Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// byte-identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue    []*queuedEvent\n\tactors   map[string]actor\n\tdead     map[string]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder       float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay       int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive          bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\trng:     rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors:  map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tstats:   st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// blackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n\t}\n\treturn int64(d)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n\t\tkind: 0,\n\t\tmsg:  m,\n\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n\t})\n}\n\n// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\nfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n\te.timerSeq++\n\ttid := e.timerSeq\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n\treturn tid\n}\n\ntype timerPayload struct {\n\tkind string\n\tdata any\n}\n\n// activeTimers guards against a canceled timer still firing.\nvar activeTimers = map[int64]bool{}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n\te.eventSeq++\n\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n\te.queue = append(e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\nfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(activeTimers, tid) }\n\n// run processes events until stopTick.\nfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n\tfor {\n\t\tif len(e.queue) == 0 {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Deterministic min selection (same semantics as heap, no heap import).\n\t\tidx := 0\n\t\tfor i := 1; i < len(e.queue); i++ {\n\t\t\tq := e.queue[i]\n\t\t\th := e.queue[idx]\n\t\t\tif q.when < h.when || (q.when == h.when && q.seq < h.seq) {\n\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tev := e.queue[idx]\n\t\te.queue = append(e.queue[:idx], e.queue[idx+1:]...)\n\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.when\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !activeTimers[ev.tid] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(activeTimers, ev.tid)\n\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n\t\tcase 2:\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// byte-identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue      []*queuedEvent\n\tactors     map[string]actor\n\tdead       map[string]bool\n\tactive     map[int64]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder       float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay       int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive          bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\trng:     rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors:  map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tactive:  map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tstats:   st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// blackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n\t}\n\treturn int64(d)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n\t\tkind: 0,\n\t\tmsg:  m,\n\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n\t})\n}\n\n// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\nfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n\te.timerSeq++\n\ttid := e.timerSeq\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n\treturn tid\n}\n\ntype timerPayload struct {\n\tkind string\n\tdata any\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n\te.eventSeq++\n\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n\te.queue = append(e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\nfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(e.active, tid) }\n\n// run processes events until stopTick.\nfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n\tfor {\n\t\tif len(e.queue) == 0 {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Deterministic min selection (same semantics as heap, no heap import).\n\t\tidx := 0\n\t\tfor i := 1; i < len(e.queue); i++ {\n\t\t\tq := e.queue[i]\n\t\t\th := e.queue[idx]\n\t\t\tif q.when < h.when || (q.when == h.when && q.seq < h.seq) {\n\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tev := e.queue[idx]\n\t\te.queue = append(e.queue[:idx], e.queue[idx+1:]...)\n\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.when\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !activeTimers[ev.tid] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(activeTimers, ev.tid)\n\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n\t\tcase 2:\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// byte-identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue      []*queuedEvent\n\tactors     map[string]actor\n\tdead       map[string]bool\n\tactive     map[int64]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder       float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay       int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive          bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\trng:     rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors:  map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tactive:  map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tstats:   st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// blackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n\t}\n\treturn int64(d)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n\t\tkind: 0,\n\t\tmsg:  m,\n\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n\t})\n}\n\n// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\nfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n\te.timerSeq++\n\ttid := e.timerSeq\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n\treturn tid\n}\n\ntype timerPayload struct {\n\tkind string\n\tdata any\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n\te.eventSeq++\n\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n\te.queue = append(e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\nfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(e.active, tid) }\n\n// run processes events until stopTick.\nfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n\tfor {\n\t\tif len(e.queue) == 0 {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Deterministic min selection (same semantics as heap, no heap import).\n\t\tidx := 0\n\t\tfor i := 1; i < len(e.queue); i++ {\n\t\t\tq := e.queue[i]\n\t\t\th := e.queue[idx]\n\t\t\tif q.when < h.when || (q.when == h.when && q.seq < h.seq) {\n\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tev := e.queue[idx]\n\t\te.queue = append(e.queue[:idx], e.queue[idx+1:]...)\n\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.when\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !e.active[ev.tid] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(e.active, ev.tid)\n\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n\t\tcase 2:\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; !ok || ver > cur.Ver {\n\t\tl.latest[key] = l.applied[key][ver]\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteConfirm(reqID string, cw ConfirmedWrite) {\n\tif _, ok := l.confirmed[reqID]; ok {\n\t\treturn // duplicate ack delivery must not double-count\n\t}\n\tl.confirmed[reqID] = cw\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) { l.reads = append(l.reads, r) }\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) latestRecord(key string) (Record, bool) {\n\tr, ok := l.latest[key]\n\treturn r, ok\n}\n\n// confirmedAt returns the highest version whose ack was observed no later than\n// tick — the lower bound a read answer at that time must meet.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedAt(key string, tick int64) int {\n\tbest := 0\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tif c.Key != key || c.ConfirmedTick > tick {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.Ver > best {\n\t\t\tbest = c.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\n// confirmedWrites returns confirmed writes sorted deterministically.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedList() []ConfirmedWrite {\n\tout := make([]ConfirmedWrite, 0, len(l.confirmed))\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tout = append(out, c)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].Key != out[j].Key {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].Key < out[j].Key\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].Ver < out[j].Ver\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"9bab9b2f-4098-4b09-b131-d0b5b4509ec0","session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}

{"parentUuid":"9f91effe-c829-4279-882d-832466136fb9","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_vx2bs739kxq0brs57vrjwgaf","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/node.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc nodeID(raw string) string { return \"node:\" + raw }\nfunc rawNode(id string) string {\n\tif len(id) > 5 && id[:5] == \"node:\" {\n\t\treturn id[5:]\n\t}\n\treturn id\n}\n\n// reliable retransmits a logical message (fixed Seq) until acknowledged.\ntype reliable struct {\n\teng      *Engine\n\tself     actor\n\ttable    map[int64]*retrans\n\tinterval int64\n}\n\ntype retrans struct {\n\tmsg *Msg\n\ttid int64\n}\n\nfunc newReliable(eng *Engine, self actor, interval int64) *reliable {\n\treturn &reliable{eng: eng, self: self, table: map[int64]*retrans{}, interval: interval}\n}\n\nfunc (r *reliable) send(m *Msg) {\n\tr.eng.send(m)\n\trt := &retrans{msg: m}\n\tr.table[m.Seq] = rt\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", retryData{m.Seq, nil})\n}\n\nfunc (r *reliable) sendData(m *Msg, data any) {\n\tr.eng.send(m)\n\trt := &retrans{msg: m}\n\tr.table[m.Seq] = rt\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", retryData{m.Seq, data})\n}\n\nfunc (r *reliable) ack(seq int64) {\n\tif rt, ok := r.table[seq]; ok {\n\t\tr.eng.cancelTimer(rt.tid)\n\t\tdelete(r.table, seq)\n\t}\n}\n\n// retransmit resends (called from the timer); returns false if forgotten.\nfunc (r *reliable) retransmit(seq int64) bool {\n\trt, ok := r.table[seq]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tr.eng.send(rt.msg)\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", retryData{seq, nil})\n\treturn true\n}\n\ntype retryData struct {\n\tseq  int64\n\textra any\n}\n\n// ---- per-key migration state on the old owner A ------------------------------\n\ntype outState struct {\n\tkey      string\n\tringVer  int\n\tsnapVer  int\n\tnextSeq  int // per-key stream seq of the next forward (snapVer+1 at start)\n\tseqToMsg map[int]int64 // stream seq -> logical Msg.Seq\n\tbarrierSeq int64       // Msg.Seq of the barrier, 0 until sent\n\tfrozen   bool\n\tbarrierAcked bool\n\tdone     bool\n\tbeganAt  int64\n}\n\n// ---- per-key migration state on the new owner B ------------------------------\n\ntype inState struct {\n\tkey          string\n\tringVer      int\n\tsnapDone     bool\n\tappliedSeq   int\n\tidem         map[string]int // reqID -> version\n\tbuffered     map[int]*MigForward\n\tbarrierWait  bool\n\tbarrierUpTo  int\n\tdone         bool\n\tpendingWrite []*WriteReq // client writes frozen at A, applied here post-barrier\n}\n\n// node is a single in-process simulated storage node.\ntype node struct {rraw  string\n\tid   string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\trel  *reliable\n\n\t// ring topology views\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\t// store: authoritative local record per key the node holds.\n\tstore map[string]Record\n\t// idem: key -> reqID -> version, for writes this node applied as owner.\n\tidem map[string]map[string]int\n\n\tout map[string]*outState\n\tin  map[string]*inState\n\n\tvnodes int\n}\n\nfunc newNode(raw string, weight int, current *ring.Ring, w *world) *node {\n\tn := &node{\n\t\trraw: raw,\n\t\tid:   nodeID(raw),\n\t\teng:  w.eng,\n\t\tw:    w,\n\t\tcurrent: current,\n\t\tstore: map[string]Record{},\n\t\tidem:  map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\tout:   map[string]*outState{},\n\t\tin:    map[string]*inState{},\n\t\tvnodes: w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t}\n\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) id() string { return n.id }\n\n// applyWrite commits a write to the local store and records ground truth.\n// ver must continue the key's version chain.\nfunc (n *node) applyWrite(key, reqID string, ver int, value string) {\n\tn.store[key] = Record{Ver: ver, Value: value, ReqID: reqID, AtTick: n.eng.tick(), Node: n.id}\n\tif n.idem[key] == nil {\n\t\tn.idem[key] = map[string]int{}\n\t}\n\tn.idem[key][reqID] = ver\n\tn.w.ledger.noteApply(key, reqID, ver, value, n.id, n.eng.tick())\n}\n\n// lastVer returns the stored version of key (0 if absent).\nfunc (n *node) lastVer(key string) int { return n.store[key].Ver }\n\nfunc (n *node) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onAnnounce(m, b)\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onCommit(m, b)\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\tn.onDecommission(m, b)\n\n\tcase *WriteReq:\n\t\tn.onWrite(m, b)\n\tcase *ReadReq:\n\t\tn.onRead(m, b)\n\n\tcase *StartMigration:\n\t\tn.onBegin(m, b)\n\tcase *StartBarrier:\n\t\tn.onStartBarrier(m, b)\n\tcase *MigSnapshot:\n\t\t// arrives at B\n\t\tn.onSnapshot(m, b)\n\tcase *MigForward:\n\t\tn.onForward(m, b)\n\tcase *MigAck:\n\t\tn.onMigAck(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrier:\n\t\tn.onBarrier(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrierAck:\n\t\tn.onBarrierAck(m, b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"retry\":\n\t\trd := data.(retryData)\n\t\tn.rel.retransmit(rd.seq)\n\tcase \"pendingWrite\":\n\t\t// nothing: pending client writes are applied opportunistically; the\n\t\t// timer entry exists only if needed.\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- topology ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (n *node) onAnnounce(m *Msg, a *TopologyAnnounce) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: a.Version}})\n\tif a.Pending {\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(a.Version, n.w.nodeSpecs(a.Nodes), n.vnodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.pending = r\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) onCommit(m *Msg, c *CommitAnnounce) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"CommitAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &CommitAck{Version: c.Version}})\n\tif n.pending != nil && n.pending.Version == c.Version {\n\t\tn.current = n.pending\n\t\tn.pending = nil\n\t}\n\t// Finalize migration streams for this epoch: B promotes its dedup table,\n\t// A drops its outgoing bookkeeping. Stored copies are retained until\n\t// explicit decommission, so the removal gate can inspect them.\n\tfor key, st := range n.in {\n\t\tif st.ringVer == c.Version {\n\t\t\tif n.idem[key] == nil {\n\t\t\t\tn.idem[key] = map[string]int{}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor req, ver := range st.idem {\n\t\t\t\tn.idem[key][req] = ver\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(n.in, key)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor key, st := range n.out {\n\t\tif st.ringVer == c.Version {\n\t\t\tdelete(n.out, key)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) onDecommission(m *Msg, d *Decommission) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"DecommissionAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &DecommissionAck{Version: d.Version}})\n\tn.w.onNodeDecommissioned(n)\n}\n\n// ---- client writes ------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (n *node) onWrite(m *Msg, w *WriteReq) {\n\tkey := w.Key\n\towner := n.current.Owner(key)\n\t// Post-commit: a node that is not the owner redirects to the owner.\n\tif owner != n.rraw {\n\t\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: n.w.newSeq(),\n\t\t\tBody: &WriteAck{Key: key, ReqID: w.ReqID, Redirect: nodeID(owner)}})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Already applied (duplicated delivery / client retry / post-switch retry)?\n\tif ver, ok := n.knownReq(key, w.ReqID); ok {\n\t\trec := n.store[key]\n\t\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: n.w.newSeq(),\n\t\t\tBody: &WriteAck{Key: key, ReqID: w.ReqID, Ver: ver, Value: rec.Value}})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Migration handoff in progress as old owner: while frozen, bounce the\n\t// write to the new owner (it applies once its barrier completes).\n\tif os := n.out[key]; os != nil {\n\t\tif os.frozen {\n\t\t\tdst := n.pending.Owner(key)\n\t\t\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: n.w.newSeq(),\n\t\t\t\tBody: &WriteAck{Key: key, ReqID: w.ReqID, Redirect: nodeID(dst)}})\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tver := n.lastVer(key) + 1\n\t\tn.applyWrite(key, w.ReqID, ver, w.Value)\n\t\tseq := os.nextSeq\n\t\tos.nextSeq++\n\t\tfwd := &MigForward{Key: key, SeqNo: seq, ReqID: w.ReqID, Ver: ver, Value: w.Value}\n\t\tmsg := &Msg{Type: \"MigForward\", From: n.id, To: nodeID(n.pending.Owner(key)),\n\t\t\tSeq: n.w.newSeq(), Migration: true, Body: fwd}\n\t\tn.rel.send(msg)\n\t\tos.seqToMsg[seq] = msg.Seq\n\t\tn.w.onMigrateTransfer(\"forward\", key, len(w.Value))\n\t\tn.ackWrite(m.From, w, ver, w.Value)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// New owner with migration not yet finalized.\n\tif is := n.in[key]; is != nil {\n\t\tif !is.done {\n\t\t\t// Barrier not complete yet: remember the write; apply after catchup.\n\t\t\tif !is.knownReq(w.ReqID) {\n\t\t\t\tis.pendingWrite = append(is.pendingWrite, w)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn // no ack yet; id[5:]\n\t}\n\treturn id\n}\n\n// reliable retransmits a logical message (fixed Seq) until acknowledged.\ntype reliable struct {\n\teng      *Engine\n\tself     actor\n\ttable    map[int64]*retrans\n\tinterval int64\n}\n\ntype retrans struct {\n\tmsg *Msg\n\ttid int64\n}\n\nfunc newReliable(eng *Engine, self actor, interval int64) *reliable {\n\treturn &reliable{eng: eng, forward (snapVer+1 at start)\n\tseqToMsg map[int]int64 // stream seq -> logical Msg.Seq\n\tbarrierSeq int64       // Msg.Seq of the barrier, 0 until sent\n\tfrozen   bool\n\tbarrierAcked bool\n\tdone bool\n\tappliedSeq   int\n\tidem         map[string]int // reqID -> version\n\tbuffered     map[int]*MigForward\n\tbarrierWait  bool\n\tbarrierUpTo  int\n\tdone         bool\n\tpendingWrite map[string]Record{},\n\t\tidem:  map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\tout:   map[string]*outState{},\n\t\tin:    map[string]*inState{},\n\t\tvnodes: w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t}\n\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) id() string { return n.id }\n\n// applyWrite commits a write to the local store and records ground truth.\n// ver must continue the key's if absent).\nfunc (n *node) lastVer(key string) int { return n.store[key].Ver }\n\nfunc (n *node) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onAnnounce(m, b)\n\tcase *MigAck:\n\t\tn.onMigAck(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrier:\n\t\tn.onBarrier(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrierAck:\n\t\tn.onBarrierAck(m, b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) timer(kind string, data any) sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc nodeID(raw string) string { return \"node:\" + raw }\nfunc rawNode(id string) string {\n\tif len(id) > 5 && id[:5] == \"node:\" {\n\t\treturn id[5:]\n\t}\n\treturn id\n}\n\n// reliable retransmits a logical message (fixed Seq) until acknowledged.\ntype reliable struct {\n\teng      *Engine\n\tself     actor\n\ttable    map[int64]*retrans\n\tinterval int64\n}\n\ntype retrans struct {\n\tmsg *Msg\n\ttid int64\n}\n\nfunc newReliable(eng *Engine, self actor, interval int64) *reliable {\n\treturn &reliable{eng: eng, self: self, table: map[int64]*retrans{}, interval: interval}\n}\n\nfunc (r *reliable) send(m *Msg) {\n\tr.eng.send(m)\n\trt := &retrans{msg: m}\n\tr.table[m.Seq] = rt\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", m.Seq)\n}\n\nfunc (r *reliable) ack(seq int64) {\n\tif rt, ok := r.table[seq]; ok {\n\t\tr.eng.cancelTimer(rt.tid)\n\t\tdelete(r.table, seq)\n\t}\n}\n\n// retransmit resends (called from the timer); returns false if forgotten.\nfunc (r *reliable) retransmit(seq int64) bool {\n\trt, ok := r.table[seq]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tr.eng.send(rt.msg)\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", seq)\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- per-key migration state on the old owner A ------------------------------\n\ntype outState struct {\n\tkey         string\n\tringVer     int\n\tsnapVer     int\n\tnextSeq     int // per-key stream seq of the next forward (snapVer+1 at start)\n\tseqToMsg    map[int]int64 // stream seq -> logical Msg.Seq\n\tbarrierSeq  int64         // Msg.Seq of the barrier, 0 until sent\n\tfrozen      bool\n\tbarrierAcked bool\n\tdone        bool\n\tbeganAt     int64\n}\n\n// ---- per-key migration state on the new owner B ------------------------------\n\ntype inState struct {\n\tkey          string\n\tringVer      int\n\tsnapDone     bool\n\tappliedSeq   int\n\tidem         map[string]int // reqID -> version\n\tbuffered     map[int]*MigForward\n\tbarrierWait  bool\n\tbarrierUpTo  int\n\tdone         bool\n\tpendingWrite []pendingClientWrite // client writes frozen at A, applied here after barrier\n}\n\ntype pendingClientWrite struct {\n\tfrom string\n\treq  *WriteReq\n}\n\n// node is a single in-process simulated storage node.\ntype node struct {\n\trraw    string\n\tid      string\n\teng     *Engine\n\tw       *world\n\trel     *reliable\n\n\t// ring topology views\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\t// store: authoritative local record per key the node holds.\n\tstore map[string]Record\n\t// idem: key -> reqID -> version, for writes this node applied as owner.\n\tidem map[string]map[string]int\n\n\tout map[string]*outState\n\tin  map[string]*inState\n\n\tvnodes int\n}\n\nfunc newNode(raw string, current *ring.Ring, w *world) *node {\n\tn := &node{\n\t\trraw:    raw,\n\t\tid:      nodeID(raw),\n\t\teng:     w.eng,\n\t\tw:       w,\n\t\tcurrent: current,\n\t\tstore:   map[string]Record{},\n\t\tidem:    map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\tout:     map[string]*outState{},\n\t\tin:      map[string]*inState{},\n\t\tvnodes:  w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t}\n\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) id() string { return n.id }\n\n// applyWrite commits a write to the local store and records ground truth.\n// ver must continue the key's version chain.\nfunc (n *node) applyWrite(key, reqID string, ver int, value string) {\n\tn.store[key] = Record{Ver: ver, Value: value, ReqID: reqID, AtTick: n.eng.tick(), Node: n.id}\n\tif n.idem[key] == nil {\n\t\tn.idem[key] = map[string]int{}\n\t}\n\tn.idem[key][reqID] = ver\n\tn.w.ledger.noteApply(key, reqID, ver, value, n.id, n.eng.tick())\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) lastVer(key string) int { return n.store[key].Ver }\n\nfunc (n *node) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onAnnounce(m, b)\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onCommit(m, b)\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\tn.onDecommission(m, b)\n\n\tcase *WriteReq:\n\t\tn.onWrite(m, b)\n\tcase *ReadReq:\n\t\tn.onRead(m, b)\n\n\tcase *StartMigration:\n\t\tn.onBegin(m, b)\n\tcase *StartBarrier:\n\t\tn.onStartBarrier(m, b)\n\tcase *MigSnapshot:\n\t\tn.onSnapshot(m, b) // arrives at B\n\tcase *MigForward:\n\t\tn.onForward(m, b)\n\tcase *MigAck:\n\t\tn.onMigAck(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrier:\n\t\tn.onBarrier(m, b)\n\tcase *MigBarrierAck:\n\t\tn.onBarrierAck(m, b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tif kind == \"retry\" {\n\t\tn.rel.retransmit(data.(int64))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- topology ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (n *node) onAnnounce(m *Msg, a *TopologyAnnounce) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: a.Version}})\n\tif a.Pending {\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(a.Version, n.w.nodeSpecs(a.Nodes), n.vnodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.pending = r\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) onCommit(m *Msg, c *CommitAnnounce) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"CommitAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &CommitAck{Version: c.Version}})\n\tif n.pending != nil && n.pending.Version == c.Version {\n\t\tn.current = n.pending\n\t\tn.pending = nil\n\t}\n\t// Finalize migration streams for this epoch: B promotes its dedup table,\n\t// A drops its outgoing sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc nodeID(raw string) string { return \"node:\" + raw }\nfunc rawNode(id string) string {\n\tif len(id) > 5 && id[:5] == \"node:\" {\n\t\treturn id[5:]\n\t}\n\treturn id\n}\n\n// reliable retransmits a logical message (fixed Seq) until acknowledged.\ntype reliable struct {\n\teng      *Engine\n\tself     actor\n\ttable    map[int64]*retrans\n\tinterval int64\n}\n\ntype retrans struct {\n\tmsg *Msg\n\ttid int64\n}\n\nfunc newReliable(eng *Engine, self actor, interval int64) *reliable {\n\treturn &reliable{eng: eng, retransmit resends (called from the timer); returns false if forgotten.\nfunc (r *reliable) retransmit(seq int64) bool {\n\trt, ok := r.table[seq]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tr.eng.send(rt.msg)\n\trt.tid = r.eng.after(r.interval, r.self, \"retry\", seq)\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- per-key migration state on the old owner A ------------------------------\n\ntype outState struct {\n\tkey         string\n\tringVer     int\n\tsnapVer     int\n\tnextSeq     int // per-key stream seq of the next forward (snapVer+1 at start)\n\tseqToMsg    map[int]int64 // stream seq -> logical Msg.Seq\n\tbarrierSeq  int64         // Msg.Seq of the barrier, 0 until sent\n\tfrozen      bool\n\tbarrierAcked bool\n\tdone bool\n\tappliedSeq   int\n\tidem         map[string]int // reqID -> version\n\tbuffered     map[int]*MigForward\n\tbarrierWait  bool\n\tbarrierUpTo  int\n\tdone         bool\n\tpendingWrite []pendingClientWrite // client writes frozen at A, applied here after barrier\n}\n\ntype pendingClientWrite struct {\n\tfrom string\n\treq  *WriteReq\n}\n\n// node is a single in-process simulated storage node.\ntype node struct {\n\trraw    string\n\tid      string\n\teng     *Engine\n\tw       *world\n\trel     *reliable\n\n\t// ring topology views\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\t// store: authoritative local record per key the node holds.\n\tstore map[string]Record\n\t// idem: key -> reqID -> version, for writes this node applied as owner.\n\tidem map[string]map[string]int\n\n\tout map[string]*outState\n\tin  map[string]*inState\n\n\tvnodes int\n}\n\nfunc newNode(raw string, current *ring.Ring, w *world) *node {\n\tn := &node{\n\t\trraw:    raw,\n\t\tid:      nodeID(raw),\n\t\teng:     w.eng,\n\t\tw:       w,\n\t\tcurrent: current,\n\t\tstore:   map[string]Record{},\n\t\tidem:    map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\tout:     map[string]*outState{},\n\t\tin:      map[string]*inState{},\n\t\tvnodes:  w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t}\n\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) id() string { return n.id }\n\n// applyWrite commits a write to the local store and records ground truth.\n// ver must continue the key's version chain.\nfunc (n *node) applyWrite(key, reqID string, ver int, value string) {\n\tn.store[key] = Record{Ver: ver, Value: value, ReqID: reqID, AtTick: n.eng.tick(), Node: n.id}\n\tif n.idem[key] == nil {\n\t\tn.idem[key] = map[string]int{}\n\t}\n\tn.idem[key][reqID] = ver\n\tn.w.ledger.noteApply(key, reqID, ver, value, n.id, n.eng.tick())\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) lastVer(key string) int { return n.store[key].Ver }\n\nfunc (n *node) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onAnnounce(m, b)\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onCommit(m, b)\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\tn.onDecommission(m, b)\n\n\tcase m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: a.Version}})\n\tif a.Pending {\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(a.Version, n.w.nodeSpecs(a.Nodes), n.vnodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.pending = r\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) onCommit(m *Msg, c *CommitAnnounce) {\n\tn.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"CommitAck\", From: n.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &CommitAck{Version: c.Version}})\n\tif n.pending != ok {\n\t\trec := n.store[key]\n\t\tn.replyWrite(m.From, w, ver, rec.Value, \"\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Migration handoff in progress as old owner: apply + forward until frozen,\n\t// then bounce writes to the new owner (they apply once its barrier closes).\n\tif os := n.out[key]; id[5:]\n\t}\n\treturn id\n}\n\n// reliable retransmits a logical message (fixed Seq) until acknowledged.\ntype reliable struct {\n\teng      *Engine\n\tself     actor\n\ttable    map[int64]*retrans\n\tinterval int64\n}\n\ntype retrans struct {\n\tmsg *Msg\n\ttid int64\n}\n\nfunc newReliable(eng *Engine, self actor, interval int64) *reliable {\n\treturn &reliable{eng: eng, bool\n\tappliedSeq   int\n\tidem         map[string]int // reqID -> version\n\tbuffered     map[int]*MigForward\n\tbarrierWait  bool\n\tbarrierUpTo  int\n\tdone         bool\n\tpendingWrite raw,\n\t\tid:      nodeID(raw),\n\t\teng:     w.eng,\n\t\tw:       w,\n\t\tcurrent: current,\n\t\tstore:   map[string]Record{},\n\t\tidem:    map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\tout:     map[string]*outState{},\n\t\tin:      map[string]*inState{},\n\t\tvnodes:  w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t}\n\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\treturn n\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) id() string { ver\n\tn.w.ledger.noteApply(key, reqID, ver, value, n.id, n.eng.tick())\n}\n\nfunc (n *node) lastVer(key string) int { return n.store[key].Ver }\n\nfunc (n *node) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onAnnounce(m, b)\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tn.onCommit(m, b)\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\tn.onDecommission(m, b)\n\n\tcase ReqID is globally unique; nodes apply an\n// idempotency table on it, so retries or duplicate delivery never apply twice.\ntype WriteReq struct {\n\tKey    string\n\tValue  string\n\tReqID  string\n}\n\n// WriteAck is the single-version decision. Ver is the key's monotonically\n// increasing version assigned by the current coordinator.\ntype WriteAck struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tReqID   string\n\tVer     int\n\tValue   string\n\tRedirect string // non-empty: write was rejected pre-barrier, retry on node\n}\n\n// ---- client <-> node: reads --------------------------------------------------\n\ntype ReadReq struct {\n\tRID string\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ReadResp is an individual node's answer. During dual-read the client takes\n// the answer with the greatest Ver — the single-version arbiter.\ntype ReadResp struct {\n\tRID   string\n\tKey   string\n\tFound bool\n\tVer   int\n\tValue string\n}\n\n// ---- node A (old owner) <-> node B (new owner) -------------------------------\n\n// MigBegin opens the per-key migration stream.\ntype MigBegin struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tRingVer   int\n\tNextVer   int // expected per-key apply seq of the first forwarded write\n}\n\n// MigSnapshot ships the record visible on A at the moment migration starts,\n// together with A's idempotency table for the key, so B can deduplicate client\n// retries that arrive after the switch.\ntype MigSnapshot struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tVer       int\n\tValue     string\n\tIdempotents map[string]int // reqID -> applied version\n\tNextVer   int\n}\n\n// MigForward streams every write A applies after the snapshot, in per-key\n// sequence order. SeqNo is the key's apply sequence (snapshot covers < SeqNo).\ntype MigForward struct {\n\tKey    string\n\tSeqNo  int\n\tReqID  string\n\tVer    int\n\tValue  string\n}\n\n// MigAck acknowledges snapshot (SeqNo == snapshot version) or forwards.\ntype MigAck struct {\n\tKey   string\n\tSeqNo int\n}\n\n// MigBarrier is the switch barrier: once B acknowledges it, having applied the\n// snapshot and every forwarded write, the key is safe to serve from B.\ntype MigBarrier struct {\n\tKey string\n}\n\ntype MigBarrierAck struct {\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ---- controller <-> nodes/clients -------------------------------------------\n\n// TopologyAnnounce reliably publishes a pending or committed ring.\ntype TopologyAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n\tNodes   []string\n\tPending bool // true: migration in progress, dual-read against old+new\n}\n\ntype TopologyAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// CommitAnnounce finalizes a ring epoch after every key barrier passed.\ntype CommitAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\ntype CommitAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// Decommission tells a removed physical node to shut down. sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc clientID(raw string) string { return \"client:\" + raw }\n\ntype plannedOp struct {\n\tat    int64\n\twrite bool\n\tidx   int // plan index, used in ReqID/RID\n}\n\n// inflight tracks one outstanding write or read.\ntype inflight struct {\n\tkey      string\n\treqID    string\n\tvalue    string\n\twrite    bool\n\tattempts int\n\tto       string // current target node (internal id)\n\tissueTick int64\n\ttid      int64\n\t// read bookkeeping\n\treadVer int\n\treadVal string\n\treadFound bool\n\tgotResp bool\n}\n\ntype client struct {\n\tcfg  ClientCfg\n\tid   string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\tplan    []plannedOp\n\tinflight map[string]*inflight\n\tmaxRetry int\n}\n\nfunc newClient(cfg ClientCfg, w *world) *client {\n\tc := &client{\n\t\tcfg: cfg, id: clientID(cfg.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\tcurrent: w.rings[0],\n\t\tinflight: map[string]*inflight{},\n\t\tmaxRetry: w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tnumKeys := len(w.cfg.Keys)\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves generation on ties).\n\tsort.SliceStable(plan, func(i, j int) bool { return plan[i].at < plan[j].at })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.id }\n\nfunc (c *client) valueFor(planIdx int) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"v:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: c.id, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(b.Version, c.w.nodeSpecs(b.Nodes), c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.Pending {\n\t\t\tc.pending = r\n\t\t} else if c.current.Version < b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = r\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\tc.onWriteAck(b)\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tc.onReadResp(b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"issue\":\n\t\tp := data.(plannedOp)\n\t\tif p.write {\n\t\t\tc.startWrite(p.idx)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.startRead(p.idx)\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wretry\":\n\t\tc.retryWrite(data.(string))\n\tcase \"rretry\":\n\t\tc.retryRead(data.(string))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- writes -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (c *client) startWrite(planIdx int) {\n\tkey := c.w.keyFor(c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\treqID := fmt.Sprintf(\"w:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\tval := c.valueFor(planIdx)\n\tc.w.stats.WritesIssued++\n\tinf := &inflight{key: key, reqID: reqID, value: val, write: true, attempt: 1,\n\t\tissueTick: c.eng.tick(), to: nodeID(c.current.Owner(key))}\n\tc.inflight[reqID] = inf\n\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", reqID)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) sendWrite(inf *inflight) {\n\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteReq\", From: c.id, To: inf.to, Seq: c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\tBody: &WriteReq{Key: inf.key, Value: inf.value, ReqID: inf.reqID}})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onWriteAck(a *WriteAck) {\n\tinf := c.inflight[a.ReqID]\n\tif inf == nil {\n\t\treturn // already completed, duplicated ack\n\t}\n\tif a.Redirect != \"\" {\n\t\t// Migration bounce: follow to the new owner, same request id.\n\t\tc.eng.cancelTimer(inf.tid)\n\t\tinf.to = a.Redirect\n\t\tinf.attempts++\n\t\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\t\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", a.ReqID)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.eng.cancelTimer(inf.tid)\n\tdelete(c.inflight, a.ReqID)\n\tc.w.stats.WritesConfirmed++\n\tc.w.ledger.noteConfirm(a.ReqID, ConfirmedWrite{\n\t\tKey: a.Key, Ver: a.Ver, Value: a.Value, ConfirmedTick: c.eng.tick(),\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) retryWrite(reqID string) {\n\tinf, ok := c.inflight[reqID]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tinf.attempts++\n\tif inf.attempts > c.maxRetry {\n\t\tdelete(c.inflight, reqID)\n\t\tc.w.stats.WritesFailed++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Re-target on the freshest view in case topology moved while we waited.\n\tif c.pending != nil {\n\t\t// Prefer the new owner only once it is known to serve; otherwise keep\n\t\t// hitting the current owner and follow its redirects.\n\t}\n\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", reqID)\n}\n\n// ---- reads --------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (c *client) startRead(planIdx int) {\n\tkey := c.w.keyFor(c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\trid := fmt.Sprintf(\"r:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\tc.w.stats.ReadsIssued++\n\tinf := &inflight{key: key, reqID: rid, write: false, attempts: 1, issueTick: c.eng.tick()}\n\tc.inflight[rid] = inf\n\tc.sendRead(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"rretry\", rid)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) readTargets(key string) []string {\n\tt := nodeID(c.current.Owner(key))\n\tif c.pending != nil {\n\t\tif n2 := nodeID(c.pending.Owner(key)); n2 != t {\n\t\t\treturn []string{t, n2} // dual read: old + new owner\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn []string{t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) sendRead(inf *inflight) {\n\tfor _, t := range c.readTargets(inf.key) {\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"ReadReq\", From: c.id, To: t, Seq: c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\t\tBody: &ReadReq{RID: inf.reqID, Key: inf.key}})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onReadResp(r *ReadResp) {\n\tinf := c.inflight[r.RID]\n\tif inf == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !inf.gotResp || (r.Found && (!inf.readFound || r.Ver > inf.readVer)) {\n\t\tinf.gotResp = true\n\t\tinf.readFound = r.Found\n\t\tinf.readVer = r.Ver\n\t\tinf.readVal = r.Value\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) retryRead(rid string) {\n\tinf, ok := c.inflight[rid]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif inf.gotResp {\n\t\t// Dual-read winner: the greatest version across the answers — the\n\t\t// single-version arbiter when replicas disagree during migration.\n\t\tc.eng.cancelTimer(inf.tid)\n\t\tdelete(c.inflight, rid)\n\t\tc.w.stats.ReadsSucceeded++\n\t\tc.w.ledger.noteRead(ReadObservation{\n\t\t\tKey: inf.key, IssueTick: inf.issueTick, RespTick: c.eng.tick(),\n\t\t\tVer: inf.readVer, Found: inf.readFound, Success: true,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tinf.attempts++\n\tif inf.attempts > c.maxRetry {\n\t\tdelete(c.inflight, rid)\n\t\tc.w.stats.ReadsFailed++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tc.sendRead(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"rretry\", rid)\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_d96fabc5c5733b00b7f193ae","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1028,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":61240,"output_tokens":2961,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_5t7melyas3ly3f3v74dl08a6":{"content":"package *world\n\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\tplan    []plannedOp\n\tinflight map[string]*inflight\n\tmaxRetry int\n}\n\nfunc newClient(cfg ClientCfg, w *world) *client {\n\tc := plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tnumKeys := len(w.cfg.Keys)\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.id }\n\nfunc (c *client) {"parentUuid":"8e3407cd-d72f-4b24-83b7-6f58d938a4f5","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_nt0w7b1d3bidjrt2379lelfg","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/controller.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nconst ctrlID = \"ctrl\"\n\n// epochM tracks the lifecycle of one topology epoch under migration.\ntype epochM struct {\n\tversion    int\n\tring       *ring.Ring\n\tbeganAt    int64\n\tmovingKeys []string\n\tswitchDone map[string]bool\n\tbarrierSent map[string]bool\n\t// announce/commit reliable-delivery tracking\n\tannAcked   map[string]bool\n\tcommitAcked map[string]bool\n\tcommitted  bool\n\tremoved    []string // nodes removed in this epoch (scale in)\n\tdecomAcked map[string]bool\n}\n\n// controller is the (in-process, simulated) migration orchestrator.\ntype controller struct {\n\tid  string\n\teng *Engine\n\tw   *world\n\n\t// pending topology epochs in version order; head is the active migration.\n\tepochs []*epochM\n}\n\nfunc newController(w *world) *controller {\n\treturn &controller{id: ctrlID, eng: w.eng, w: w}\n}\n\nfunc (c *controller) id() string { return c.id }\n\nfunc (c *controller) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAck:\n\t\tc.onAnnounceAck(m, b)\n\tcase *CommitAck:\n\t\tc.onCommitAck(m, b)\n\tcase *BarrierDone:\n\t\tc.onBarrierDone(m, b)\n\tcase *DecommissionAck:\n\t\tc.onDecomAck(m, b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *controller) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"resendAnnounce\":\n\t\tc.resendAnnounce(data.(int))\n\tcase \"startBarrier\":\n\t\tc.sendBarrier(data.(string))\n\tcase \"resendBarrier\":\n\t\tc.resendBarrier(data.(string))\n\tcase \"commit\":\n\t\tc.sendCommit(data.(int))\n\tcase \"resendCommit\":\n\t\tc.resendCommit(data.(int))\n\tcase \"decom\":\n\t\tc.resendDecom(data.(int))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- timed operations ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n// beginScaleOut builds the next ring with added nodes and starts migration.\nfunc (c *controller) beginScaleOut(add []NodeSpec, tick int64) {\n\tspecs := append(c.currentSpecs(), add...)\n\tnextVer := c.w.nextRingVersion()\n\tr, err := ring.New(nextVer, specs, c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tc.startEpoch(r, nil, tick)\n}\n\n// beginScaleIn builds the next ring without removed nodes. {"parentUuid":"5187c3f6-a86a-4969-a028-f6d307850932","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_br9zhu5fvbt9ouuwpxzce4bs","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/world.go","content":"// Package sim is a deterministic single-process discrete-event simulator for\n// weighted consistent hashing with live key migration.\n//\n// The package has three roles:\n//\n//   - Engine (engine.go): logical clock, event queue and the lossy network\n//     (drop / duplicate / reorder, plus a migration-only blackhole).\n//   - Nodes and clients (node.go, client.go): storage nodes implementing the\n//     snapshot/forward/switch-barrier protocol, and clients performing writes\n//     and dual-reads with a single-version arbiter.\n//   - World (this file): assembly, timed operations, migration accounting and\n//     the end-of-run correctness verifications against an external ledger.\n//\n// Nothing here opens a socket or spawns a goroutine: the same Config and Seed\n// always produce the same Report.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\n// World is one simulation run.\ntype world struct {\n\tcfg    Config\n\teng    *Engine\n\tledger *Ledger\n\tctrl   *controller\n\n\t// rings by topology version\n\trings        []*ring.Ring\n\tpendingRings map[int]*ring.Ring\n\tringSpecs    map[int][]ring.NodeSpec // specs used to build each ring\n\n\tnodes     map[string]*node // live nodes by raw id\n\tclients   map[string]*client\n\tactorOrder []string\n\n\tseqCounter int64\n\n\t// epoch lifecycle metadata for the report\n\tepochBegan   map[int]int64\n\tepochCommit  map[int]int64\n\tcommittedEpochs map[int]*epochM // retained for decommission acks\n\tepochOrder   []int\n\n\t// migration accounting\n\tmovements     map[string]*moveTrack // keyed \"ver|key\"\n\tmoveOrder     []string\n\tapplyCounts   map[string]int // \"ver|key\" -> record versions applied at B\n\tapplyBytes    map[string]int // payload bytes applied at B\n\tfinalBytes    map[string]int // bytes of each moved key's final record\n\tmovedKeySet   map[string]bool\n\tdeadNodes     map[string]bool\n\tdeadAt        map[string]int64\n\n\taborts []string\n}\n\ntype moveTrack struct {\n\tkey, from, to string\n\tversion       int\n\tbeganAt       int64\n\tswitchedAt    int64\n}\n\nfunc moveKey(ver int, key string) string { return fmt.Sprintf(\"%d|%s\", ver, key) }\n\n// Run executes a configuration and returns the JSON-ready report.\nfunc Run(cfg Config) (*Report, error) {\n\tif err := normalizeCfg(&cfg); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw := &world{\n\t\tcfg: cfg,\n\t\tledger: newLedger(),\n\t\tpendingRings: map[int]*ring.Ring{},\n\t\tringSpecs:    map[int][]ring.NodeSpec{},\n\t\tnodes:        map[string]*node{},\n\t\tclients:      map[string]*client{},\n\t\tepochBegan:   map[int]int64{},\n\t\tepochCommit:  map[int]int64{},\n\t\tcommittedEpochs: map[int]*epochM{},\n\t\tmovements:    map[string]*moveTrack{},\n\t\tapplyCounts:  map[string]int{},\n\t\tapplyBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tfinalBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tmovedKeySet:  map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadNodes:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadAt:       map[string]int64{},\n\t}\n\tw.eng = newEngine(cfg.Seed, &Stats{})\n\tw.eng.onDeliver = nil\n\n\t// Ring 0\n\tspecs := make([]ring.NodeSpec, len(cfg.InitialNodes))\n\tfor i, n := range cfg.InitialNodes {\n\t\tspecs[i] = ring.NodeSpec{ID: n.ID, Weight: n.Weight}\n\t}\n\tr0, err := ring.New(0, specs, cfg.VNodes)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw.rings = []*ring.Ring{r0}\n\tw.ringSpecs[0] = r0.Nodes()\n\tw.epochOrder = []int{0}\n\n\tw.ctrl = newController(w)\n\tw.eng.register(w.ctrl)\n\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, ctrlID)\n\n\tfor _, s := range r0.Nodes() {\n\t\tn := newNode(s.ID, r0, w)\n\t\tw.nodes[s.ID] = n\n\t\tw.eng.register(n)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, n.id)\n\t}\n\tfor _, cc := range cfg.Clients {\n\t\tcl := newClient(cc, w)\n\t\tw.clients[cc.ID] = cl\n\t\tw.eng.register(cl)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, cl.id)\n\t}\n\n\t// Initial epoch 0 view in the report (committed at tick 0).\n\tw.epochBegan[0] = 0\n\tw.epochCommit[0] = 0\n\n\t// Timed operations.\n\tlastTick := 0\n\tfor _, op := range cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Tick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.Tick\n\t\t}\n\t\tif op.Kind == \"interrupt\" && op.EndTick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.EndTick\n\t\t}\n\t\tw.scheduleOp(op)\n\t}\n\tstopTick := cfg.StopTick\n\tif stopTick == 0 {\n\t\tstopTick = lastTick + cfg.DrainTicks\n\t}\n\tw.eng.after(int64(stopTick), w.ctrl, \"noop\", nil) // not used; kept for clarity\n\n\tw.eng.run(int64(stopTick))\n\n\treturn w.buildReport(stopTick), nil\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) scheduleOp(op OpCfg) {\n\tswitch op.Kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tspecs := make([]NodeCfg, len(op.Add))\n\t\tcopy(specs, op.Add)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"scaleOut\", specs)\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tids := make([]string, len(op.Remove))\n\t\tcopy(ids, op.Remove)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"scaleIn\", ids)\n\tcase \"interrupt\":\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"blackholeOn\", op.EndTick)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.EndTick), w.ctrl, \"blackholeOff\", nil)\n\tdefault:\n\t\tpanic(\"unknown operation kind: \" + op.Kind)\n\t}\n}\n\n// controller noop + operation entry points: operations arrive as controller\n// timers so ordering relative to messages is deterministic.\nfunc init() {}\n\nfunc (c *controller) handleOp(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleOut(data.([]NodeCfg), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleIn(data.([]string), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"blackholeOn\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(true, int64(data.(int)))\n\tcase \"blackholeOff\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(false, 0)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- config normalization -----------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc normalizeCfg(cfg *Config) error {\n\tif len(cfg.InitialNodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"initialNodes required\")\n\t}\n\tif len(cfg.Keys) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"keys required\")\n\t}\n\tif len(cfg.Clients) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"at least one client required\")\n\t}\n\tif cfg.VNodes <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.VNodes = 64\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MinLinkDelay <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.MinLinkDelay = 1\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MaxLinkDelay < cfg.MinLinkDelay {\n\t\tcfg.MaxLinkDelay = cfg.MinLinkDelay + 2\n\t}\n\tif cfg.RetryTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.RetryTicks = 20\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MigrationConcurrency <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.MigrationConcurrency = 8\n\t}\n\tif cfg.BarrierTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.BarrierTicks = 30\n\t}\n\tif cfg.DrainTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.DrainTicks = 400\n\t}\n\tfor _, r := range []*float64{&cfg.LossRate, &cfg.DuplicateRate, &cfg.ReorderRate} {\n\t\tif *r < 0 || *r >= 1 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network rates must be in [0,1)\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Validate operations against topology at declaration time where possible.\n\tpresent := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, n := range cfg.InitialNodes {\n\t\tif n.Weight <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q weight must be positive\", n.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\tpresent[n.ID] = true\n\t}\n\tprevTick := -1\n\tfor _, op := range cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Tick < prevTick {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"operations must be ordered by tick\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tprevTick = op.Tick\n\t\tswitch op.Kind {\n\t\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\t\tif len(op.Add) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleOut requires add nodes\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor _, a := range op.Add {\n\t\t\t\tif present[a.ID] {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleOut node already present: %s\", a.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tpresent[a.ID] = true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\t\tfor _, id := range op.Remove {\n\t\t\t\tif !present[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleIn node not present: %s\", id)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tdelete(present, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif len(present) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleIn would remove every node\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"interrupt\":\n\t\t\tif op.EndTick <= op.Tick {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"interrupt endTick must exceed tick\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown operation kind: %s\", op.Kind)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Client windows.\n\tfor i := range cfg.Clients {\n\t\tif cfg.Clients[i].Writes <= 0 {\n\t\t\tcfg.Clients[i].Writes = 50\n\t\t}\n\t\tif cfg.Clients[i].EndTick <= cfg.Clients[i].StartTick {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"client %s endTick must exceed startTick\", cfg.Clients[i].ID)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ---- world services used by actors --------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (w *world) newSeq() int64 {\n\tw.seqCounter++\n\treturn w.seqCounter\n}\n\n// clientRNG derives a dedicated workload RNG per client from the master seed.\nfunc (w *world) clientRNG(id string) *rand.Rand {\n\th := fnvMix(uint64(w.cfg.Seed) ^ fnvStringHash(id))\n\treturn rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(h)))\n}\n\n// keyFor maps a client plan slot to a key deterministically.\nfunc (w *world) keyFor(clientID string, planIdx int) string {\n\tn := len(w.cfg.Keys)\n\th := fnvMix(fnvStringHash(clientID) ^ uint64(planIdx)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)\n\treturn w.cfg.Keys[int(h%uint64(n))]\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) maxClientAttempts() int { return 40 }\n\nfunc (w *world) nodeSpecs(ids []string) []ring.NodeSpec {\n\t// Weight lookup: search the most recent ring containing the id.\n\tweightOf := func(id string) int {\n\t\tfor i := len(w.rings) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range w.rings[i].Nodes() {\n\t\t\t\tif n.ID == id {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn n.Weight\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif p := w.pendingRings[len(w.rings)]; p != nil {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range p.Nodes() {\n\t\t\t\tif n.ID == id {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn n.Weight\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tout := make([]ring.NodeSpec, 0, len(ids))\n\tfor _, id := range ids {\n\t\tout = append(out, ring.NodeSpec{ID: id, Weight: weightOf(id)})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) allActorIDs() []string {\n\tout := make([]string, 0, len(w.actorOrder))\n\tout = append(out, w.actorOrder...)\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) nextRingVersion() int { return len(w.rings) }\n\nfunc (w *world) registerPending(r *ring.Ring) {\n\tw.pendingRings[r.Version] = r\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) recordEpoch(r *ring.Ring, tick int64) {\n\tw.pendingRings[r.Version] = r\n\tw.ringSpecs[r.Version] = r.Nodes()\n\tw.epochBegan[r.Version] = tick\n\tw.epochOrder = append(w.epochOrder, r.Version)\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) recordCommit(ver int, produce the same Report.\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\n// World is one simulation run.\ntype world struct {\n\tcfg    Config\n\teng    *Engine\n\tledger *Ledger\n\tctrl   *controller\n\n\t// rings by topology version\n\trings        []*ring.Ring\n\tpendingRings map[int]*ring.Ring\n\tringSpecs epoch lifecycle metadata for the report\n\tepochBegan   map[int]int64\n\tepochCommit  map[int]int64\n\tcommittedEpochs map[int]*epochM // retained for decommission acks\n\tepochOrder   []int\n\n\t// migration accounting\n\tmovements     map[string]*moveTrack // keyed \"ver|key\"\n\tmoveOrder     []string\n\tapplyCounts   map[string]int // \"ver|key\" -> record versions applied at B\n\tapplyBytes    map[string]int // payload bytes applied at B\n\tfinalBytes    map[string]int // bytes of each moved key's final record\n\tmovedKeySet   map[string]bool\n\tdeadNodes     map[string]bool\n\tdeadAt string) string { return fmt.Sprintf(\"%d|%s\", ver, key) }\n\n// Run executes a configuration and returns the JSON-ready report.\nfunc Run(cfg Config) (*Report, error) {\n\tif err := normalizeCfg(&cfg); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw := &world{\n\t\tcfg: cfg,\n\t\tledger: newLedger(),\n\t\tpendingRings: map[int]*ring.Ring{},\n\t\tringSpecs:    map[int][]ring.NodeSpec{},\n\t\tnodes:        map[string]*node{},\n\t\tclients:      map[string]*client{},\n\t\tepochBegan:   map[int]int64{},\n\t\tepochCommit:  map[int]int64{},\n\t\tcommittedEpochs: map[int]*epochM{},\n\t\tmovements:    map[string]*moveTrack{},\n\t\tapplyCounts:  map[string]int{},\n\t\tapplyBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tfinalBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tmovedKeySet:  map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadNodes:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadAt:       map[string]int64{},\n\t}\n\tw.eng = newEngine(cfg.Seed, &Stats{})\n\tw.eng.onDeliver = nil\n\n\t// Ring 0\n\tspecs := make([]ring.NodeSpec, len(cfg.InitialNodes))\n\tfor i, n := range cfg.InitialNodes {\n\t\tspecs[i] = ring.NodeSpec{ID: n.ID, Weight: n.Weight}\n\t}\n\tr0, err := ring.New(0, specs, cfg.VNodes)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw.rings = []*ring.Ring{r0}\n\tw.ringSpecs[0] = r0.Nodes()\n\tw.epochOrder = []int{0}\n\n\tw.ctrl = newController(w)\n\tw.eng.register(w.ctrl)\n\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, ctrlID)\n\n\tfor _, s := range r0.Nodes() {\n\t\tn := newNode(s.ID, r0, w)\n\t\tw.nodes[s.ID] = n\n\t\tw.eng.register(n)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, n.id)\n\t}\n\tfor _, cc := range cfg.Clients {\n\t\tcl := newClient(cc, w)\n\t\tw.clients[cc.ID] = cl\n\t\tw.eng.register(cl)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, cl.id)\n\t}\n\n\t// Initial epoch 0 view in the report (committed at tick 0).\n\tw.epochBegan[0] = 0\n\tw.epochCommit[0] = 0\n\n\t// Timed operations.\n\tlastTick := 0\n\tfor _, op := range cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Tick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.Tick\n\t\t}\n\t\tif op.Kind == \"interrupt\" && op.EndTick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.EndTick\n\t\t}\n\t\tw.scheduleOp(op)\n\t}\n\tstopTick := cfg.StopTick\n\tif stopTick == 0 {\n\t\tstopTick = lastTick + cfg.DrainTicks\n\t}\n\tw.eng.after(int64(stopTick), w.ctrl, \"noop\", nil) // not used; kept for clarity\n\n\tw.eng.run(int64(stopTick))\n\n\treturn w.buildReport(stopTick), nil\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) scheduleOp(op OpCfg) {\n\tswitch op.Kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tspecs := make([]NodeCfg, len(op.Add))\n\t\tcopy(specs, op.Add)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"scaleOut\", specs)\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tids := make([]string, len(op.Remove))\n\t\tcopy(ids, op.Remove)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, nil)\n\tdefault:\n\t\tpanic(\"unknown operation kind: \" + op.Kind)\n\t}\n}\n\n// controller noop + operation entry points: operations arrive as controller\n// timers so ordering relative to messages is deterministic.\nfunc init() {}\n\nfunc (c *controller) handleOp(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleOut(data.([]NodeCfg), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleIn(data.([]string), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"blackholeOn\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(true, int64(data.(int)))\n\tcase \"blackholeOff\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(false, cfg.MinLinkDelay + 2\n\t}\n\tif cfg.RetryTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.RetryTicks = 20\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MigrationConcurrency <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.MigrationConcurrency = 8\n\t}\n\tif cfg.BarrierTicks <= 0 >= 1 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network rates must be in [0,1)\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Validate operations against topology at declaration time where possible.\n\tpresent := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _,
