normalizeCfg(&cfg); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw := &world{\n\t\tcfg: cfg,\n\t\tledger: newLedger(),\n\t\tpendingRings: map[int]*ring.Ring{},\n\t\tringSpecs:    map[int][]ring.NodeSpec{},\n\t\tnodes:        map[string]*node{},\n\t\tclients:      map[string]*client{},\n\t\tepochBegan:   map[int]int64{},\n\t\tepochCommit:  map[int]int64{},\n\t\tcommittedEpochs: map[int]*epochM{},\n\t\tmovements:    map[string]*moveTrack{},\n\t\tapplyCounts:  map[string]int{},\n\t\tapplyBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tfinalBytes:   map[string]int{},\n\t\tmovedKeySet:  map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadNodes:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tdeadAt:       map[string]int64{},\n\t}\n\tw.eng = newEngine(cfg.Seed, &Stats{})\n\tw.eng.onDeliver = nil\n\n\t// Ring 0\n\tspecs := make([]ring.NodeSpec, len(cfg.InitialNodes))\n\tfor i, n := range cfg.InitialNodes {\n\t\tspecs[i] = ring.NodeSpec{ID: n.ID, Weight: n.Weight}\n\t}\n\tr0, err := ring.New(0, specs, cfg.VNodes)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tw.rings = []*ring.Ring{r0}\n\tw.ringSpecs[0] = r0.Nodes()\n\tw.epochOrder = []int{0}\n\n\tw.ctrl = newController(w)\n\tw.eng.register(w.ctrl)\n\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, ctrlID)\n\n\tfor _, s := range r0.Nodes() {\n\t\tn := newNode(s.ID, r0, w)\n\t\tw.nodes[s.ID] = n\n\t\tw.eng.register(n)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, n.id)\n\t}\n\tfor _, cc := range cfg.Clients {\n\t\tcl := newClient(cc, w)\n\t\tw.clients[cc.ID] = cl\n\t\tw.eng.register(cl)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, cl.id)\n\t}\n\n\t// Initial epoch 0 view in the report (committed at tick 0).\n\tw.epochBegan[0] = 0\n\tw.epochCommit[0] = 0\n\n\t// Timed operations.\n\tlastTick := 0\n\tfor _, op := range cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Tick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.Tick\n\t\t}\n\t\tif op.Kind == \"interrupt\" && op.EndTick > lastTick {\n\t\t\tlastTick = op.EndTick\n\t\t}\n\t\tw.scheduleOp(op)\n\t}\n\tstopTick := cfg.StopTick\n\tif stopTick == 0 {\n\t\tstopTick = lastTick + cfg.DrainTicks\n\t}\n\tw.eng.after(int64(stopTick), w.ctrl, \"noop\", nil) // not used; kept for clarity\n\n\tw.eng.run(int64(stopTick))\n\n\treturn w.buildReport(stopTick), nil\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) scheduleOp(op OpCfg) {\n\tswitch op.Kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tspecs := make([]NodeCfg, len(op.Add))\n\t\tcopy(specs, op.Add)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"scaleOut\", specs)\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tids := make([]string, len(op.Remove))\n\t\tcopy(ids, op.Remove)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"scaleIn\", ids)\n\tcase \"interrupt\":\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.Tick), w.ctrl, \"blackholeOn\", op.EndTick)\n\t\tw.eng.after(int64(op.EndTick), w.ctrl, \"blackholeOff\", nil)\n\tdefault:\n\t\tpanic(\"unknown operation kind: \" + op.Kind)\n\t}\n}\n\n// controller noop + operation entry points: operations arrive as controller\n// timers so ordering relative to messages is deterministic.\nfunc init() {}\n\nfunc (c *controller) handleOp(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleOut(data.([]NodeCfg), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\tc.beginScaleIn(data.([]string), c.eng.tick())\n\tcase \"blackholeOn\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(true, int64(data.(int)))\n\tcase \"blackholeOff\":\n\t\tc.eng.setBlackhole(false, 0)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- config normalization -----------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc normalizeCfg(cfg *Config) error {\n\tif len(cfg.InitialNodes) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"initialNodes required\")\n\t}\n\tif len(cfg.Keys) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"keys required\")\n\t}\n\tif len(cfg.Clients) == 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"at least one client required\")\n\t}\n\tif cfg.VNodes <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.VNodes = 64\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MinLinkDelay <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.MinLinkDelay = 1\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MaxLinkDelay < cfg.MinLinkDelay {\n\t\tcfg.MaxLinkDelay = cfg.MinLinkDelay + 2\n\t}\n\tif cfg.RetryTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.RetryTicks = 20\n\t}\n\tif cfg.MigrationConcurrency <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.MigrationConcurrency = 8\n\t}\n\tif cfg.BarrierTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.BarrierTicks = 30\n\t}\n\tif cfg.DrainTicks <= 0 {\n\t\tcfg.DrainTicks = 400\n\t}\n\tfor _, r := range []*float64{&cfg.LossRate, &cfg.DuplicateRate, &cfg.ReorderRate} {\n\t\tif *r < 0 || *r >= 1 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network rates must be in [0,1)\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Validate operations against topology at declaration time where possible.\n\tpresent := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, n := range cfg.InitialNodes {\n\t\tif n.Weight <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q weight must be positive\", n.ID)\n\t\t}\n\t\tpresent[n.ID] = true\n\t}\n\tprevTick := -1\n\tfor _, op := range cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Tick < prevTick {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"operations must be ordered by tick\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tprevTick = op.Tick\n\t\tswitch op.Kind {\n\t\tcase \"scaleOut\":\n\t\t\tif len(op.Add) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleOut requires add nodes\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor _, a := range op.Add {\n\t\t\t\tif present[a.ID] {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleOut node already present: %s\", a.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tpresent[a.ID] = true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"scaleIn\":\n\t\t\tfor _, id := range op.Remove {\n\t\t\t\tif !present[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleIn node not present: %s\", id)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tdelete(present, id)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif len(present) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"scaleIn would remove every node\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"interrupt\":\n\t\t\tif op.EndTick <= op.Tick {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"interrupt endTick must exceed tick\")\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"unknown operation kind: %s\", op.Kind)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// Client windows.\n\tfor i := range cfg.Clients {\n\t\tif cfg.Clients[i].Writes <= 0 {\n\t\t\tcfg.Clients[i].Writes = 50\n\t\t}\n\t\tif cfg.Clients[i].EndTick <= cfg.Clients[i].StartTick {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"client %s endTick must exceed startTick\", cfg.Clients[i].ID)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// ---- world services used by actors --------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (w *world) newSeq() int64 {\n\tw.seqCounter++\n\treturn w.seqCounter\n}\n\n// clientRNG derives a dedicated workload RNG per client from the master seed.\nfunc (w *world) clientRNG(id string) *rand.Rand {\n\th := fnvMix(uint64(w.cfg.Seed) ^ fnvStringHash(id))\n\treturn rand.New(rand.NewSource(int64(h)))\n}\n\n// keyFor maps a client plan slot to a key deterministically.\nfunc (w *world) keyFor(clientID string, planIdx int) string {\n\tn := len(w.cfg.Keys)\n\th := fnvMix(fnvStringHash(clientID) ^ uint64(planIdx)*0x9e3779b97f4a7c15)\n\treturn w.cfg.Keys[int(h%uint64(n))]\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) maxClientAttempts() int { return 40 }\n\nfunc (w *world) nodeSpecs(ids []string) []ring.NodeSpec {\n\t// Weight lookup: search the most recent ring containing the id.\n\tweightOf := func(id string) int {\n\t\tfor i := len(w.rings) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range w.rings[i].Nodes() {\n\t\t\t\tif n.ID == id {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn n.Weight\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif p := w.pendingRings[len(w.rings)]; p != nil {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range p.Nodes() {\n\t\t\t\tif n.ID == id {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn n.Weight\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 1\n\t}\n\tout := make([]ring.NodeSpec, 0, len(ids))\n\tfor _, id := range ids {\n\t\tout = append(out, ring.NodeSpec{ID: id, Weight: weightOf(id)})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) allActorIDs() []string {\n\tout := make([]string, 0, len(w.actorOrder))\n\tout = append(out, w.actorOrder...)\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) nextRingVersion() int { return len(w.rings) }\n\nfunc (w *world) registerPending(r *ring.Ring) {\n\tw.pendingRings[r.Version] = r\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) recordEpoch(r *ring.Ring, tick int64) {\n\tw.pendingRings[r.Version] = r\n\tw.ringSpecs[r.Version] = r.Nodes()\n\tw.epochBegan[r.Version] = tick\n\tw.epochOrder = append(w.epochOrder, r.Version)\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) recordCommit(ver int, tick int64) { w.epochCommit[ver] = tick }\n\nfunc (w *world) onRingCommitted(ver int) {\n\tr := w.pendingRings[ver]\n\tif r == nil {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tw.rings = append(w.rings, r)\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) ringByVersion(ver int) *ring.Ring {\n\tif ver < len(w.rings) {\n\t\treturn w.rings[ver]\n\t}\n\treturn w.pendingRings[ver]\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) authoritativeRing() *ring.Ring { return w.rings[len(w.rings)-1] }\n\n// ---- migration accounting -------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (w *world) onMigrationBegan(key string, ver int, from, to string, tick int64) {\n\tmk := moveKey(ver, key)\n\tif _, ok := w.movements[mk]; ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tw.movements[mk] = &moveTrack{key: key, from: from, to: to, version: ver, beganAt: tick}\n\tw.moveOrder = append(w.moveOrder, mk)\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) onKeySwitched(key string, ver int, tick int64) {\n\tmk := moveKey(ver, key)\n\tif mt := w.movements[mk]; mt != nil {\n\t\tmt.switchedAt = tick\n\t}\n}\n\n// onMigrateTransfer counts bytes injected into the network by A's stream.\nfunc (w *world) onMigrateTransfer(kind, key string, valueLen int) {\n\t// Bytes actually moved are counted at apply time on B; network-level bytes\n\t// are already reflected in Stats.BytesDelivered.\n\t_ = kind\n\t_ = key\n\t_ = valueLen\n}\n\n// onMigrateApply counts one record version applied at the new owner.\nfunc (w *world) onMigrateApply(key string, ver int, valueLen int) {\n\t// Attribute to the in-flight epoch (the newest pending one covering the key).\n\tepoch := -1\n\tfor v := len(w.rings); ; v++ {\n\t\tif _, ok := w.pendingRings[v]; ok {\n\t\t\tepoch = v\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif epoch < 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tmk := moveKey(epoch, key)\n\tif _, ok := w.movements[mk]; !ok {\n\t\t// Defensive: applies can precede bookkeeping under message reordering.\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tw.applyCounts[mk]++\n\tw.applyBytes[mk] += valueLen\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) onNodeDecommissioned(n *node) {\n\tw.eng.dead[n.id] = true\n\tw.deadNodes[n.rraw] = true\n\tw.deadAt[n.rraw] = w.eng.tick()\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) abortEpoch(ep *epochM, reason string) {\n\tw.aborts = append(w.aborts, reason)\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) allDecommissioned(ver int, removed []string) {\n\t// Final post-removal safety check is performed in verification; record the\n\t// set here so the report includes it.\n}\n\n// ---- removal gate ----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// removalGate proves that committing a scale-in loses no latest record.\n// Returns (\"\", true) when safe.\nfunc (w *world) removalGate(ep *epochM) (string, bool) {\n\tremoved := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range ep.removed {\n\t\tremoved[id] = true\n\t}\n\tsurvive := ep.ring\n\tfor _, key := range w.cfg.Keys {\n\t\t// Every key moving in this epoch must have crossed its barrier.\n\t\tif !ep.switchDone[key] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s barrier not complete\", key), false\n\t\t}\n\t\trec, ok := w.ledger.latestRecord(key)\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tlatestNode := rawNode(rec.Node)\n\t\tif removed[latestNode] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"latest version of key %s is only on removed node %s\", key, latestNode), false\n\t\t}\n\t\t// The surviving owner must physically hold the latest record.\n\t\townerNode := w.nodes[survive.Owner(key)]\n\t\tif ownerNode == nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s owner %s missing\", key, survive.Owner(key)), false\n\t\t}\n\t\tstored := ownerNode.store[key]\n\t\tif stored.Ver != rec.Ver || stored.Value != rec.Value {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s not current on surviving owner %s\", key, survive.Owner(key)), false\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn \"\", true\n}\n\n// ---- report + verification --------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (w *world) buildReport(stopTick int) *Report {\n\tstats := *w.eng.stats\n\trep := &Report{\n\t\tSeed:         w.cfg.Seed,\n\t\tStopTick:     stopTick,\n\t\tRemovedNodes: sortedKeys(w.deadNodes),\n\t\tStats:        stats,\n\t}\n\n\t// Final ring view.\n\tfinal := w.authoritativeRing()\n\tfor _, s := range final.Nodes() {\n\t\tnv := NodeView{ID: s.ID, Weight: s.Weight, Keys: []string{}}\n\t\tif n := w.nodes[s.ID]; n != nil && !w.deadNodes[s.ID] {\n\t\t\tks := n.storedKeys()\n\t\t\tsort.Strings(ks)\n\t\t\tnv.Keys = ks\n\t\t}\n\t\trep.FinalRing = append(rep.FinalRing, nv)\n\t}\n\n\t// Epochs.\n\tsort.Ints(w.epochOrder)\n\tfor _, v := range w.epochOrder {\n\t\tvar nodes []string\n\t\tspecs := w.ringSpecs[v]\n\t\tif specs == nil {\n\t\t\tif r := w.ringByVersion(v); r != nil {\n\t\t\t\tfor _, n := range r.Nodes() {\n\t\t\t\t\tnodes = append(nodes, n.ID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tfor _, n := range specs {\n\t\t\t\tnodes = append(nodes, n.ID)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\trep.TopologyEpochs = append(rep.TopologyEpochs, EpochView{\n\t\t\tVersion: v, Nodes: nodes,\n\t\t\tBeganAt: int(w.epochBegan[v]), CommitAt: int(w.epochCommit[v]),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\n\t// Interruption view.\n\tfor _, op := range w.cfg.Operations {\n\t\tif op.Kind == \"interrupt\" {\n\t\t\trep.Interruption = &InterruptionView{StartTick: op.Tick, EndTick: op.EndTick}\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tw.fillMigration(rep)\n\tw.verify(rep)\n\treturn rep\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) fillMigration(rep *Report) {\n\t// Movements in deterministic order.\n\tkeysMoved := 0\n\ttotalRecs, totalBytes, minimalBytes := 0, 0, 0\n\tfor _, mk := range w.moveOrder {\n\t\tmt := w.movements[mk]\n\t\tif mt.switchedAt == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue // interrupted/unfinished migrations are not counted as moved\n\t\t}\n\t\tkeysMoved++\n\t\tw.movedKeySet[mt.key] = true\n\t\trecs := w.applyCounts[mk]\n\t\tbytes := w.applyBytes[mk]\n\t\ttotalRecs += recs\n\t\ttotalBytes += bytes\n\t\t// Minimal bytes = final record payload length for the moved key.\n\t\trec, ok := w.ledger.latestRecord(mt.key)\n\t\tif ok {\n\t\t\tminimalBytes += len(rec.Value)\n\t\t}\n\t\trep.Migration.Movements = append(rep.Migration.Movements, MovementView{\n\t\t\tKey: mt.key, From: mt.from, To: mt.to, Version: mt.version,\n\t\t\tBeganAt: int(mt.beganAt), SwitchedAt: int(mt.switchedAt),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\trep.Migration.KeysMoved = keysMoved\n\trep.Migration.RecordVersionsTransferred = totalRecs\n\trep.Migration.BytesTransferred = totalBytes\n\trep.Migration.BytesMoved = minimalBytes\n\trep.Migration.OverheadBytes = totalBytes - minimalBytes\n\tif rep.Migration.OverheadBytes < 0 {\n\t\trep.Migration.OverheadBytes = 0\n\t}\n\trep.Migration.BarriersPassed = keysMoved\n}\n\nfunc (w *world) verify(rep *Report) {\n\trep.Verifications.Ownership = w.checkOwnership()\n\trep.Verifications.Version = w.checkVersion()\n\trep.Verifications.ConfirmedWritesSurvive = w.checkConfirmedSurvive()\n\trep.Verifications.RemovalSafety = w.checkRemovalSafety()\n\trep.Verifications.NoStaleReadAccepted = w.checkReads()\n}\n\nfunc check(name string, offenses []string, detail string) CheckResult {\n\tcr := CheckResult{Name: name, Pass: len(offenses) == 0, Details: detail}\n\tif len(offenses) > 10 {\n\t\tcr.Offenses = offenses[:10]\n\t} else {\n\t\tcr.Offenses = offenses\n\t}\n\treturn cr\n}\n\n// checkOwnership: final authoritative owner physically stores each key, and no\n// other live node stores a newer record (RF-1: one authoritative location).\nfunc (w *world) checkOwnership() CheckResult {\n\tfinal := w.authoritativeRing()\n\tvar off []string\n\tfor _, key := range w.cfg.Keys {\n\t\towner := final.Owner(key)\n\t\ton := w.nodes[owner]\n\t\tif on == nil || w.deadNodes[owner] {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s owner %s is not live\", key, owner))\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif _, ok := on.store[key]; !ok {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s missing on owner %s\", key, owner))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"ownership\", off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%d keys, owner %s ring v%d\", len(w.cfg.Keys), \"=\", final.Version))\n}\n\n// checkVersion: the record at each key's owner equals the ledger's latest\n// applied record (single correct version + value).\nfunc (w *world) checkVersion() CheckResult {\n\tfinal := w.authoritativeRing()\n\tvar off []string\n\tfor _, key := range w.cfg.Keys {\n\t\tlatest, ok := w.ledger.latestRecord(key)\n\t\ton := w.nodes[final.Owner(key)]\n\t\tif on == nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue // reported by ownership check\n\t\t}\n\t\tstored := on.store[key]\n\t\tif ok {\n\t\t\tif stored.Ver != latest.Ver || stored.Value != latest.Value {\n\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s owner holds v%d=%q, truth v%d=%q\",\n\t\t\t\t\tkey, stored.Ver, stored.Value, latest.Ver, latest.Value))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else if stored.Ver != 0 {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s has store v%d but no applied truth\", key, stored.Ver))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"version\", off, \"owner record must equal latest applied record for every key\")\n}\n\n// checkConfirmedSurvive: every acked write is present at the final owner at its\n// version (a later version on the same chain is also acceptable).\nfunc (w *world) checkConfirmedSurvive() CheckResult {\n\tfinal := w.authoritativeRing()\n\tvar off []string\n\tfor _, cw := range w.ledger.confirmedList() {\n\t\ton := w.nodes[final.Owner(cw.Key)]\n\t\tif on == nil {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"confirmed %s v%d: owner missing\", cw.Key, cw.Ver))\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tstored := on.store[cw.Key]\n\t\tif stored.Ver < cw.Ver {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"confirmed %s v%d lost: owner has v%d\", cw.Key, cw.Ver, stored.Ver))\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// If the exact version is present, value must match (single winner).\n\t\tif recs := w.ledger.applied[cw.Key]; recs != nil {\n\t\t\tif rec, ok := recs[cw.Ver]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tif rec.Value != cw.Value {\n\t\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"confirmed %s v%d value mismatch\", cw.Key, cw.Ver))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"confirmedWritesSurvive\", off,\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%d confirmed writes verified at final owners\", len(w.ledger.confirmed)))\n}\n\n// checkRemovalSafety: after decommission, no key's latest record lives solely\n// on a removed (dead) node.\nfunc (w *world) checkRemovalSafety() CheckResult {\n\tfinal := w.authoritativeRing()\n\tvar off []string\n\tif len(w.deadNodes) > 0 {\n\t\tfor _, key := range w.cfg.Keys {\n\t\t\towner := final.Owner(key)\n\t\t\tif w.deadNodes[owner] {\n\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s final owner %s was removed\", key, owner))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\trec, ok := w.ledger.latestRecord(key)\n\t\t\tif ok && w.deadNodes[rawNode(rec.Node)] {\n\t\t\t\t// latest apply on a dead node: must also exist on a live owner\n\t\t\t\ton := w.nodes[owner]\n\t\t\t\tif on == nil || on.store[key].Ver < rec.Ver {\n\t\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"key %s latest v%d exists only on removed node\", key, rec.Ver))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"removalSafety\", off,\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%d nodes removed; decommission gate plus post-check\", len(w.deadNodes)))\n}\n\n// checkReads: no successful read returned a version older than the highest\n// version confirmed at the time the read was issued.\nfunc (w *world) checkReads() CheckResult {\n\tvar off []string\n\tchecked := 0\n\tfor _, r := range w.ledger.reads {\n\t\tif !r.Success {"parentUuid":"d04d8e40-0c29-46e9-8cfe-e08cd6c05f75","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/controller.go","snippet":"1\tpackage sim\n2\t\n3\timport (\n4\t\t\"sort\"\n5\t\n6\t\t\"chmig/ring\"\n7\t)\n8\t\n9\tconst ctrlID = \"ctrl\"\n10\t\n11\t// epochM tracks the lifecycle of one topology epoch under migration.\n12\ttype epochM struct {\n13\t\tversion    int\n14\t\tring       *ring.Ring\n15\t\tbeganAt    int64\n16\t\tmovingKeys []string\n17\t\tswitchDone map[string]bool\n18\t\tbarrierSent map[string]bool\n19\t\t// announce/commit reliable-delivery tracking\n20\t\tannAcked   map[string]bool\n21\t\tcommitAcked map[string]bool\n22\t\tcommitted  bool\n23\t\tremoved    []string // nodes removed in this epoch (scale in)\n24\t\tdecomAcked map[string]bool\n25\t}\n26\t\n27\t// controller is the (in-process, simulated) migration orchestrator.\n28\ttype controller struct {\n29\t\taid string\n30\t\teng *Engine\n31\t\tw   *world\n32\t\n33\t\t// pending topology epochs in version order; head is the active migration.\n34\t\tepochs []*epochM\n35\t}\n36\t\n37\tfunc newController(w *world) *controller {\n38\t\treturn &controller{aid: ctrlID, eng: w.eng, w: w}\n39\t}\n40\t\n41\tfunc (c *controller) id() string { return c.aid }\n42\t\n43\tfunc (c *controller) receive(m *Msg) {\n44\t\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n45\t\tcase *TopologyAck:\n46\t\t\tc.onAnnounceAck(m, b)\n47\t\tcase *CommitAck:\n48\t\t\tc.onCommitAck(m, b)\n49\t\tcase *BarrierDone:\n50\t\t\tc.onBarrierDone(m, b)\n51\t\tcase *DecommissionAck:\n52\t\t\tc.onDecomAck(m, b)\n53\t\t}\n54\t}\n55\t\n56\tfunc (c *controller) timer(kind string, data any) {\n57\t\tswitch kind {\n58\t\tcase \"scaleOut\", \"scaleIn\", \"blackholeOn\", \"blackholeOff\":\n59\t\t\tc.handleOp(kind, data)\n60\t\tcase \"resendAnnounce\":\n61\t\t\tc.resendAnnounce(data.(int))\n62\t\tcase \"startBarrier\":\n63\t\t\tc.sendBarrier(data.(barKey))\n64\t\tcase \"beginKey\":\n65\t\t\titem := data.(migrationTarget)\n66\t\t\tc.beginKey(item.ver, item.from, item.key)\n67\t\tcase \"resendBarrier\":\n68\t\t\tc.resendBarrier(data.(string))\n69\t\tcase \"commit\":\n70\t\t\tc.sendCommit(data.(int))\n71\t\tcase \"resendCommit\":\n72\t\t\tc.resendCommit(data.(int))\n73\t\tcase \"decom\":\n74\t\t\tc.resendDecom(data.(int))\n75\t\t}\n76\t}\n77\t\n78\t// ---- timed operations ----------------------------------------------------------\n79\t\n80\t// beginScaleOut builds the next ring with added nodes and starts migration.\n81\tfunc (c *controller) beginScaleOut(add []NodeSpec, tick int64) {\n82\t\tspecs := append(c.currentSpecs(), add...)\n83\t\tnextVer := c.w.nextRingVersion()\n84\t\tr, err := ring.New(nextVer, specs, c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n85\t\tif err != nil {\n86\t\t\tpanic(err)\n87\t\t}\n88\t\tc.startEpoch(r, nil, tick)\n89\t}\n90\t\n91\t// beginScaleIn builds the next ring without removed nodes. Removal is gated:\n92\t// the epoch can only commit once every key the removed nodes owned has crossed\n93\t// a barrier onto a surviving node.\n94\tfunc (c *controller) beginScaleIn(remove []string, tick int64) {\n95\t\tcur := c.authoritativeRing()\n96\t\tspecs := make([]ring.NodeSpec, 0)\n97\t\trm := map[string]bool{}\n98\t\tfor _, id := range remove {\n99\t\t\trm[id] = true\n100\t\t}\n101\t\tfor _, n := range cur.Nodes() {\n102\t\t\tif !rm[n.ID] {\n103\t\t\t\tspecs = append(specs, n)\n104\t\t\t}\n105\t\t}\n106\t\tif len(specs) == 0 {\n107\t\t\tpanic(\"scaleIn would remove every node\")\n108\t\t}\n109\t\tnextVer := c.w.nextRingVersion()\n110\t\tr, err := ring.New(nextVer, specs, c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n111\t\tif err != nil {\n112\t\t\tpanic(err)\n113\t\t}\n114\t\tc.startEpoch(r, remove, tick)\n115\t}\n116\t\n117\t// startEpoch publishes a pending ring and kicks off per-key migration streams.\n118\tfunc (c *controller) startEpoch(next *ring.Ring, removed []string, tick int64) {\n119\t\tprev := c.authoritativeRing()\n120\t\tmovements := prev.Diff(next, c.w.cfg.Keys)\n121\t\tmoving := make([]string, 0)\n122\t\tfor _, mv := range movements {\n123\t\t\tif mv.Migrates {\n124\t\t\t\tmoving = append(moving, mv.Key)\n125\t\t\t}\n126\t\t}\n127\t\tsort.Strings(moving)\n128\t\n129\t\t// Epoch view for the report.\n130\t\tc.w.recordEpoch(next, tick)\n131\t\n132\t\tep := &epochM{\n133\t\t\tversion: next.Version, ring: next, beganAt: tick, movingKeys: moving,\n134\t\t\tswitchDone: map[string]bool{}, barrierSent: map[string]bool{},\n135\t\t\tannAcked: map[string]bool{}, commitAcked: map[string]bool{},\n136\t\t\tremoved: removed, decomAcked: map[string]bool{},\n137\t\t}\n138\t\tc.epochs = append(c.epochs, ep)\n139\t\tc.w.registerPending(next)\n140\t\n141\t\t// Reliable pending-ring announcement to every node and client.\n142\t\tc.publishAnnounce(ep, true)\n143\t\n144\t\t// Drive migration: only the head epoch proceeds; concurrent epochs queue.\n145\t\tif c.epochs[0] == ep {\n146\t\t\tc.driveEpoch(ep)\n147\t\t}\n148\t}\n149\t\n150\t// driveEpoch opens migration streams for the moving keys (bounded concurrency\n151\t// from one old owner) and schedules each key's switch barrier.\n152\tfunc (c *controller) driveEpoch(ep *epochM) {\n153\t\tprev := c.previousRingFor(ep.version)\n154\t\t// Deterministic key order: group by (from, key).\n155\t\ttype kv struct{ from, key string }\n156\t\tlist := make([]kv, 0, len(ep.movingKeys))\n157\t\tfor _, k := range ep.movingKeys {\n158\t\t\tlist = append(list, kv{prev.Owner(k), k})\n159\t\t}\n160\t\tsort.Slice(list, func(i, j int) bool {\n161\t\t\tif list[i].from != list[j].from {\n162\t\t\t\treturn list[i].from < list[j].from\n163\t\t\t}\n164\t\t\treturn list[i].key < list[j].key\n165\t\t})\n166\t\tmaxC := c.w.cfg.MigrationConcurrency\n167\t\tfor idx, item := range list {\n168\t\t\tstagger := int64(0)\n169\t\t\tif maxC > 0 {\n170\t\t\t\t// Deterministic staggered start to respect per-source concurrency.\n171\t\t\t\tstagger = int64((idx / maxC) * 2)\n172\t\t\t}\n173\t\t\ttarget := migrationTarget{ver: ep.version, from: item.from, key: item.key}\n174\t\t\tif stagger == 0 {\n175\t\t\t\tc.beginKey(target.ver, target.from, target.key)\n176\t\t\t} else {\n177\t\t\t\tc.eng.after(stagger, c, \"beginKey\", target)\n178\t\t\t}\n179\t\t}\n180\t}\n181\t\n182\ttype migrationTarget struct {\n183\t\tver      int\n184\t\tfrom     string\n185\t\tkey      string\n186\t}\n187\t\n188\tfunc (c *controller) beginKey(ver int, from, key string) {\n189\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"StartMigration\", From: c.id, To: nodeID(from),\n190\t\t\tSeq: c.w.newSeq(), Body: &StartMigration{Key: key, RingVer: ver}})\n191\t\t// Barrier schedule: deterministic window after BEGIN. slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\tBody: &WriteReq{Key: inf.key, Value: inf.value, ReqID: inf.reqID}})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onWriteAck(a *WriteAck) {\n\tinf := c.inflight[a.ReqID]\n\tif inf == nil {\n\t\treturn // the new owner only once it is known to serve; otherwise keep\n193\t\t\t// hitting the current owner and follow its redirects.\n194\t\t}\n195\t\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n196\t\tinf.tid = Pre-existing nodes are left untouched.\nfunc (w *world) instantiateNodes(next *ring.Ring) {\n\tfor _, s := range next.Nodes() {\n\t\tif w.nodes[s.ID] != nil {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn := &node{\n\t\t\trraw: s.ID, aid: nodeID(s.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\t\t// current stays the last committed ring (it contains the OLD owners\n\t\t\t// this node needs when answering a barrier); pending is the new ring.\n\t\t\tcurrent: w.authoritativeRing(),\n\t\t\tpending: next,\n\t\t\tstore:   map[string]Record{},\n\t\t\tidem:    map[string]map[string]int{},\n\t\t\tout:     map[string]*outState{},\n\t\t\tin:      map[string]*inState{},\n\t\t\tvnodes:  w.cfg.VNodes,\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.rel = newReliable(w.eng, n, int64(w.cfg.RetryTicks))\n\t\tw.nodes[s.ID] = n\n\t\tw.eng.register(n)\n\t\tw.actorOrder = append(w.actorOrder, n.aid)\n\t}\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_906e568f31f444e5d1974e8c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":247,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":101176,"output_tokens":615,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_1i3nflinz01uj4bgpsbcicuz":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/world.go","new_string":"func (w *world) registerPending(r *ring.Ring) {\n\tw.pendingRings[r.Version] = r // keyed by unique version; no overwrite\n}\n\n// instantiateNodes creates actor instances for nodes newly introduced by a\n// scale-out epoch, registers them with the engine and adds them to the\n// announcement fan-out. Record payloads use the value length;\n// control messages use a small fixed header cost.\nfunc (m *Msg) Size() int {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *WriteReq:\n\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\treturn 40\n\tcase *ReadReq:\n\t\treturn 16\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tif b.Found {\n\t\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigBegin:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigSnapshot:\n\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *MigForward:\n\t\treturn 40 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *MigAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigBarrier:\n\t\treturn 28\n\tcase *MigBarrierAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *StartMigration:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *StartBarrier:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *BarrierDone:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\treturn 64 + len(b.Nodes)*16\n\tcase *TopologyAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\treturn 32\n\tcase *CommitAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\treturn 16\n\t}\n\treturn 16\n}\n\n// ---- client <-> node: writes -------------------------------------------------\n\n// WriteReq carries a client write. ReqID is globally unique; nodes apply an\n// idempotency table on it, so retries or duplicate delivery never apply twice.\ntype WriteReq struct {\n\tKey    string\n\tValue  string\n\tReqID  string\n}\n\n// WriteAck is the single-version decision. Ver is the key's monotonically\n// increasing version assigned by the current coordinator.\ntype WriteAck struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tReqID   string\n\tVer     int\n\tValue   string\n\tRedirect string // non-empty: write was rejected pre-barrier, retry on node\n}\n\n// ---- client <-> node: reads --------------------------------------------------\n\ntype ReadReq struct {\n\tRID string\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ReadResp is an individual node's answer. During dual-read the client takes\n// the answer with the greatest Ver — the single-version arbiter.\ntype ReadResp struct {\n\tRID   string\n\tKey   string\n\tFound bool\n\tVer   int\n\tValue string\n}\n\n// ---- node A (old owner) <-> node B (new owner) -------------------------------\n\n// MigBegin opens the per-key migration stream.\ntype MigBegin struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tRingVer   int\n\tNextVer   int // expected per-key apply seq of the first forwarded write\n}\n\n// MigSnapshot ships the record visible on A at the moment migration starts,\n// together with A's idempotency table for the key, so B can deduplicate client\n// retries that arrive after the switch.\ntype MigSnapshot struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tVer       int\n\tValue     string\n\tIdempotents map[string]int // reqID -> applied version\n\tNextVer   int\n}\n\n// MigForward streams every write A applies after the snapshot, in per-key\n// sequence order. SeqNo is the key's apply sequence (snapshot covers < SeqNo).\ntype MigForward struct {\n\tKey    string\n\tSeqNo  int\n\tReqID  string\n\tVer    int\n\tValue  string\n}\n\n// MigAck acknowledges snapshot (SeqNo == snapshot version) or forwards.\ntype MigAck struct {\n\tKey   string\n\tSeqNo int\n}\n\n// MigBarrier is the switch barrier: once B acknowledges it, having applied the\n// snapshot and every forwarded write, the key is safe to serve from B.\n// UpTo is the per-key stream sequence of the last write A will forward; B only\n// completes the barrier after applying through UpTo contiguously.\ntype MigBarrier struct {\n\tKey  string\n\tUpTo int\n}\n\ntype MigBarrierAck struct {\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ---- controller -> nodes: migration drive ------------------------------------\n\n// StartMigration tells the old owner to open the per-key migration stream.\ntype StartMigration struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// StartBarrier tells the old owner to freeze and issue the switch barrier.\ntype StartBarrier struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// BarrierDone is the new (or old) owner's report that a key's barrier passed.\ntype BarrierDone struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// DecommissionAck confirms a removed node has shut down.\ntype DecommissionAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// ---- controller <-> nodes/clients -------------------------------------------\n\n// TopologyAnnounce reliably publishes a pending or committed ring.\ntype TopologyAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n\tNodes   []string\n\tPending bool // true: migration in progress, dual-read against old+new\n}\n\ntype TopologyAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// CommitAnnounce finalizes a ring epoch after every key barrier passed.\ntype CommitAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\ntype CommitAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// Decommission tells a removed physical node to shut down. It is only sent\n// after the commit gate proves no latest record is left on the node.\ntype Decommission struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":111,"oldLines":21,"newStart":111,"newLines":23,"lines":[" // together with A's idempotency table for the key, so B can deduplicate client"," // retries that arrive after the switch."," type MigSnapshot struct {","-  Key       string","-  Ver       int","-  Value     string","+  Key         string","+  RingVer     int","+  Ver         int","+  Value       string","   Idempotents map[string]int // reqID -> applied version","-  NextVer   int","+  NextVer     int"," }"," "," // MigForward streams every write A applies after the snapshot, in per-key"," // sequence order. Record payloads use the value length;\n// control messages use a small fixed header cost.\nfunc (m *Msg) Size() int {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *WriteReq:\n\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\treturn 40\n\tcase *ReadReq:\n\t\treturn 16\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tif b.Found {\n\t\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigBegin:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigSnapshot:\n\t\treturn 32 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *MigForward:\n\t\treturn 40 + len(b.Value)\n\tcase *MigAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *MigBarrier:\n\t\treturn 28\n\tcase *MigBarrierAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *StartMigration:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *StartBarrier:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *BarrierDone:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\treturn 64 + len(b.Nodes)*16\n\tcase *TopologyAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\treturn 32\n\tcase *CommitAck:\n\t\treturn 24\n\tcase *Decommission:\n\t\treturn 16\n\t}\n\treturn 16\n}\n\n// ---- client <-> node: writes -------------------------------------------------\n\n// WriteReq carries a client write. ReqID is globally unique; nodes apply an\n// idempotency table on it, so retries or duplicate delivery never apply twice.\ntype WriteReq struct {\n\tKey    string\n\tValue  string\n\tReqID  string\n}\n\n// WriteAck is the single-version decision. Ver is the key's monotonically\n// increasing version assigned by the current coordinator.\ntype WriteAck struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tReqID   string\n\tVer     int\n\tValue   string\n\tRedirect string // non-empty: write was rejected pre-barrier, retry on node\n}\n\n// ---- client <-> node: reads --------------------------------------------------\n\ntype ReadReq struct {\n\tRID string\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ReadResp is an individual node's answer. During dual-read the client takes\n// the answer with the greatest Ver — the single-version arbiter.\ntype ReadResp struct {\n\tRID   string\n\tKey   string\n\tFound bool\n\tVer   int\n\tValue string\n}\n\n// ---- node A (old owner) <-> node B (new owner) -------------------------------\n\n// MigBegin opens the per-key migration stream.\ntype MigBegin struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tRingVer   int\n\tNextVer   int // expected per-key apply seq of the first forwarded write\n}\n\n// MigSnapshot ships the record visible on A at the moment migration starts,\n// together with A's idempotency table for the key, so B can deduplicate client\n// retries that arrive after the switch.\ntype MigSnapshot struct {\n\tKey         string\n\tRingVer     int\n\tVer         int\n\tValue       string\n\tIdempotents map[string]int // reqID -> applied version\n\tNextVer     int\n}\n\n// MigForward streams every write A applies after the snapshot, in per-key\n// sequence order. SeqNo is the key's apply sequence (snapshot covers < SeqNo).\ntype MigForward struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n\tSeqNo   int\n\tReqID   string\n\tVer     int\n\tValue   string\n}\n\n// MigAck acknowledges snapshot (SeqNo == snapshot version) or forwards.\ntype MigAck struct {\n\tKey   string\n\tSeqNo int\n}\n\n// MigBarrier is the switch barrier: once B acknowledges it, having applied the\n// snapshot and every forwarded write, the key is safe to serve from B.\n// UpTo is the per-key stream sequence of the last write A will forward; B only\n// completes the barrier after applying through UpTo contiguously.\ntype MigBarrier struct {\n\tKey  string\n\tUpTo int\n}\n\ntype MigBarrierAck struct {\n\tKey string\n}\n\n// ---- controller -> nodes: migration drive ------------------------------------\n\n// StartMigration tells the old owner to open the per-key migration stream.\ntype StartMigration struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// StartBarrier tells the old owner to freeze and issue the switch barrier.\ntype StartBarrier struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// BarrierDone is the new (or old) owner's report that a key's barrier passed.\ntype BarrierDone struct {\n\tKey     string\n\tRingVer int\n}\n\n// DecommissionAck confirms a removed node has shut down.\ntype DecommissionAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// ---- controller <-> nodes/clients -------------------------------------------\n\n// TopologyAnnounce reliably publishes a pending or committed ring.\ntype TopologyAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n\tNodes   []string\n\tPending bool // true: migration in progress, dual-read against old+new\n}\n\ntype TopologyAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// CommitAnnounce finalizes a ring epoch after every key barrier passed.\ntype CommitAnnounce struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\ntype CommitAck struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n\n// Decommission tells a removed physical node to shut down. It is only sent\n// after the commit gate proves no latest record is left on the node.\ntype Decommission struct {\n\tVersion int\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":132,"oldLines":8,"newStart":132,"newLines":9,"lines":[" "," // MigAck acknowledges snapshot (SeqNo == snapshot version) or forwards."," type MigAck struct {","-  Key   string","-  SeqNo int","+  Key     string","+  RingVer int","+  SeqNo   int"," }"," "," // MigBarrier is the switch barrier: once B acknowledges it, having applied the"]},{"oldStart":141,"oldLines":12,"newStart":142,"newLines":14,"lines":[" // UpTo is the per-key stream sequence of the last write A will forward; B only"," // completes the barrier after applying through UpTo contiguously."," type MigBarrier struct {","-  Key  string","-  UpTo int","+  Key     string","+  RingVer int","+  UpTo    int"," }"," "," type MigBarrierAck struct {","-  Key string","+  Key     string","+  RingVer int"," }"," "," // ---- controller -> nodes: migration drive ------------------------------------"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"66ff6243-3b48-4fab-ad18-6c3eaad21dde","session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}

err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"decode config: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\trep, err := sim.Run(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"simulation: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\tb, err := json.MarshalIndent(rep, \"\", \"  \")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tfmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, \"marshal report: %v\\n\", err)\n\t\tos.Exit(1)\n\t}\n\tb = append(b, '\\n')\n\tif *out == \"\" || *out == \"-\" {\n\t\tos.Stdout.Write(b)\n\t} else {\n\t\tif err := os.WriteFile(*out, b, 0o644); *ReadResp:\n\t\tc.onReadResp(b)\n\t}\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc clientID(raw string) string { return \"client:\" + raw }\n\ntype plannedOp struct {\n\tat    int64\n\twrite bool\n\tidx   int // plan index, used in ReqID/RID\n}\n\n// inflight tracks one outstanding write or read.\ntype inflight struct {\n\tkey      string\n\treqID    string\n\tvalue    string\n\twrite    bool\n\tattempts int\n\tto       string // current target node (internal id)\n\tissueTick int64\n\ttid      int64\n\t// read bookkeeping\n\treadVer int\n\treadVal string\n\treadFound bool\n\tgotResp bool\n}\n\ntype client struct {\n\tcfg  ClientCfg\n\taid  string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\tplan    []plannedOp\n\tinflight map[string]*inflight\n\tmaxRetry int\n}\n\nfunc newClient(cfg ClientCfg, w *world) *client {\n\tc := &client{\n\t\tcfg: cfg, aid: clientID(cfg.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\tcurrent: w.rings[0],\n\t\tinflight: map[string]*inflight{},\n\t\tmaxRetry: w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves generation on ties).\n\tsort.SliceStable(plan, func(i, j int) bool { return plan[i].at < plan[j].at })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.aid }\n\nfunc (c *client) valueFor(planIdx int) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"v:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: c.aid, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(b.Version, c.w.nodeSpecs(b.Nodes), c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.Pending {\n\t\t\tc.pending = r\n\t\t} else if c.current.Version < b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = r\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\tc.onWriteAck(b)\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tc.onReadResp(b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"issue\":\n\t\tp := data.(plannedOp)\n\t\tif p.write {\n\t\t\tc.startWrite(p.idx)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.startRead(p.idx)\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wretry\":\n\t\tc.retryWrite(data.(string))\n\tcase \"rretry\":\n\t\tc.retryRead(data.(string))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- writes -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc operations (scale out, scale\n// in, simulated network interruptions).\ntype Config struct {\n\tSeed          int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int    `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tVNodes        int    `json:\"vnodesPerWeight\"`\n\tLossRate      float64 `json:\"lossRate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicateRate\"`\n\tReorderRate   float64 `json:\"reorderRate\"`\n\t// Min/MaxLinkDelay bound timeout.\n\tRetryTicks int `json:\"retryTicks\"`\n\t// MigrationConcurrency: max keys migrating in parallel from one node.\n\tMigrationConcurrency int `json:\"migrationConcurrency\"`\n\t// BarrierTicks: delay between BEGIN for a key and its switch barrier.\n\tBarrierTicks int `json:\"barrierTicks\"`\n\t// DrainTicks: quiet period after the last scheduled op before stopTick, used\n\t// if StopTick is 0.\n\tDrainTicks int `json:\"drainTicks\"`\n\n\tInitialNodes []NodeCfg `json:\"initialNodes\"`\n\tKeys         []string  `json:\"keys\"`\n\tClients      []ClientCfg `json:\"clients\"`\n\tOperations   []OpCfg   `json:\"operations\"`\n}\n\n// NodeCfg configures one initial physical node.\ntype NodeCfg struct {\n\tID     string `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int    `json:\"weight\"`\n}\n\n// ClientCfg configures one client actor and the write stream it generates.\ntype ClientCfg struct {\n\tID string `json:\"id\"`\n\t// Writes is the total number of writes this client issues.\n\tWrites int `json:\"writes\"`\n\t// StartTick / EndTick bound the uniform spread of issue times.\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n\t// ReadEvery: issue a read every Nth operation slot (0 disables reads).\n\tReadEvery int `json:\"readEvery\"`\n}\n\n// OpCfg is one timed topology / failure operation.\n//\n// Kind:\n//   - \"scaleOut\": Add lists nodes joining the ring.\n//   - \"scaleIn\":  Remove lists nodes leaving; the simulator refuses to remove\n//                  a node until every key it owned has crossed the barrier.\n//   - \"interrupt\": establish a directed network blackhole between all\n//                  migration (node-to-node) traffic during [Tick, EndTick).\n//                  Client/control traffic is unaffected, so the migration\n//                  protocol's retransmission can be observed recovering.\ntype OpCfg struct {\n\tKind     string    `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTick     int       `json:\"tick\"`\n\tEndTick  int       `json:\"endTick\"`  // interrupt only\n\tAdd      []NodeCfg `json:\"add\"`      // scaleOut\n\tRemove   []string  `json:\"remove\"`   // scaleIn\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tSeed          int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int              `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tFinalRing     []NodeView       `json:\"finalRing\"`\n\tRemovedNodes  []string         `json:\"removedNodes\"`\n\tInterruption  *InterruptionView `json:\"interruption,omitempty\"`\n\tTopologyEpochs []EpochView     `json:\"topologyEpochs\"`\n\tStats         Stats            `json:\"stats\"`\n\t// MigrationBytes is the number of key-record payload bytes applied at a\n\t// destination node as part of migration (snapshot/forward stream), summed\n\t// over every migration. Each migrated version is counted once.\n\tMigration      MigrationReport `json:\"migration\"`\n\tVerifications  Verifications    `json:\"verifications\"`\n}\n\n// NodeView is a node's weight and the keys it stores at end of run.\ntype NodeView struct {\n\tID     string   `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int      `json:\"weight\"`\n\tKeys   []string `json:\"keys\"`\n}\n\n// EpochView records one ring epoch and when it became authoritative.\ntype EpochView struct {\n\tVersion  int      `json:\"version\"`\n\tNodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tBeganAt  int      `json:\"beganAt\"`\n\tCommitAt int      `json:\"commitAt,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// InterruptionView records a simulated blackhole window.\ntype InterruptionView struct {\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n}\n\n// Stats holds network and workload counters.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tMessagesSent      int `json:\"messagesSent\"`\n\tMessagesDelivered int `json:\"messagesDelivered\"`\n\tMessagesDropped   int `json:\"messagesDropped\"`\n\tMessagesDuplicated int `json:\"messagesDuplicated\"`\n\tMessagesReordered int `json:\"messagesReordered\"`\n\tBytesDelivered    int `json:\"bytesDelivered\"`\n\tWritesIssued      int `json:\"writesIssued\"`\n\tWritesConfirmed   int `json:\"writesConfirmed\"`\n\tWritesFailed      int `json:\"writesFailed\"` // exhausted retries\n\tReadsIssued       int `json:\"readsIssued\"`\n\tReadsSucceeded    int `json:\"readsSucceeded\"`\n\tReadsFailed       int `json:\"readsFailed\"`\n}\n\n// MigrationReport quantifies the migration.\ntype MigrationReport struct {\n\t// KeysMoved is the number of keys whose owner changed across all epochs.\n\tKeysMoved int `json:\"keysMoved\"`\n\t// RecordVersionsTransferred counts every record version applied at the new\n\t// owner through snapshot/forward streams.\n\tRecordVersionsTransferred int `json:\"recordVersionsTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesTransferred sums payload sizes of the transferred record versions.\n\tBytesTransferred int `json:\"bytesTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesMoved counts each migrated key's final record payload once: the\n\t// minimum data movement the migration cannot avoid.\n\tBytesMoved int `json:\"bytesMoved\"`\n\t// OverheadBytes is BytesTransferred - BytesMoved   `json:\"version\"`\n\tNodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tBeganAt  int      `json:\"beganAt\"`\n\tCommitAt int      `json:\"commitAt\"`\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"encoding/json\"\n\n// Config is the JSON run interface for the simulator.\n//\n// A run is fully described by this structure: the initial weighted topology,\n// the key universe, the deterministic client workload, the lossy network\n// parameters and a timed schedule of topology operations (scale out, scale\n// in, simulated network interruptions).\ntype Config struct {\n\tSeed          int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int    `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tVNodes        int    `json:\"vnodesPerWeight\"`\n\tLossRate      float64 `json:\"lossRate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicateRate\"`\n\tReorderRate   float64 `json:\"reorderRate\"`\n\t// Min/MaxLinkDelay bound the random one-way delivery delay in ticks.\n\tMinLinkDelay int `json:\"minLinkDelay\"`\n\tMaxLinkDelay int `json:\"maxLinkDelay\"`\n\t// RetryTicks: client outstanding request / migration control timeout.\n\tRetryTicks int `json:\"retryTicks\"`\n\t// MigrationConcurrency: max keys migrating in parallel from one node.\n\tMigrationConcurrency int `json:\"migrationConcurrency\"`\n\t// BarrierTicks: delay between BEGIN for a key and its switch barrier.\n\tBarrierTicks int `json:\"barrierTicks\"`\n\t// DrainTicks: quiet period after the last scheduled op before stopTick, used\n\t// if StopTick is 0.\n\tDrainTicks int `json:\"drainTicks\"`\n\n\tInitialNodes []NodeCfg `json:\"initialNodes\"`\n\tKeys         []string  `json:\"keys\"`\n\t// Preload, when true, writes one seed record (\"seed:<key>\") to every key\n\t// on its ring-0 owner at tick 0. It gives every migration real snapshot\n\t// data to move and makes the transferred-volume statistics meaningful.\n\tPreload       bool        `json:\"preload\"`\n\tClients       []ClientCfg `json:\"clients\"`\n\tOperations    []OpCfg     `json:\"operations\"`\n}\n\n// NodeCfg configures one initial physical node.\ntype NodeCfg struct {\n\tID     string `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int    `json:\"weight\"`\n}\n\n// ClientCfg configures one client actor and the write stream it generates.\ntype ClientCfg struct {\n\tID string `json:\"id\"`\n\t// Writes is the total number of writes this client issues.\n\tWrites int `json:\"writes\"`\n\t// StartTick / EndTick bound the uniform spread of issue times.\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n\t// ReadEvery: issue a read every Nth operation slot (0 disables reads).\n\tReadEvery int `json:\"readEvery\"`\n}\n\n// OpCfg is one timed topology / failure operation.\n//\n// Kind:\n//   - \"scaleOut\": Add lists nodes joining the ring.\n//   - \"scaleIn\":  Remove lists nodes leaving; the simulator refuses to remove\n//                  a node until every key it owned has crossed the barrier.\n//   - \"interrupt\": establish a directed network blackhole between all\n//                  migration (node-to-node) traffic during [Tick, EndTick).\n//                  Client/control traffic is unaffected, so the migration\n//                  protocol's retransmission can be observed recovering.\ntype OpCfg struct {\n\tKind     string    `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTick     int       `json:\"tick\"`\n\tEndTick  int       `json:\"endTick\"`  // interrupt only\n\tAdd      []NodeCfg `json:\"add\"`      // scaleOut\n\tRemove   []string  `json:\"remove\"`   // scaleIn\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tSeed          int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int              `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tFinalRing     []NodeView       `json:\"finalRing\"`\n\tRemovedNodes  []string         `json:\"removedNodes\"`\n\tInterruption  *InterruptionView `json:\"interruption,omitempty\"`\n\tTopologyEpochs []EpochView     `json:\"topologyEpochs\"`\n\tStats         Stats            `json:\"stats\"`\n\t// MigrationBytes is the number of key-record payload bytes applied at a\n\t// destination node as part of migration (snapshot/forward stream), summed\n\t// over every migration. Each migrated version is counted once.\n\tMigration      MigrationReport `json:\"migration\"`\n\tVerifications  Verifications    `json:\"verifications\"`\n}\n\n// NodeView is a node's weight and the keys it stores at end of run.\ntype NodeView struct {\n\tID     string   `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int      `json:\"weight\"`\n\tKeys   []string `json:\"keys\"`\n}\n\n// EpochView records one ring epoch and when it became authoritative.\ntype EpochView struct {\n\tVersion  int      `json:\"version\"`\n\tNodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tBeganAt  int      `json:\"beganAt\"`\n\tCommitAt int      `json:\"commitAt,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// InterruptionView records a simulated blackhole window.\ntype InterruptionView struct {\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n}\n\n// Stats holds network and workload counters.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tMessagesSent      int `json:\"messagesSent\"`\n\tMessagesDelivered int `json:\"messagesDelivered\"`\n\tMessagesDropped   int `json:\"messagesDropped\"`\n\tMessagesDuplicated int `json:\"messagesDuplicated\"`\n\tMessagesReordered int `json:\"messagesReordered\"`\n\tBytesDelivered    int `json:\"bytesDelivered\"`\n\tWritesIssued      int `json:\"writesIssued\"`\n\tWritesConfirmed   int `json:\"writesConfirmed\"`\n\tWritesFailed      int `json:\"writesFailed\"` // exhausted retries\n\tReadsIssued       int `json:\"readsIssued\"`\n\tReadsSucceeded    int `json:\"readsSucceeded\"`\n\tReadsFailed       int `json:\"readsFailed\"`\n}\n\n// MigrationReport quantifies the migration.\ntype MigrationReport struct {\n\t// KeysMoved is the number of keys whose owner changed across all epochs.\n\tKeysMoved int `json:\"keysMoved\"`\n\t// RecordVersionsTransferred counts every record version applied at the new\n\t// owner through snapshot/forward streams.\n\tRecordVersionsTransferred int `json:\"recordVersionsTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesTransferred sums payload sizes of the transferred record versions.\n\tBytesTransferred int `json:\"bytesTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesMoved counts each migrated key's final record payload once: the\n\t// minimum data movement the migration cannot avoid.\n\tBytesMoved int `json:\"bytesMoved\"`\n\t// OverheadBytes is BytesTransferred - BytesMoved (writes during migration\n\t// that had to be forwarded too).\n\tOverheadBytes int `json:\"overheadBytes\"`\n\t// BarriersPassed counts switch barriers completed.\n\tBarriersPassed int `json:\"barriersPassed\"`\n\t// KeysPerMovement details each key move.\n\tMovements []MovementView `json:\"movements\"`\n}\n\n// MovementView describes one key's migration between two epochs.\ntype MovementView struct {\n\tKey        string `json:\"key\"`\n\tFrom       string `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo         string `json:\"to\"`\n\tVersion    int    `json:\"ringVersion\"`\n\tBeganAt    int    `json:\"beganAt\"`\n\tSwitchedAt int    `json:\"switchedAt\"`\n}\n\n// Verifications holds end-of-run correctness checks.\ntype Verifications struct {\n\t// Ownership: every key lives on its owner in the final ring, and only\n\t// there for a replicated-factor-1 store.\n\tOwnership CheckResult `json:\"ownership\"`\n\t// Version: every stored record is the latest applied version with the\n\t// correct single-winner value.\n\tVersion CheckResult `json:\"version\"`\n\t// ConfirmedWritesSurvive: every write that received an ack is present at\n\t// its key's final owner with its committed (or newer) version.\n\tConfirmedWritesSurvive CheckResult `json:\"confirmedWritesSurvive\"`\n\t// RemovalSafety: no key's latest record exists solely on a removed node;\n\t// the decommission gate itself also enforces this before a node is dropped.\n\tRemovalSafety CheckResult `json:\"removalSafety\"`\n\t// NoStaleReadAccepted: any read the simulator could validate returned a\n\t// version >= the newest committed version at request time (reads racing a\n\t// not-yet-delivered newer write are tolerated, never an older committed one).\n\tNoStaleReadAccepted CheckResult `json:\"noStaleReadAccepted\"`\n\t// Determinism is populated only by tests re-running the same config.\n\tDeterminism *CheckResult `json:\"determinism,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// CheckResult is one verification outcome.\ntype CheckResult struct {\n\tName    string   `json:\"name\"`\n\tPass    bool     `json:\"pass\"`\n\tDetails string   `json:\"details,omitempty\"`\n\t// Offenses lists at most the first few violations to keep reports compact.\n\tOffenses []string `json:\"offenses,omitempty\"`\n}\n\nfunc marshal(v any) []byte { b, _ := json.Marshal(v); return b }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":102,"oldLines":7,"newStart":102,"newLines":7,"lines":["   Version  int      `json:\"version\"`","   Nodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`","   BeganAt  int (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"5d4c0939-4b0b-41af-b074-c812c1412737","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:27:34.101Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/engine.go","oldString":"\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}","newString":"\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n\n\t// diag, if set, is invoked for every processed event.\n\tdiag func(now int64)\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// actor is anything that receives messages and timer firings.\ntype actor interface {\n\tid() string\n\treceive(m *Msg)\n\ttimer(kind string, data any)\n}\n\ntype queuedEvent struct {\n\twhen  int64\n\tseq   int64 // FIFO tie-break: smaller scheduled first -> causal order\n\tkind  byte  // 0 = delivery, 1 = timer, 2 = stop\n\tmsg   *Msg\n\tto    actor\n\ttid   int64\n\ttdata any\n}\n\n// Engine is the deterministic discrete-event core: a logical clock, an event\n// queue and the simulated lossy network. Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// byte-identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue      []*queuedEvent\n\tactors     map[string]actor\n\tdead       map[string]bool\n\tactive     map[int64]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder       float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay       int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive          bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hooks the upper layer uses to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:    seed,\n\t\trng:     rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors:  map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:    map[string]bool{},\n\t\tactive:  map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tstats:   st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// blackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"38b52a94-93a9-405e-911a-37a81b57b874","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:33:30.438Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/engine.go","oldString":"\t// Hook the upper layer may use to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}","newString":"\t// Hook the upper layer may use to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n\n\t// diag, if set, is invoked for every processed event.\n\tdiag func(ev *queuedEvent)\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// actor is anything that receives messages and timer firings.\ntype actor interface {\n\tid() string\n\treceive(m *Msg)\n\ttimer(kind string, data any)\n}\n\ntype queuedEvent struct {\n\twhen  int64\n\tseq   int64 // FIFO tie-break: smaller scheduled first -> causal order\n\tkind  byte  // 0 = delivery, 1 = timer\n\tmsg   *Msg\n\tto    actor\n\ttid   int64\n\ttdata any\n}\n\n// eventHeap is a min-heap ordered by (when, seq): the same causal ordering the\n// earlier linear scan produced, at O(log n) per push/pop instead of O(n).\ntype eventHeap []*queuedEvent\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].when != h[j].when {\n\t\treturn h[i].when < h[j].when\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)   { *h = append(*h, x.(*queuedEvent)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\tx := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn x\n}\n\n// Engine is the deterministic discrete-event core: a logical clock, an event\n// queue and the simulated lossy network. Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue    eventHeap\n\tactors   map[string]actor\n\tdead     map[string]bool\n\tactive   map[int64]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder         float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay         int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil   int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive            bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hook the upper layer may use to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:   seed,\n\t\trng:    rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors: map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:   map[string]bool{},\n\t\tactive: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tstats:  st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// setBlackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n\t}\n\treturn int64(d)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n\t\tkind: 0,\n\t\tmsg:  m,\n\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n\t})\n}\n\n// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\nfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n\te.timerSeq++\n\ttid := e.timerSeq\n\te.active[tid] = true\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n\treturn tid\n}\n\ntype timerPayload struct {\n\tkind string\n\tdata any\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n\te.eventSeq++\n\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\nfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(e.active, tid) }\n\n// run processes events in (when, seq) order until the next event exceeds\n// stopTick.\nfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*queuedEvent)\n\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.when\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !e.active[ev.tid] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(e.active, ev.tid)\n\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"207144eb-6c00-40c5-98dd-ebc4e56dbda1","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:36:04.312Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/ledger.go","oldString":"// ReadObservation is one client read, validated after the run.\ntype ReadObservation struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tIssueTick int64\n\tRespTick  int64\n\tVer       int\n\tFound     bool\n\tSuccess   bool\n}","newString":"// ReadObservation is one client read, validated after the run.\ntype ReadObservation struct {\n\tClient    string\n\tKey       string\n\tIssueTick int64\n\tRespTick  int64\n\tVer       int\n\tFound     bool\n\tSuccess   bool\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"sort\"\n\n// Record is one applied version of a key.\ntype Record struct {\n\tVer       int\n\tValue     string\n\tReqID     string\n\tAtTick    int64\n\tNode      string\n}\n\n// ConfirmedWrite records a write that received a client ack.\ntype ConfirmedWrite struct {\n\tKey           string\n\tVer           int\n\tValue         string\n\tConfirmedTick int64\n}\n\n// ReadObservation is one client read, validated after the run.\ntype ReadObservation struct {\n\tKey       string\n\tIssueTick int64\n\tRespTick  int64\n\tVer       int\n\tFound     bool\n\tSuccess   bool\n}\n\n// Ledger is the simulator's external ground truth. It observes every local\n// apply, every ack and every read answer; the verification pass uses it to\n// judge the storage nodes, never the reverse — storage code cannot \"win\" an\n// argument by writing here.\ntype Ledger struct {\n\t// applied versions per key, keyed by version.\n\tapplied map[string]map[int]Record\n\tlatest   map[string]Record\n\tconfirmed map[string]ConfirmedWrite // reqID -> write\n\treads     []ReadObservation\n}\n\nfunc newLedger() *Ledger {\n\treturn &Ledger{\n\t\tapplied:   map[string]map[int]Record{},\n\t\tlatest:    map[string]Record{},\n\t\tconfirmed: map[string]ConfirmedWrite{},\n\t}\n}\n\n// applied is called whenever a node commits a write to its local store.\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteApply(key, reqID string, ver int, value string, node string, tick int64) {\n\tif l.applied[key] == nil {\n\t\tl.applied[key] = map[int]Record{}\n\t}\n\tl.applied[key][ver] = Record{Ver: ver, Value: value, ReqID: reqID, AtTick: tick, Node: node}\n\tif cur, ok := l.latest[key]; !ok || ver > cur.Ver {\n\t\tl.latest[key] = l.applied[key][ver]\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteConfirm(reqID string, cw ConfirmedWrite) {\n\tif _, ok := l.confirmed[reqID]; ok {\n\t\treturn // duplicate ack delivery must not double-count\n\t}\n\tl.confirmed[reqID] = cw\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) { l.reads = append(l.reads, r) }\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) latestRecord(key string) (Record, bool) {\n\tr, ok := l.latest[key]\n\treturn r, ok\n}\n\n// confirmedAt returns the highest version whose ack was observed no later than\n// tick — the lower bound a read answer at that time must meet.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedAt(key string, tick int64) int {\n\tbest := 0\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tif c.Key != key || c.ConfirmedTick > tick {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.Ver > best {\n\t\t\tbest = c.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\n// confirmedWrites returns confirmed writes sorted deterministically.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedList() []ConfirmedWrite {\n\tout := make([]ConfirmedWrite, 0, len(l.confirmed))\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tout = append(out, c)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].Key != out[j].Key {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].Key < out[j].Key\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].Ver < out[j].Ver\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":21,"oldLines":6,"newStart":21,"newLines":7,"lines":[" "," // ReadObservation is one client read, validated after the run."," type ReadObservation struct {","+  Client    string","   Key       string","   IssueTick int64","   RespTick  int64"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"dee1573b-e604-407c-b1cb-66e75d1eecad","session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}

Read-your-writes: a read that completes after one of the same client's\n//     writes was confirmed never returns a version below that write.\n//\n// We deliberately do NOT require reads to see the globally newest confirmed\n// version: a read can legitimately race a write whose ack is still in flight,\n// and dual-read only forbids accepting the older of the two answers.\nfunc (w *world) checkReads() CheckResult {\n\tvar off []string\n\treads := append([]ReadObservation(nil), w.ledger.reads...)\n\tsort.Slice(reads, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif reads[i].RespTick != reads[j].RespTick {\n\t\t\treturn reads[i].RespTick < reads[j].RespTick\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn reads[i].Client < reads[j].Client\n\t})\n\tseen := map[string]int{} // \"client\\x00key\" -> highest version read so far\n\tfor _, r := range reads {\n\t\tif !r.Success {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tck := r.Client + \"\\x00\" + r.Key\n\t\tif prev := seen[ck]; r.Ver < prev {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s read %s@%d returned v%d after previously reading v%d\",\n\t\t\t\tr.Client, r.Key, r.RespTick, r.Ver, prev))\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Ver > seen[ck] {\n\t\t\tseen[ck] = r.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Value must match the version the ledger knows for this key.\n\t\tif r.Found {\n\t\t\tif recs := w.ledger.applied[r.Key]; recs != nil {\n\t\t\t\tif rec, ok := recs[r.Ver]; ok && rec.Value != r.Value {\n\t\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s read %s v%d got %q but that version is %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tr.Client, r.Key, r.Ver, r.Value, rec.Value))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Read-your-writes floor: highest version this client confirmed before\n\t\t// the response arrived.\n\t\tfloor := 0\n\t\tfor _, c := range w.ledger.confirmed {\n\t\t\tif c.Key != r.Key || c.ConfirmedTick > r.RespTick {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif c.Ver > floor {\n\t\t\t\tfloor = c.Ver\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Only count confirms originating from THIS client. ConfirmedWrite does\n\t\t// not carry the client id, so attribute via value prefix the simulator\n\t\t// itself uses (\"v:<client>:<n>\"); preload uses a different prefix and\n\t\t// therefore never matches.\n\t\tif floor > 0 {\n\t\t\townFloor := 0\n\t\t\tfor reqID, c := range w.ledger.confirmed {\n\t\t\t\tif c.Key != r.Key || c.ConfirmedTick > r.RespTick {\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif strings.HasPrefix(reqID, \"w:\"+r.Client+\":\") && c.Ver > ownFloor {\n\t\t\t\t\townFloor = c.Ver\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfloor = ownFloor\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Ver < floor {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s read-your-writes violated on %s: v%d < own confirmed v%d\",\n\t\t\t\tr.Client, r.Key, r.Ver, floor))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check(\"noStaleReadAccepted\", off,\n\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%d successful reads validated (monotonic + read-your-writes + single-value)\",\n\t\t\tlen(reads)))\n}"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_a53fa8d77119fac7798a87aa","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":804,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":159544,"output_tokens":1293,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_qggjq6tn5d0jqqgqge2l3n3j":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/world.go","new_string":"// checkReads verifies two single-version properties under the dual-read\n// \"highest version wins\" arbiter:\n//\n//  1. Read-your-writes: a read that completes after one of the same client's\n//     writes was confirmed never returns a version below that write.\n//\n// We deliberately do NOT require reads to see the globally newest confirmed\n// version: a read can legitimately race a write whose ack is still in flight,\n// and dual-read only forbids accepting the older of the two answers.\nfunc (w *world) checkReads() CheckResult {\n\tvar off []string\n\treads := append([]ReadObservation(nil), w.ledger.reads...)\n\tsort.Slice(reads, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif reads[i].RespTick != reads[j].RespTick {\n\t\t\treturn reads[i].RespTick < reads[j].RespTick\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn reads[i].Client < reads[j].Client\n\t})\n\tseen := map[string]int{} // \"client\\x00key\" -> highest version read so far\n\tfor _, r := range reads {\n\t\tif !r.Success {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tck := r.Client + \"\\x00\" + r.Key\n\t\tif prev := seen[ck]; r.Ver < prev {\n\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s read %s@%d returned v%d after previously reading v%d\",\n\t\t\t\tr.Client, r.Key, r.RespTick, r.Ver, prev))\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.Ver > seen[ck] {\n\t\t\tseen[ck] = r.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Value must match the version the ledger knows for this key.\n\t\tif r.Found {\n\t\t\tif recs := w.ledger.applied[r.Key]; recs != nil {\n\t\t\t\tif rec, ok := recs[r.Ver]; ok && rec.Value != r.Value {\n\t\t\t\t\toff = append(off, fmt.Sprintf(\"%s read %s v%d got %q but that version is %q\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tr.Client, r.Key, r.Ver, r.Value, rec.Value))\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Read-your-writes floor: highest version this client confirmed before\n\t\t// the response arrived.\n\t\tfloor := 0\n\t\tfor _, c := range w.ledger.confirmed {\n\t\t\tif c.Key != r.Key || c.ConfirmedTick > r.RespTick {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif c.Ver > floor {\n\t\t\t\tfloor = c.Ver\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// Only count confirms originating from THIS client.
