`json:\"switchedAt\"`\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport \"encoding/json\"\n\n// Config is the JSON run interface for the simulator.\n//\n// A run is fully described by this structure: the initial weighted topology,\n// the key universe, the deterministic client workload, the lossy network\n// parameters and a timed schedule of topology operations (scale out, scale\n// in, simulated network interruptions).\ntype Config struct {\n\tSeed          int64  `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int    `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tVNodes        int    `json:\"vnodesPerWeight\"`\n\tLossRate      float64 `json:\"lossRate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicateRate\"`\n\tReorderRate   float64 `json:\"reorderRate\"`\n\t// Min/MaxLinkDelay bound the random one-way delivery delay in ticks.\n\tMinLinkDelay int `json:\"minLinkDelay\"`\n\tMaxLinkDelay int `json:\"maxLinkDelay\"`\n\t// RetryTicks: client outstanding request / migration control timeout.\n\tRetryTicks int `json:\"retryTicks\"`\n\t// MigrationConcurrency: max keys migrating in parallel from one node.\n\tMigrationConcurrency int `json:\"migrationConcurrency\"`\n\t// BarrierTicks: delay between BEGIN for a key and its switch barrier.\n\tBarrierTicks int `json:\"barrierTicks\"`\n\t// DrainTicks: quiet period after the last scheduled op before stopTick, used\n\t// if StopTick is 0.\n\tDrainTicks int `json:\"drainTicks\"`\n\n\tInitialNodes []NodeCfg `json:\"initialNodes\"`\n\tKeys         []string  `json:\"keys\"`\n\t// Preload, when true, writes one seed record (\"seed:<key>\") to every key\n\t// on its ring-0 owner at tick 0. It gives every migration real snapshot\n\t// data to move and makes the transferred-volume statistics meaningful.\n\tPreload       bool        `json:\"preload\"`\n\tClients       []ClientCfg `json:\"clients\"`\n\tOperations    []OpCfg     `json:\"operations\"`\n}\n\n// NodeCfg configures one initial physical node.\ntype NodeCfg struct {\n\tID     string `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int    `json:\"weight\"`\n}\n\n// ClientCfg configures one client actor and the write stream it generates.\ntype ClientCfg struct {\n\tID string `json:\"id\"`\n\t// Writes is the total number of writes this client issues.\n\tWrites int `json:\"writes\"`\n\t// StartTick / EndTick bound the uniform spread of issue times.\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n\t// ReadEvery: issue a read every Nth operation slot (0 disables reads).\n\tReadEvery int `json:\"readEvery\"`\n}\n\n// OpCfg is one timed topology / failure operation.\n//\n// Kind:\n//   - \"scaleOut\": Add lists nodes joining the ring.\n//   - \"scaleIn\":  Remove lists nodes leaving; the simulator refuses to remove\n//                  a node until every key it owned has crossed the barrier.\n//   - \"interrupt\": establish a directed network blackhole between all\n//                  migration (node-to-node) traffic during [Tick, EndTick).\n//                  Client/control traffic is unaffected, so the migration\n//                  protocol's retransmission can be observed recovering.\ntype OpCfg struct {\n\tKind     string    `json:\"kind\"`\n\tTick     int       `json:\"tick\"`\n\tEndTick  int       `json:\"endTick\"`  // interrupt only\n\tAdd      []NodeCfg `json:\"add\"`      // scaleOut\n\tRemove   []string  `json:\"remove\"`   // scaleIn\n}\n\n// Report is the JSON result of a run.\ntype Report struct {\n\tSeed          int64            `json:\"seed\"`\n\tStopTick      int              `json:\"stopTick\"`\n\tFinalRing     []NodeView       `json:\"finalRing\"`\n\tRemovedNodes  []string         `json:\"removedNodes\"`\n\tInterruption  *InterruptionView `json:\"interruption,omitempty\"`\n\tTopologyEpochs []EpochView     `json:\"topologyEpochs\"`\n\tStats         Stats            `json:\"stats\"`\n\t// MigrationBytes is the number of key-record payload bytes applied at a\n\t// destination node as part of migration (snapshot/forward stream), summed\n\t// over every migration. Each migrated version is counted once.\n\tMigration      MigrationReport `json:\"migration\"`\n\tVerifications  Verifications    `json:\"verifications\"`\n}\n\n// NodeView is a node's weight and the keys it stores at end of run.\ntype NodeView struct {\n\tID     string   `json:\"id\"`\n\tWeight int      `json:\"weight\"`\n\tKeys   []string `json:\"keys\"`\n}\n\n// EpochView records one ring epoch and when it became authoritative.\ntype EpochView struct {\n\tVersion  int      `json:\"version\"`\n\tNodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tBeganAt  int      `json:\"beganAt\"`\n\tCommitAt int      `json:\"commitAt\"`\n}\n\n// InterruptionView records a simulated blackhole window.\ntype InterruptionView struct {\n\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n}\n\n// Stats holds network and workload counters.\ntype Stats struct {\n\tMessagesSent      int `json:\"messagesSent\"`\n\tMessagesDelivered int `json:\"messagesDelivered\"`\n\tMessagesDropped   int `json:\"messagesDropped\"`\n\tMessagesDuplicated int `json:\"messagesDuplicated\"`\n\tMessagesReordered int `json:\"messagesReordered\"`\n\tBytesDelivered    int `json:\"bytesDelivered\"`\n\tWritesIssued      int `json:\"writesIssued\"`\n\tWritesConfirmed   int `json:\"writesConfirmed\"`\n\tWritesFailed      int `json:\"writesFailed\"` // exhausted retries\n\tReadsIssued       int `json:\"readsIssued\"`\n\tReadsSucceeded    int `json:\"readsSucceeded\"`\n\tReadsFailed       int `json:\"readsFailed\"`\n}\n\n// MigrationReport quantifies the migration.\ntype MigrationReport struct {\n\t// KeysMoved is the number of keys whose owner changed across all epochs.\n\tKeysMoved int `json:\"keysMoved\"`\n\t// RecordVersionsTransferred counts every record version applied at the new\n\t// owner through snapshot/forward streams.\n\tRecordVersionsTransferred int `json:\"recordVersionsTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesTransferred sums payload sizes of the transferred record versions.\n\tBytesTransferred int `json:\"bytesTransferred\"`\n\t// BytesMoved counts each migrated key's final record payload once: the\n\t// minimum data movement the got != 500 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"vnode count = %d, want 500\", got)\n\t}\n\tcounts := map[string]int{}\n\tfor i := 0; i < 20000; i++ {\n\t\tcounts[r.Owner(keyN(i))]++\n\t}\n\tratio := float64(counts[\"heavy\"]) / float64(counts[\"lite\"])\n\tif ratio < 3.4 || ratio > 4.6 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"weight ratio %.2f not near 4.0 (lite=%d heavy=%d)\", ratio, counts[\"lite\"], counts[\"heavy\"])\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestAddOneNodeMovesExpectedFraction: adding one of N+1 nodes should move\n// roughly 1/(N+1) of keys — the core balanced-hashing guarantee.\nfunc TestAddOneNodeMovesExpectedFraction(t *testing.T) {\n\tconst vn = 256\n\told, _ := New(0, []NodeSpec{\n\t\t{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 1},\n\t}, vn)\n\tnw, _ := New(1, []NodeSpec{\n\t\t{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 1},\n\t}, vn)\n\tkeys := make([]string, 6000)\n\tfor i := range keys {\n\t\tkeys[i] = keyN(i)\n\t}\n\tmoves := old.Diff(nw, keys)\n\tmoved := 0\n\tfor _, m := range moves {\n\t\tif m.Migrates {\n\t\t\tmoved++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfrac := float64(moved) / float64(len(keys))\n\tif frac < 0.20 || frac > 0.30 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"moved fraction %.3f outside ~0.25\", frac)\n\t}\n\t// Every move must go TO the new node or redistribute; the key invariant is\n\t// only that unmoved keys keep their owner.\n\tfor _, m := range moves {\n\t\tif !m.Migrates && m.From != m.To {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"non-migrate report with differing owners\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestNoKeysMoveWhenUnchanged verifies a rebuild of the same set moves nothing.\nfunc TestNoKeysMoveWhenUnchanged(t *testing.T) {\n\tspecs := []NodeSpec{{ID: \"a\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"b\", Weight: 3}}\n\tr1, _ := New(0, specs, 64)\n\tr2, _ := New(1, specs, 64)\n\tkeys := make([]string, 500)\n\tfor i := range keys {\n\t\tkeys[i] = keyN(i)\n\t}\n\tfor _, m := range r1.Diff(r2, keys) {\n\t\tif m.Migrates {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"key %s moved %s->%s under unchanged topology\", m.Key, m.From, m.To)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestRemoveNodeRedistributesToSurvivors verifies every key that the removed\n// node owned moves to a surviving node; no key is assigned to the removed node\n// on the new ring.\nfunc TestRemoveNodeRedistributesToSurvivors(t *testing.T) {\n\told, _ := New(0, []NodeSpec{\n\t\t{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 1},\n\t}, 128)\n\tnw, _ := New(1, []NodeSpec{\n\t\t{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 1},\n\t}, 128)\n\tkeys := make([]string, 4000)\n\tfor i := range keys {\n\t\tkeys[i] = keyN(i)\n\t}\n\tremovedOwned := 0\n\tfor _, m := range old.Diff(nw, keys) {\n\t\tif m.To == \"n2\" {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"key %s assigned to removed node n2\", m.Key)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif m.From == \"n2\" {\n\t\t\tremovedOwned++\n\t\t\tif !m.Migrates {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"key %s stayed on removed node\", m.Key)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif removedOwned == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"test had no keys owned by the removed node; {"parentUuid":"785a741d-35f0-441f-a2b8-9eeccc85589d","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_vk8y3r1ra4z8ktgtg05uhzoy","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/sim_test.go","content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\n// ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n// movingKeysBetween returns up to n key strings whose owner differs between\n// the two rings, plus a stable set that does not.\nfunc movingKeysBetween(t *testing.T, r0, r1 *ring.Ring, n int) []string {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tvar moving, stable []string\n\tfor i := 0; i < 20000 && len(moving) < n; i++ {\n\t\tk := testKey(i)\n\t\tif r0.Owner(k) != r1.Owner(k) {\n\t\t\tmoving = append(moving, k)\n\t\t} else if len(stable) < n {\n\t\t\tstable = append(stable, k)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(moving) < n {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"could only find %d moving keys (wanted %d)\", len(moving), n)\n\t}\n\treturn append(moving, stable...)\n}\n\nfunc testKey(i int) string {\n\tn := i\n\tvar b strings.Builder\n\tb.WriteString(\"test:key:\")\n\tfor j := 0; j < 4; j++ {\n\t\tb.WriteByte(byte('a' + n%26))\n\t\tn /= 26\n\t}\n\tb.WriteByte(':')\n\treturn b.String()\n}\n\nfunc baseConfig(keys []string) Config {\n\treturn Config{\n\t\tSeed: 1, VNodes: 64, Preload: true,\n\t\tLossRate: 0.05, DuplicateRate: 0.02, ReorderRate: 0.02,\n\t\tMinLinkDelay: 1, MaxLinkDelay: 3, RetryTicks: 20,\n\t\tMigrationConcurrency: 8, BarrierTicks: 30, DrainTicks: 400,\n\t\tInitialNodes: []NodeCfg{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}},\n\t\tKeys:         keys,\n\t\tClients: []ClientCfg{\n\t\t\t{ID: \"c1\", Writes: 100, StartTick: 5, EndTick: 220, ReadEvery: 5},\n\t\t\t{ID: \"c2\", Writes: 100, StartTick: 8, EndTick: 240, ReadEvery: 6},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc assertAllPass(t *testing.T, r *Report) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tv := r.Verifications\n\tchecks := []CheckResult{v.Ownership, v.Version, v.ConfirmedWritesSurvive,\n\t\tv.RemovalSafety, v.NoStaleReadAccepted}\n\tfor _, c := range checks {\n\t\tif !c.Pass {\n\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"%s failed: %v\", c.Name, c.Offenses)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ring0/ringAfterOut for scenario key selection.\nfunc mustRing(t *testing.T, v int, specs []NodeSpec) *ring.Ring {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tr, err := ring.New(v, specs, 64)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\treturn r\n}\n\n// ---- tests --------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc TestSteadyStateNoMigration(t *testing.T) {\n\tr0 := mustRing(t, 0, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}})\n\tkeys := movingKeysBetween(t, r0, r0, 40) // stable set only in effect\n\tcfg := baseConfig(keys)\n\tr, err := Run(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tassertAllPass(t, r)\n\tif r.Migration.KeysMoved != 0 || len(r.TopologyEpochs) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected no epochs/moves, got epochs=%d moved=%d\", len(r.TopologyEpochs), r.Migration.KeysMoved)\n\t}\n\tif r.Stats.WritesConfirmed == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"no confirmed writes\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScaleOutMigration(t *testing.T) {\n\tr0 := mustRing(t, 0, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}})\n\tr1 := mustRing(t, 1, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}})\n\tkeys := movingKeysBetween(t, r0, r1, 40)\n\tcfg := baseConfig(keys)\n\tcfg.Operations = []OpCfg{{Kind: \"scaleOut\", Tick: 80, Add: []NodeCfg{{ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}}}}\n\tr, err := Run(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tassertAllPass(t, r)\n\tif r.Migration.KeysMoved == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"expected keys to move on scale-out\")\n\t}\n\t// Final ring must contain n4 and report its committed epoch.\n\tids := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, n := range r.FinalRing {\n\t\tids[n.ID] = true\n\t}\n\tif !ids[\"n4\"] {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"n4 missing from final ring\")\n\t}\n\tif r.Migration.EpochsCommitted != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"epochsCommitted=%d, want 1\", r.Migration.EpochsCommitted)\n\t}\n\t// Each movement points from a ring-0 owner to a ring-1 owner.\n\tfor _, m := range r.Migration.Movements {\n\t\tif m.From != r0.Owner(m.Key) || m.To != r1.Owner(m.Key) {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"movement %s %s->%s disagrees with rings (%s->%s)\",\n\t\t\t\tm.Key, m.From, m.To, r0.Owner(m.Key), r1.Owner(m.Key))\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !m.Committed || m.SwitchedAt <= m.BeganAt {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"movement %s not committed or bad timing: %+v\", m.Key, m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestScaleInRemovalSafety(t *testing.T) {\n\tspecs0 := []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}}\n\tr0 := mustRing(t, 0, specs0)\n\tr1 := mustRing(t, 1, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}})\n\tkeys := movingKeysBetween(t, r0, r1, 40)\n\tcfg := baseConfig(keys)\n\tcfg.InitialNodes = []NodeCfg{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}}\n\tcfg.Operations = []OpCfg{{Kind: \"scaleIn\", Tick: 80, Remove: []string{\"n2\"}}}\n\tr, err := Run(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tassertAllPass(t, r)\n\t// n2 must be reported removed and absent from final ring.\n\tfound := false\n\tfor _, n := range r.FinalRing {\n\t\tif n.ID == \"n2\" {\n\t\t\tfound = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif found {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"removed node n2 still in final ring\")\n\t}\n\tif len(r.RemovedNodes) != 1 || r.RemovedNodes[0] != \"n2\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"removedNodes=%v\", r.RemovedNodes)\n\t}\n\t// Every key n2 used to own must now be on a survivor with the latest value.\n\tfinal := mustRing(t, 1, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}})\n\tfor _, k := range keys {\n\t\tif r0.Owner(k) != \"n2\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif final.Owner(k) == \"n2\" {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"key %s still maps to removed node\", k)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestInterruptedMigrationNoConfirmedLoss(t *testing.T) {\n\tr0 := mustRing(t, 0, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}})\n\tr1 := mustRing(t, 1, []ring.NodeSpec{{ID: \"n1\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n2\", Weight: 1}, {ID: \"n3\", Weight: 2}, {ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}})\n\tkeys := movingKeysBetween(t, r0, r1, 40)\n\tcfg := baseConfig(keys)\n\tcfg.StopTick = 220\n\tcfg.Clients[0].EndTick = 160\n\tcfg.Clients[1].EndTick = 170\n\t// Scale-out, then blackhole migration traffic until near stop: barriers that\n\t// pass cannot commit, so the epoch must stay uncommitted with no data loss.\n\tcfg.Operations = []OpCfg{\n\t\t{Kind: \"scaleOut\", Tick: 50, Add: []NodeCfg{{ID: \"n4\", Weight: 2}}},\n\t\t{Kind: \"interrupt\", Tick: 60, EndTick: 215},\n\t}\n\tr, err := Run(cfg)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tassertAllPass(t, r) // the key acceptance criterion\n\tif r.Migration.EpochsCommitted != Everything runs in one goroutine and\n50\t// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n51\t// identical runs.\n52\ttype Engine struct {\n53\t\tSeed int64\n54\t\trng  *rand.Rand\n55\t\n56\t\tnow      int64\n57\t\teventSeq int64\n58\t\ttimerSeq int64\n59\t\tqueue    eventHeap\n60\t\tactors   map[string]actor\n61\t\tdead     map[string]bool\n62\t\tactive   map[int64]bool\n63\t\n64\t\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n65\t\tloss, dup, reorder         float64\n66\t\tminDelay, maxDelay         int\n67\t\tblackholeMigrationUntil   int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n68\t\tblackholeActive            bool\n69\t\n70\t\tstats *Stats\n71\t\n72\t\t// Hook the upper layer may use to observe delivery (ground truth).\n73\t\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n74\t}\n75\t\n76\t\n77\tfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n78\t\treturn &Engine{\n79\t\t\tSeed:   seed,\n80\t\t\trng:    rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n81\t\t\tactors: map[string]actor{},\n82\t\t\tdead:   map[string]bool{},\n83\t\t\tactive: map[int64]bool{},\n84\t\t\tstats:  st,\n85\t\t}\n86\t}\n87\t\n88\tfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n89\t\n90\t// tick returns the current logical time.\n91\tfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n92\t\n93\t// setBlackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\n94\tfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n95\t\te.blackholeActive = on\n96\t\tif on {\n97\t\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n98\t\t}\n99\t}\n100\t\n101\t// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n102\t// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\n103\tfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n104\t\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n105\t\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n106\t\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n107\t\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n108\t\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n109\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n110\t\t\treturn\n111\t\t}\n112\t\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n113\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n114\t\t\treturn\n115\t\t}\n116\t\tcopies := 1\n117\t\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n118\t\t\tcopies = 2\n119\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n120\t\t}\n121\t\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n122\t\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n123\t\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n124\t\t}\n125\t}\n126\t\n127\tfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n128\t\td := e.minDelay\n129\t\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n130\t\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n131\t\t}\n132\t\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n133\t\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n134\t\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n135\t\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n136\t\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n137\t\t}\n138\t\treturn int64(d)\n139\t}\n140\t\n141\tfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n142\t\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n143\t\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n144\t\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n145\t\t\tkind: 0,\n146\t\t\tmsg:  m,\n147\t\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n148\t\t})\n149\t}\n150\t\n151\t// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\n152\tfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n153\t\te.timerSeq++\n154\t\ttid := e.timerSeq\n155\t\te.active[tid] = true\n156\t\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n157\t\treturn tid\n158\t}\n159\t\n160\ttype timerPayload struct {\n161\t\tkind string\n162\t\tdata any\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\tfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n166\t\te.eventSeq++\n167\t\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n168\t\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n169\t}\n170\t\n171\t// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\n172\tfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(e.active, tid) }\n173\t\n174\t// run processes events in (when, seq) order until the next event exceeds\n175\t// stopTick.\n176\tfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n177\t\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n178\t\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*queuedEvent)\n179\t\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n180\t\t\t\tbreak\n181\t\t\t}\n182\t\t\te.now = ev.when\n183\t\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n184\t\t\tcase 0:\n185\t\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n186\t\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n187\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n188\t\t\t\t}\n189\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n190\t\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n191\t\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n192\t\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n193\t\t\t\t}\n194\t\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n195\t\t\tcase 1:\n196\t\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !e.active[ev.tid] {\n197\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n198\t\t\t\t}\n199\t\t\t\tdelete(e.active, ev.tid)\n200\t\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n201\t\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n202\t\t\t}\n203\t\t}\n204\t}\n205\t\n206\tfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n207\t\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; client ids use\n208\t\t// \"client:\" and the controller is \"ctrl\".\n209\t\treturn len(id) > 5 && id[:5] == \"node:\"\n210\t}\n211\t\n212\t// sortedKeys helper for deterministic report iteration.\n213\tfunc sortedKeys(m map[string]bool) []string {\n214\t\tout := make([]string, 0, len(m))\n215\t\tfor k := range m {\n216\t\t\tout = append(out, k)\n217\t\t}\n218\t\tsort.Strings(out)\n219\t\treturn out\n220\t}"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"cd5c0128-1b85-44f5-9f94-cf51b7e2f310","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:04:09.284Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nNote: /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/engine.go changed on disk since you last read it. (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"3fcedb47-37d4-4e64-9ffb-a4b7e2b15bb9","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:04:39.461Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/sim/engine.go","oldString":"func (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }","newString":"func (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// setNetwork configures the lossy-link parameters (rates in [0,1), delays in\n// ticks). Called once before the run starts.\nfunc (e *Engine) setNetwork(loss, dup, reorder float64, minDelay, maxDelay int) {\n\te.loss, e.dup, e.reorder = loss, dup, reorder\n\te.minDelay, e.maxDelay = minDelay, maxDelay\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"container/heap\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n)\n\n// actor is anything that receives messages and timer firings.\ntype actor interface {\n\tid() string\n\treceive(m *Msg)\n\ttimer(kind string, data any)\n}\n\ntype queuedEvent struct {\n\twhen  int64\n\tseq   int64 // FIFO tie-break: smaller scheduled first -> causal order\n\tkind  byte  // 0 = delivery, 1 = timer\n\tmsg   *Msg\n\tto    actor\n\ttid   int64\n\ttdata any\n}\n\n// eventHeap is a min-heap ordered by (when, seq): the same causal ordering the\n// earlier linear scan produced, at O(log n) per push/pop instead of O(n).\ntype eventHeap []*queuedEvent\n\nfunc (h eventHeap) Len() int { return len(h) }\nfunc (h eventHeap) Less(i, j int) bool {\n\tif h[i].when != h[j].when {\n\t\treturn h[i].when < h[j].when\n\t}\n\treturn h[i].seq < h[j].seq\n}\nfunc (h eventHeap) Swap(i, j int) { h[i], h[j] = h[j], h[i] }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Push(x any)   { *h = append(*h, x.(*queuedEvent)) }\nfunc (h *eventHeap) Pop() any {\n\told := *h\n\tn := len(old)\n\tx := old[n-1]\n\told[n-1] = nil\n\t*h = old[:n-1]\n\treturn x\n}\n\n// Engine is the deterministic discrete-event core: a logical clock, an event\n// queue and the simulated lossy network. Everything runs in one goroutine and\n// every random decision comes from one RNG, so identical Config+Seed produces\n// identical runs.\ntype Engine struct {\n\tSeed int64\n\trng  *rand.Rand\n\n\tnow      int64\n\teventSeq int64\n\ttimerSeq int64\n\tqueue    eventHeap\n\tactors   map[string]actor\n\tdead     map[string]bool\n\tactive   map[int64]bool\n\n\t// Network knobs (rates in [0,1], delays in ticks).\n\tloss, dup, reorder         float64\n\tminDelay, maxDelay         int\n\tblackholeMigrationUntil   int64 // migration msgs at tick < this are dropped\n\tblackholeActive            bool\n\n\tstats *Stats\n\n\t// Hook the upper layer may use to observe delivery (ground truth).\n\tonDeliver func(m *Msg)\n}\n\n\nfunc newEngine(seed int64, st *Stats) *Engine {\n\treturn &Engine{\n\t\tSeed:   seed,\n\t\trng:    rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed)),\n\t\tactors: map[string]actor{},\n\t\tdead:   map[string]bool{},\n\t\tactive: map[int64]bool{},\n\t\tstats:  st,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) register(a actor) { e.actors[a.id()] = a }\n\n// tick returns the current logical time.\nfunc (e *Engine) tick() int64 { return e.now }\n\n// setBlackhole installs/removes the migration-only network interruption.\nfunc (e *Engine) setBlackhole(on bool, until int64) {\n\te.blackholeActive = on\n\tif on {\n\t\te.blackholeMigrationUntil = until\n\t}\n}\n\n// send puts one logical message through the network. Retransmissions call\n// send again with the same Msg.Seq.\nfunc (e *Engine) send(m *Msg) {\n\te.stats.MessagesSent++\n\t// Simulated interruption: node-to-node migration traffic is blackholed;\n\t// client and control traffic still flows, so the protocol must recover via\n\t// retransmission once the window ends.\n\tif e.blackholeActive && m.Migration && isNode(m.From) && isNode(m.To) {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.loss {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcopies := 1\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.dup {\n\t\tcopies = 2\n\t\te.stats.MessagesDuplicated++\n\t}\n\tfor c := 0; c < copies; c++ {\n\t\tdelay := e.drawDelay(c)\n\t\te.scheduleDelivery(delay, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) drawDelay(copyIdx int) int64 {\n\td := e.minDelay\n\tif e.maxDelay > e.minDelay {\n\t\td += e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay - e.minDelay + 1)\n\t}\n\t// Reordering: an extra delay beyond the normal window. Duplicate copies\n\t// also take the detour so they can arrive after the original.\n\tif e.rng.Float64() < e.reorder || copyIdx == 1 {\n\t\te.stats.MessagesReordered++\n\t\td += e.maxDelay + 1 + e.rng.Intn(e.maxDelay+1)\n\t}\n\treturn int64(d)\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) scheduleDelivery(delay int64, m *Msg) {\n\ta := e.actors[m.To]\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{\n\t\twhen: e.now + delay,\n\t\tkind: 0,\n\t\tmsg:  m,\n\t\tto:   a, // nil if target never existed; handled at pop\n\t})\n}\n\n// after schedules a one-shot timer; returns its id for cancellation.\nfunc (e *Engine) after(delay int64, a actor, kind string, data any) int64 {\n\te.timerSeq++\n\ttid := e.timerSeq\n\te.active[tid] = true\n\te.push(&queuedEvent{when: e.now + delay, kind: 1, to: a, tid: tid, tdata: timerPayload{kind, data}})\n\treturn tid\n}\n\ntype timerPayload struct {\n\tkind string\n\tdata any\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) push(ev *queuedEvent) {\n\te.eventSeq++\n\tev.seq = e.eventSeq\n\theap.Push(&e.queue, ev)\n}\n\n// cancelTimer marks a timer id stale.\nfunc (e *Engine) cancelTimer(tid int64) { delete(e.active, tid) }\n\n// run processes events in (when, seq) order until the next event exceeds\n// stopTick.\nfunc (e *Engine) run(stopTick int64) {\n\tfor e.queue.Len() > 0 {\n\t\tev := heap.Pop(&e.queue).(*queuedEvent)\n\t\tif ev.when > stopTick {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t\te.now = ev.when\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.msg.To] {\n\t\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDropped++\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.stats.MessagesDelivered++\n\t\t\te.stats.BytesDelivered += ev.msg.Size()\n\t\t\tif e.onDeliver != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.onDeliver(ev.msg)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tev.to.receive(ev.msg)\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tif ev.to == nil || e.dead[ev.to.id()] || !e.active[ev.tid] {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdelete(e.active, ev.tid)\n\t\t\ttp := ev.tdata.(timerPayload)\n\t\t\tev.to.timer(tp.kind, tp.data)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc isNode(id string) bool {\n\t// Node ids are registered with a \"node:\" prefix internally; {"parentUuid":"ff9b9d6f-71da-461a-b454-682daa11a8d0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Real network exposure uncovered bugs:\n1. \n\nThe root cause of the v4 value mismatch bug has been identified: the same version number was applied twice with different values.\n\nThe root cause of the version collision that triggers the mismatch has been pinpointed: during migration, nodes may independently assign version numbers to redirected writes after the barrier, leading to conflicting version chains for the same version ID. Additionally, after the barrier, B will buffer writes without sending acks.\n\nAfter further verification, I confirmed that stream forwarding stops at the freeze stage with no overlap, duplicate write requests cannot trigger version conflicts, and the root cause of the previous v4 value mismatch is actually the interaction between duplicate delivery of the same request and the freeze/redirect mechanism.\n\nI've ruled out the possibility of double version triggering the mismatch. I also found that B does not validate whether the received version is equal to appliedSeq + 1, and version divergence may occur between A and B. Additionally, overlapping versions from the same key's previous migration epoch can be received, but version reset per stream works properly.\n\nI've confirmed the single-threaded commit logic on B is safe. I also found the root cause of same-version value conflicts: the `ledger.applied` map only stores one record per version, so duplicate applies of the same version with different values will be overwritten.\n\nI've identified the root cause of snapshot replay triggering version conflicts: snapshot applies are not recorded in the applied ledger, and duplicate snapshot delivery will not cause re-application due to the existing guard. I also confirmed the 1:1 mapping between sequence numbers and versions during normal forwarding, with no gaps.\n\nAfter verification, I've confirmed the lastVer logic on B is correct. Next, I'll conduct targeted reproduction testing and add debug checks to detect same-version different-value applies.\n","type":"thinking"}],"id":"msg_1c3c801e6e8946e5de3aee0a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":823,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":213816,"output_tokens":2105,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"type":"assistant","uuid":"3a2f81ba-6fef-4c8b-865a-8d2c91270066","timestamp":"2026-09-23T06:06:28.133Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}

{\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.Ver > best {\n\t\t\tbest = c.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\n// confirmedWrites returns confirmed writes sorted deterministically.\nfunc (l *Ledger) *Ledger) noteConfirm(reqID string, cw ConfirmedWrite) {\n\tif _, ok := l.confirmed[reqID]; ok {\n\t\treturn // duplicate ack delivery must not double-count\n\t}\n\tl.confirmed[reqID] = cw\n}\n\nfunc read bookkeeping\n\treadVer int\n\treadVal string\n\treadFound bool\n\tgotResp bool\n}\n\ntype client struct {\n\tcfg  ClientCfg\n\taid  string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\n\tcurrent clientID(cfg.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\tcurrent: w.rings[0],\n\t\tinflight: map[string]*inflight{},\n\t\tmaxRetry: w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.aid }\n\nfunc (c *client) valueFor(planIdx int) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"v:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: c.aid, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(b.Version, c.w.nodeSpecs(b.Nodes), c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.Pending {\n\t\t\tc.pending = r\n\t\t} else if c.current.Version < b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = r\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"CommitAck\", From: c.aid, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &CommitAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tif c.pending != nil && c.pending.Version == b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = c.pending\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\tc.onWriteAck(b)\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tc.onReadResp(b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"issue\":\n\t\tp := data.(plannedOp)\n\t\tif p.write {\n\t\t\tc.startWrite(p.idx)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.startRead(p.idx)\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wretry\":\n\t\tc.retryWrite(data.(string))\n\tcase \"rretry\":\n\t\tc.retryRead(data.(string))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- nodeID(c.current.Owner(key))}\n\tc.inflight[reqID] = inf\n\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", reqID)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) sendWrite(inf *inflight) {\n\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteReq\", From: c.aid, To: inf.to, Seq: c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\tBody: &WriteReq{Key: inf.key, Value: inf.value, ReqID: inf.reqID}})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onWriteAck(a w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves generation on ties).\n\tsort.SliceStable(plan, func(i, j int) bool { return plan[i].at < plan[j].at })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.aid }\n\nfunc (c *client) int\n}","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc clientID(raw string) string { return \"client:\" + raw }\n\ntype plannedOp struct {\n\tat    int64\n\twrite bool\n\tidx   int // plan index, used in ReqID/RID\n}\n\n// inflight tracks one outstanding write or read.\ntype inflight struct {\n\tkey      string\n\treqID    string\n\tvalue    string\n\twrite    bool\n\tattempts int\n\tto       string // current target node (internal id)\n\tissueTick int64\n\ttid      int64\n\t// read bookkeeping\n\treadVer   int\n\treadVal   string\n\treadFound bool\n\tgotResp   bool\n\t// readSeen counts distinct responders (by node id) for this read attempt;\n\t// a not-found is accepted only when every dual-read target answered\n\t// not-found, so a single lost old-owner answer can never surface as empty.\n\treadSeen map[string]bool\n\treadWant int\n}\n\ntype client struct {\n\tcfg  ClientCfg\n\taid  string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\tplan    []plannedOp\n\tinflight map[string]*inflight\n\tmaxRetry int\n}\n\nfunc newClient(cfg ClientCfg, w *world) *client {\n\tc := &client{\n\t\tcfg: cfg, aid: clientID(cfg.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\tcurrent: w.rings[0],\n\t\tinflight: map[string]*inflight{},\n\t\tmaxRetry: w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves generation on ties).\n\tsort.SliceStable(plan, func(i, j int) bool { return plan[i].at < plan[j].at })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.aid }\n\nfunc (c *client) valueFor(planIdx int) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"v:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase *TopologyAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"TopologyAck\", From: c.aid, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &TopologyAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tr, err := ring.New(b.Version, c.w.nodeSpecs(b.Nodes), c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.Pending {\n\t\t\tc.pending = r\n\t\t} else if c.current.Version < b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = r\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *CommitAnnounce:\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"CommitAck\", From: c.aid, To: m.From, Seq: m.Seq, Body: &CommitAck{Version: b.Version}})\n\t\tif c.pending != nil && c.pending.Version == b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = c.pending\n\t\t\tc.pending = nil\n\t\t}\n\tcase *WriteAck:\n\t\tc.onWriteAck(b)\n\tcase *ReadResp:\n\t\tc.onReadResp(m.From, b)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) timer(kind string, data any) {\n\tswitch kind {\n\tcase \"issue\":\n\t\tp := data.(plannedOp)\n\t\tif p.write {\n\t\t\tc.startWrite(p.idx)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tc.startRead(p.idx)\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wretry\":\n\t\tc.retryWrite(data.(string))\n\tcase \"rretry\":\n\t\tc.retryRead(data.(string))\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- writes -------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfunc (c *client) startWrite(planIdx int) {\n\tkey := c.w.keyFor(c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\treqID := fmt.Sprintf(\"w:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n\tval := c.valueFor(planIdx)\n\tc.w.stats.WritesIssued++\n\tinf := &inflight{key: key, reqID: reqID, value: val, write: true, attempts: 1,\n\t\tissueTick: c.eng.tick(), to: nodeID(c.current.Owner(key))}\n\tc.inflight[reqID] = inf\n\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", reqID)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) sendWrite(inf *inflight) {\n\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"WriteReq\", From: c.aid, To: inf.to, Seq: c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\tBody: &WriteReq{Key: inf.key, Value: inf.value, ReqID: inf.reqID}})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onWriteAck(a *WriteAck) {\n\tinf := c.inflight[a.ReqID]\n\tif inf == nil {\n\t\treturn // already completed, duplicated ack\n\t}\n\tif a.Redirect != \"\" {\n\t\t// Migration bounce: follow to the new owner, same request id.\n\t\tc.eng.cancelTimer(inf.tid)\n\t\tinf.to = a.Redirect\n\t\tinf.attempts++\n\t\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\t\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := It observes every local\n// apply, every ack and every read answer; the verification pass uses it to\n// judge the storage nodes, never the reverse — storage code cannot \"win\" an\n// argument by writing here.\ntype Ledger struct {\n\t// applied versions per key, keyed by version.\n\tapplied map[string]map[int]Record\n\tlatest   map[string]Record\n\tconfirmed map[string]ConfirmedWrite // reqID -> write\n\treads     []ReadObservation\n}\n\nfunc newLedger() *Ledger {\n\treturn &Ledger{\n\t\tapplied:   map[string]map[int]Record{},\n\t\tlatest:    map[string]Record{},\n\t\tconfirmed: map[string]ConfirmedWrite{},\n\t}\n}\n\n// applied is called whenever a node commits a write to its local store.\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteApply(key, reqID string, ver int, value string, node string, tick int64) {\n\tif l.applied[key] == nil {\n\t\tl.applied[key] = map[int]Record{}\n\t}\n\trec := Record{Ver: ver, Value: value, ReqID: reqID, AtTick: tick, Node: node}\n\tl.applied[key][ver] = rec\n\tif cur, ok := l.latest[key]; !ok || ver > cur.Ver {\n\t\tl.latest[key] = rec\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteConfirm(reqID string, cw ConfirmedWrite) {\n\tif _, ok := l.confirmed[reqID]; ok {\n\t\treturn // duplicate ack delivery must not double-count\n\t}\n\tl.confirmed[reqID] = cw\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) { l.reads = append(l.reads, r) }\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) latestRecord(key string) (Record, bool) {\n\tr, ok := l.latest[key]\n\treturn r, ok\n}\n\n// confirmedAt returns the highest version whose ack was observed no later than\n// tick — the lower bound a read answer at that time must meet.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedAt(key string, tick int64) int {\n\tbest := 0\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tif c.Key != key || c.ConfirmedTick > tick {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.Ver > best {\n\t\t\tbest = c.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\n// confirmedWrites returns confirmed writes sorted deterministically.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedList() []ConfirmedWrite {\n\tout := make([]ConfirmedWrite, 0, len(l.confirmed))\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tout = append(out, c)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].Key != out[j].Key {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].Key < out[j].Key\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].Ver < out[j].Ver\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":70,"oldLines":7,"newStart":70,"newLines":19,"lines":["   l.confirmed[reqID] = cw"," }"," ","-func (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) { l.reads = append(l.reads, r) }","+func (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) {","+  // Deduplicate identical observations (a read resolving on a retry timer can","+  // otherwise be recorded more than once), keyed by client/key/issue/resp.","+  key := r.Client + \"\\x00\" + r.Key","+  for i := len(l.reads) - 1; !ok || ver > cur.Ver {\n\t\tl.latest[key] = rec\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteConfirm(reqID string, cw ConfirmedWrite) {\n\tif _, ok := l.confirmed[reqID]; ok {\n\t\treturn // duplicate ack delivery must not double-count\n\t}\n\tl.confirmed[reqID] = cw\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) {\n\t// Deduplicate identical observations (a read resolving on a retry timer can\n\t// otherwise be recorded more than once), keyed by client/key/issue/resp.\n\n\tfor i := len(l.reads) - 1; i >= 0 && i >= len(l.reads)-4; i-- {\n\t\tp := l.reads[i]\n\t\tif p.Client == r.Client && p.Key == r.Key && p.IssueTick == r.IssueTick && p.RespTick == r.RespTick {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tl.reads = append(l.reads, r)\n}\n\nfunc (l *Ledger) latestRecord(key string) (Record, bool) {\n\tr, ok := l.latest[key]\n\treturn r, ok\n}\n\n// confirmedAt returns the highest version whose ack was observed no later than\n// tick — the lower bound a read answer at that time must meet.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedAt(key string, tick int64) int {\n\tbest := 0\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tif c.Key != key || c.ConfirmedTick > tick {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif c.Ver > best {\n\t\t\tbest = c.Ver\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\n// confirmedWrites returns confirmed writes sorted deterministically.\nfunc (l *Ledger) confirmedList() []ConfirmedWrite {\n\tout := make([]ConfirmedWrite, 0, len(l.confirmed))\n\tfor _, c := range l.confirmed {\n\t\tout = append(out, c)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\tif out[i].Key != out[j].Key {\n\t\t\treturn out[i].Key < out[j].Key\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn out[i].Ver < out[j].Ver\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":71,"oldLines":16,"newStart":71,"newLines":20,"lines":[" }"," "," func (l *Ledger) noteRead(r ReadObservation) {","-  // Deduplicate identical observations (a read resolving on a retry timer can","-  // otherwise be recorded more than once), keyed by client/key/issue/resp.","-","-  for i := len(l.reads) - 1; if at least one target returned the record, take the greatest version;\n\t//  - accept not-found only when every queried owner answered not-found;\n\t//  - reject the result if it is below the client's current monotonic-read\n\t//    floor, even when that answer looked fresh when it arrived: another\n\t//    overlapping read on the same client may have raised the floor while\n\t//    this read was still in flight.\n\tallAnswered := len(inf.readSeen) >= inf.readWant\n\tfloor := c.readFloor[inf.key]\n\tstaleByFloor := inf.readFound && inf.readVer < floor\n\tacceptEmpty := allAnswered && !inf.readFound && inf.readStale == 0\n\tif (inf.readFound && !staleByFloor) || acceptEmpty {","originalFile":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"chmig/ring\"\n)\n\nfunc clientID(raw string) string { return \"client:\" + raw }\n\ntype plannedOp struct {\n\tat    int64\n\twrite bool\n\tidx   int // plan index, used in ReqID/RID\n}\n\n// inflight tracks one outstanding write or read.\ntype inflight struct {\n\tkey      string\n\treqID    string\n\tvalue    string\n\twrite    bool\n\tattempts int\n\tto       string // current target node (internal id)\n\tissueTick int64\n\ttid      int64\n\t// read bookkeeping\n\treadVer   int\n\treadVal   string\n\treadFound bool\n\tgotResp   bool\n\t// readSeen counts distinct responders (by node id) for this read attempt;\n\t// a not-found is accepted only when every dual-read target answered\n\t// not-found, so a single lost old-owner answer can never surface as empty.\n\treadSeen  map[string]bool\n\treadWant  int\n\treadStale int // answers rejected for being below the read watermark\n}\n\ntype client struct {\n\tcfg  ClientCfg\n\taid  string\n\teng  *Engine\n\tw    *world\n\n\tcurrent *ring.Ring\n\tpending *ring.Ring\n\n\tplan    []plannedOp\n\tinflight map[string]*inflight\n\t// readFloor is this client's per-key monotonic-read watermark: the highest\n\t// version it has ever observed for the key. Answers below it are rejected\n\t// (the client re-reads), so a single stale replica can never move a read\n\t// backwards after a newer value was observed.\n\treadFloor map[string]int\n\tmaxRetry int\n}\n\nfunc newClient(cfg ClientCfg, w *world) *client {\n\tc := &client{\n\t\tcfg: cfg, aid: clientID(cfg.ID), eng: w.eng, w: w,\n\t\tcurrent: w.rings[0],\n\t\tinflight: map[string]*inflight{},\n\t\treadFloor: map[string]int{},\n\t\tmaxRetry: w.maxClientAttempts(),\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic workload plan, drawn from a per-client RNG derived from the\n\t// master seed so network scheduling can never perturb the workload.\n\tops := cfg.Writes\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\t// Roughly one read per ReadEvery writes; total slots ~ writes*(1+1/ReadEvery).\n\t}\n\ttotal := ops\n\tif cfg.ReadEvery > 0 {\n\t\ttotal = ops + ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t}\n\trng := w.clientRNG(cfg.ID)\n\tplan := make([]plannedOp, 0, total)\n\tslot := 0\n\twritesPlanned := 0\n\treadsPlanned := 0\n\tfor writesPlanned < ops {\n\t\tisRead := cfg.ReadEvery > 0 && (slot+1)%(cfg.ReadEvery+1) == 0 && readsPlanned < ops/cfg.ReadEvery\n\t\tat := int64(cfg.StartTick)\n\t\tif cfg.EndTick > cfg.StartTick && total > 1 {\n\t\t\tat += int64(rng.Intn(cfg.EndTick - cfg.StartTick + 1))\n\t\t}\n\t\tplan = append(plan, plannedOp{at: at, write: !isRead, idx: slot})\n\t\tif isRead {\n\t\t\treadsPlanned++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\twritesPlanned++\n\t\t}\n\t\tslot++\n\t}\n\t// Deterministic order by time (stable preserves generation on ties).\n\tsort.SliceStable(plan, func(i, j int) bool { return plan[i].at < plan[j].at })\n\tc.plan = plan\n\tfor _, p := range plan {\n\t\tpp := p\n\t\tw.eng.after(pp.at, c, \"issue\", pp)\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) id() string { return c.aid }\n\nfunc (c *client) valueFor(planIdx int) string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"v:%s:%d\", c.cfg.ID, planIdx)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) receive(m *Msg) {\n\tswitch b := m.Body.(type) {\n\tcase c.w.cfg.VNodes)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.Pending {\n\t\t\tc.pending = r\n\t\t} else if c.current.Version < b.Version {\n\t\t\tc.current = r\n\t\t\tc.pending = a.ReqID)\n\tc.w.stats.WritesConfirmed++\n\tc.w.ledger.noteConfirm(a.ReqID, ConfirmedWrite{\n\t\tKey: a.Key, Ver: a.Ver, Value: a.Value, ConfirmedTick: c.eng.tick(),\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) retryWrite(reqID string) {\n\tinf, ok := c.inflight[reqID]\n\tif !ok {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tinf.attempts++\n\tif inf.attempts > c.maxRetry {\n\t\tdelete(c.inflight, reqID)\n\t\tc.w.stats.WritesFailed++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// Re-target on the freshest view in case topology moved while we waited.\n\tif c.pending != nil {\n\t\t// Prefer the new owner only once it is known to serve; otherwise keep\n\t\t// hitting the current owner and follow its redirects.\n\t}\n\tc.sendWrite(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"wretry\", reqID)\n}\n\n// inf\n\tc.sendRead(inf)\n\tinf.tid = c.eng.after(int64(c.w.cfg.RetryTicks), c, \"rretry\", rid)\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) readTargets(key string) []string {\n\tt := nodeID(c.current.Owner(key))\n\tif c.pending != nil {\n\t\tif n2 := nodeID(c.pending.Owner(key)); n2 != t {\n\t\t\treturn []string{t, n2} // dual read: old + new owner\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn []string{t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) sendRead(inf *inflight) {\n\ttargets := c.readTargets(inf.key)\n\tinf.readWant = len(targets)\n\tfor _, t := range targets {\n\t\tc.eng.send(&Msg{Type: \"ReadReq\", From: c.aid, To: t, Seq: c.w.newSeq(),\n\t\t\tBody: &ReadReq{RID: inf.reqID, Key: inf.key}})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *client) onReadResp(from string, r *ReadResp) {\n\tinf := c.inflight[r.RID]\n\tif inf == nil || It gives every migration real snapshot\n35\t\t// data to move and makes the transferred-volume statistics meaningful.\n36\t\tPreload    bool        `json:\"preload\"`\n37\t\tClients    []ClientCfg `json:\"clients\"`\n38\t\tOperations []OpCfg     `json:\"operations\"`\n39\t}\n40\t\n41\t// NodeCfg configures one initial physical node.\n42\ttype NodeCfg struct {\n43\t\tID     string `json:\"id\"`\n44\t\tWeight int    `json:\"weight\"`\n45\t}\n46\t\n47\t// ClientCfg configures one client actor and the write stream it generates.\n48\ttype ClientCfg struct {\n49\t\tID string `json:\"id\"`\n50\t\t// Writes is the total number of writes this client issues.\n51\t\tWrites int `json:\"writes\"`\n52\t\t// StartTick / EndTick bound the uniform spread of issue times.\n53\t\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n54\t\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n55\t\t// ReadEvery: issue a read every Nth operation slot (0 disables reads).\n56\t\tReadEvery int `json:\"readEvery\"`\n57\t}\n58\t\n59\t// OpCfg is one timed topology / failure operation.\n60\t//\n61\t// Kind:\n62\t//   - \"scaleOut\": Add lists nodes joining the ring.\n63\t//   - \"scaleIn\":  Remove lists nodes leaving; the simulator refuses to remove\n64\t//     a node until every key it owned has crossed the barrier.\n65\t//   - \"interrupt\": establish a directed network blackhole between all\n66\t//     migration (node-to-node) traffic during [Tick, EndTick).\n67\t//     Client/control traffic is unaffected, so the migration\n68\t//     protocol's retransmission can be observed recovering.\n69\ttype OpCfg struct {\n70\t\tKind    string    `json:\"kind\"`\n71\t\tTick    int       `json:\"tick\"`\n72\t\tEndTick int       `json:\"endTick\"` // interrupt only\n73\t\tAdd     []NodeCfg `json:\"add\"`     // scaleOut\n74\t\tRemove  []string  `json:\"remove\"`  // scaleIn\n75\t}\n76\t\n77\t// Report is the JSON result of a run.\n78\ttype Report struct {\n79\t\tSeed           int64             `json:\"seed\"`\n80\t\tStopTick       int               `json:\"stopTick\"`\n81\t\tFinalRing      []NodeView        `json:\"finalRing\"`\n82\t\tRemovedNodes   []string          `json:\"removedNodes\"`\n83\t\tInterruption   *InterruptionView `json:\"interruption,omitempty\"`\n84\t\tTopologyEpochs []EpochView       `json:\"topologyEpochs\"`\n85\t\tStats          Stats             `json:\"stats\"`\n86\t\t// MigrationBytes is the number of key-record payload bytes applied at a\n87\t\t// destination node as part of migration (snapshot/forward stream), summed\n88\t\t// over every migration. Each migrated version is counted once.\n89\t\tMigration     MigrationReport `json:\"migration\"`\n90\t\tVerifications Verifications   `json:\"verifications\"`\n91\t}\n92\t\n93\t// NodeView is a node's weight and the keys it stores at end of run.\n94\ttype NodeView struct {\n95\t\tID     string   `json:\"id\"`\n96\t\tWeight int      `json:\"weight\"`\n97\t\tKeys   []string `json:\"keys\"`\n98\t}\n99\t\n100\t// EpochView records one ring epoch and when it became authoritative.\n101\ttype EpochView struct {\n102\t\tVersion  int      `json:\"version\"`\n103\t\tNodes    []string `json:\"nodes\"`\n104\t\tBeganAt  int      `json:\"beganAt\"`\n105\t\tCommitAt int      `json:\"commitAt\"`\n106\t}\n107\t\n108\t// InterruptionView records a simulated blackhole window.\n109\ttype InterruptionView struct {\n110\t\tStartTick int `json:\"startTick\"`\n111\t\tEndTick   int `json:\"endTick\"`\n112\t}\n113\t\n114\t// Stats holds network and workload counters.\n115\ttype Stats struct {\n116\t\tMessagesSent       int `json:\"messagesSent\"`\n117\t\tMessagesDelivered  int `json:\"messagesDelivered\"`\n118\t\tMessagesDropped    int `json:\"messagesDropped\"`\n119\t\tMessagesDuplicated int `json:\"messagesDuplicated\"`\n120\t\tMessagesReordered  int `json:\"messagesReordered\"`\n121\t\tBytesDelivered     int `json:\"bytesDelivered\"`\n122\t\tWritesIssued       int `json:\"writesIssued\"`\n123\t\tWritesConfirmed    int `json:\"writesConfirmed\"`\n124\t\tWritesFailed       int `json:\"writesFailed\"` // exhausted retries\n125\t\tReadsIssued        int `json:\"readsIssued\"`\n126\t\tReadsSucceeded     int `json:\"readsSucceeded\"`\n127\t\tReadsFailed        int `json:\"readsFailed\"`\n128\t}\n129\t\n130\t// MigrationReport quantifies the migration.\n131\ttype MigrationReport struct {\n132\t\t// KeysMoved is the number of keys whose owner changed across COMMITTED\n133\t\t// epochs. KeysMoved <= KeysSwitched.\n138\t\tKeysSwitched int `json:\"keysSwitched\"`\n139\t\t// EpochsCommitted is the number of topology epochs that reached commit.\n140\t\tEpochsCommitted int `json:\"epochsCommitted\"`\n141\t\t// RecordVersionsTransferred counts every record version applied at the new\n142\t\t// owner through snapshot/forward streams across committed migrations.\n143\t\tRecordVersionsTransferred int `json:\"recordVersionsTransferred\"`\n144\t\t// BytesTransferred sums payload sizes of the transferred record versions.\n145\t\tBytesTransferred int `json:\"bytesTransferred\"`\n146\t\t// BytesMoved counts each migrated key's final record payload once: the\n147\t\t// minimum data movement the migration cannot avoid.\n148\t\tBytesMoved int `json:\"bytesMoved\"`\n149\t\t// OverheadBytes is BytesTransferred - {"parentUuid":"1acffb5b-148d-48cb-836e-1f080d7961bc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_6bus3z10pnyeadsmu5e01k9u","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/README.md","content":"# chmig — 带虚拟节点与权重的一致性哈希在线迁移模拟器\n\n纯后端、单进程、**确定性离散事件模拟器**，用于验证一致性哈希环在**扩容、并发写入、\n节点移除（缩容）和迁移中断**下的正确性。没有真实网络、没有 goroutine、没有真实\n集群：所有\"节点\"都是同一进程内的 actor，所有消息都经过一个可注入**丢包 / 重复 /\n乱序 / 黑洞**的模拟网络；相同配置 + 相同随机种子必然产生相同结果。\n\n## 它验证什么\n\n1. **带权重和虚拟节点的一致性哈希环**（`ring` 包）：FNV-1a + splitmix64 雪崩化，\n   权重按比例分配虚拟节点；新增一个节点只迁移约 `1/(N+1)` 的键。\n2. **在线迁移协议**（`sim` 包）：旧属主 A 对每个迁出键走\n   `BEGIN → SNAPSHOT → FORWARD(并发写) → 切换屏障 BARRIER → COMMIT`。\n3. **迁移期双读、单一版本决胜**：客户端同时读旧/新属主，取**版本号最大**的应答；\n   并带每客户端单调读水位线，绝不接受比已见过版本更旧的结果。\n4. **切换屏障（switch barrier）**：A 在屏障点冻结该键，B 必须连续应用到冻结点之前的\n   全部前向写并回 ACK；屏障通过但未 COMMIT 前，A/B **都不确认**新写——这保证中断时\n   已确认数据仍只在权威属主上。\n5. **节点移除安全闸门**：缩容提交前，控制器逐键证明被移除节点已不持有任何键的最新\n   记录、存活属主已持有该最新版本；闸门不通过则拒绝提交、拒绝下线该节点。\n6. 端到端五项不变量（见报告 `verifications`）。\n\n## 目录\n\n```\nring/                 一致性哈希环（不可变拓扑视图、Diff）\nsim/                  事件引擎、模拟网络、节点/客户端协议、账本与验证、JSON 类型\ncmd/chmig/            JSON 配置 → JSON 报告 的命令行入口\nexamples/             三个验收场景的请求样例\n```\n\n## 快速开始\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...                 # 全部自动化测试（环性质 + 模拟场景 + 多种子压测）\n\n# 三个验收场景（-strict：任一校验失败则退出码非 0）\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json     -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scalein.json      -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/interrupted.json\n```\n\n也可从标准输入读配置：\n\n```bash\ncat examples/scaleout.json | go run ./cmd/chmig -in -\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json -out report.json\n```\n\n## 迁移协议（单进程模拟）\n\n对每个属主发生变化的键，由控制器（`ctrl`）编排：\n\n```\nctrl ──BEGIN(key)──────────▶ A(旧属主)\nA    ──SNAPSHOT(ver,value,幂等表)──▶ B(新属主)\nA    ──FORWARD(seq, ver, value)───▶ B   # 迁移窗口内到达 A 的每个写，应用后立即前传\nctrl ──BARRIER(key, upTo)──▶ A          # A 冻结该键，不再本地应用/确认\nA    ──MIG_BARRIER(upTo)────▶ B\nB    连续应用到 seq=upTo 后 ──MIG_BARRIER_ACK──▶ A\nA    ──BARRIER_DONE─────────▶ ctrl\nctrl 收齐全部键 ── COMMIT(新环) ──▶ 所有节点/客户端（可靠重传直到全部 ACK）\n     COMMIT 后 B 才落盘并确认屏障期间缓冲的写；A 删除迁移态\n缩容时：COMMIT 后 ctrl 再发 DECOMMISSION，存活属主通过移除闸门才允许节点下线\n```\n\n关键安全性质：\n\n- **幂等**：每条客户端写有全局唯一 `ReqID`；节点按 `ReqID` 去重，重传/重复投递/\n  迁移后重试都不会重复应用。幂等应答按**该版本**取值，绝不串用更新版本的值。\n- **单调版本**：每个键在属主上的版本号严格 +1；快照/前传携带版本链，B 按序号连续\n  应用，乱序到达先缓冲。\n- **屏障即边界**：冻结后到 COMMIT 之间，A 只重定向、B 只缓冲，**双方都不确认**新写。\n  因此迁移在 COMMIT 前被打断时，未决写全部\"未确认\"，而已确认写只在旧权威属主上——\n  不会出现\"已确认数据仅存在于即将消失的节点\"。\n- **陈旧消息隔离**：已提交 epoch 的迟到 SNAPSHOT/FORWARD/BARRIER 会被节点直接忽略，\n  不会用旧值回退已提交存储。\n\n## JSON 运行接口\n\n### 请求（Config）\n\n见 `examples/*.json`。主要字段：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子；决定网络丢包/延迟与客户端选键，保证可复现 |\n| `vnodesPerWeight` | 权重 1 对应的虚拟节点数 |\n| `preload` | tick 0 给每个键写一条种子记录，使迁移有真实快照数据、迁移量可统计 `migrationConcurrency` | 单个旧属主并发迁移键的调度上限（错峰开始） |\n| `barrierTicks` | BEGIN 到冻结屏障的窗口长度 |\n| `drainTicks` / `stopTick` | 收尾时长；`stopTick=0` 时用 `最后操作tick+drainTicks` |\n| `initialNodes[]` | 初始加权节点 `{id, weight}` |\n| `keys[]` | 键的全集（最终归属按全集校验） |\n| `clients[]` | 客户端写流 `{id, writes, startTick, endTick, readEvery}` |\n| `operations[]` | 定时操作，见下 |\n\n`operations[].kind`：\n\n- `scaleOut`：`{tick, add:[{id,weight}]}`，新节点加入并触发迁移。\n- `scaleIn`：`{tick, remove:[id]}`，节点离开；受移除安全闸门保护。\n- `interrupt`：`{tick, endTick}`，在该时间窗内**黑洞所有节点间迁移流量**\n  （`Mig*` 消息），但客户端/控制流量照常——用于观察重传恢复与\"未提交不丢数据\"。\n\n### 响应（Report）\n\n- `finalRing[]`：最终权威环及每个在线节点实际持有的键。\n- `removedNodes[]`：已安全下线的节点。\n- `topologyEpochs[]`：每个环版本的开始/提交时刻；未提交的 epoch `commitAt=0`。\n- `stats`：报文收发/丢弃/重复/乱序、字节数、读写 issued/confirmed/failed。\n- chmig — 带虚拟节点与权重的一致性哈希在线迁移模拟器\n\n纯后端、单进程、**确定性离散事件模拟器**，用于验证一致性哈希环在**扩容、并发写入、\n节点移除（缩容）和迁移中断**下的正确性。没有真实网络、没有 goroutine、没有真实\n集群：所有\"节点\"都是同一进程内的 actor，所有消息都经过一个可注入**丢包 / 重复 /\n乱序 / 黑洞**的模拟网络；相同配置 + 相同随机种子必然产生相同结果。\n\n## 它验证什么\n\n1. **带权重和虚拟节点的一致性哈希环**（`ring` 包）：FNV-1a + splitmix64 雪崩化，\n   权重按比例分配虚拟节点；新增一个节点只迁移约 `1/(N+1)` 的键。\n2. **在线迁移协议**（`sim` 包）：旧属主 A 对每个迁出键走\n   `BEGIN → SNAPSHOT → FORWARD(并发写) → 切换屏障 BARRIER → COMMIT`。\n3. **迁移期双读、单一版本决胜**：客户端同时读旧/新属主，取**版本号最大**的应答；\n   并带每客户端单调读水位线，绝不接受比已见过版本更旧的结果。\n4. **切换屏障（switch barrier）**：A 在屏障点冻结该键，B 必须连续应用到冻结点之前的\n   全部前向写并回 ACK；屏障通过但未 COMMIT 前，A/B **都不确认**新写——这保证中断时\n   已确认数据仍只在权威属主上。\n5. **节点移除安全闸门**：缩容提交前，控制器逐键证明被移除节点已不持有任何键的最新\n   记录、存活属主已持有该最新版本；闸门不通过则拒绝提交、拒绝下线该节点。\n6. 端到端五项不变量（见报告 `verifications`）。\n\n## 目录\n\n```\nring/                 一致性哈希环（不可变拓扑视图、Diff）\nsim/                  事件引擎、模拟网络、节点/客户端协议、账本与验证、JSON 类型\ncmd/chmig/            JSON 配置 → JSON 报告 的命令行入口\nexamples/             三个验收场景的请求样例\n```\n\n## 快速开始\n\n需要 Go 1.22+，无第三方依赖。\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...                 # 全部自动化测试（环性质 + 模拟场景 + 多种子压测）\n\n# 三个验收场景（-strict：任一校验失败则退出码非 0）\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json     -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scalein.json      -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/interrupted.json\n```\n\n也可从标准输入读配置：\n\n```bash\ncat examples/scaleout.json | go run ./cmd/chmig -in -\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json -out report.json\n```\n\n## 迁移协议（单进程模拟）\n\n对每个属主发生变化的键，由控制器（`ctrl`）编排：\n\n```\nctrl ──BEGIN(key)──────────▶ A(旧属主)\nA    ──SNAPSHOT(ver,value,幂等表)──▶ B(新属主)\nA    ──FORWARD(seq, ver, value)───▶ B   # 迁移窗口内到达 A 的每个写，应用后立即前传\nctrl ──BARRIER(key, upTo)──▶ A          # A 冻结该键，不再本地应用/确认\nA    ──MIG_BARRIER(upTo)────▶ B\nB    连续应用到 seq=upTo 后 ──MIG_BARRIER_ACK──▶ A\nA    ──BARRIER_DONE─────────▶ ctrl\nctrl 收齐全部键 ── COMMIT(新环) ──▶ 所有节点/客户端（可靠重传直到全部 ACK）\n     COMMIT 后 B 才落盘并确认屏障期间缓冲的写；A 删除迁移态\n缩容时：COMMIT 后 ctrl 再发 DECOMMISSION，存活属主通过移除闸门才允许节点下线\n```\n\n关键安全性质：\n\n- `migrationConcurrency` | 单个旧属主并发迁移键的调度上限（错峰开始） |\n| `barrierTicks` | BEGIN 到冻结屏障的窗口长度 |\n| `drainTicks` / `stopTick` | 收尾时长；`stopTick=0` 时用 `最后操作tick+drainTicks` |\n| `initialNodes[]` | 初始加权节点 `{id, examples/scaleout.json -out report.json\n```\n\n## 迁移协议（单进程模拟）\n\n对每个属主发生变化的键，由控制器（`ctrl`）编排：\n\n```\nctrl ──BEGIN(key)──────────▶ A(旧属主)\nA    ──SNAPSHOT(ver,value,幂等表)──▶ B(新属主)\nA    ──FORWARD(seq, ver, value)───▶ B   # 迁移窗口内到达 A 的每个写，应用后立即前传\nctrl ──BARRIER(key, upTo)──▶ A          # A 冻结该键，不再本地应用/确认\nA    ──MIG_BARRIER(upTo)────▶ B\nB    连续应用到 seq=upTo 后 ──MIG_BARRIER_ACK──▶ A\nA    ──BARRIER_DONE─────────▶ ctrl\nctrl 收齐全部键 ── COMMIT(新环) ──▶ 所有节点/客户端（可靠重传直到全部 ACK）\n     COMMIT 后 B 才落盘并确认屏障期间缓冲的写；A 删除迁移态\n缩容时：COMMIT 后 ctrl 再发 DECOMMISSION，存活属主通过移除闸门才允许节点下线\n```\n\n关键安全性质：\n\n- **幂等**：每条客户端写有全局唯一 `ReqID`；节点按 `ReqID` 去重，重传/重复投递/\n  迁移后重试都不会重复应用。幂等应答按**该版本**取值，绝不串用更新版本的值。\n- **单调版本**：每个键在属主上的版本号严格 +1；快照/前传携带版本链，B 按序号连续\n  应用，乱序到达先缓冲。\n- **屏障即边界**：冻结后到 COMMIT 之间，A 只重定向、B 只缓冲，**双方都不确认**新写。\n  因此迁移在 COMMIT 前被打断时，未决写全部\"未确认\"，而已确认写只在旧权威属主上——\n  不会出现\"已确认数据仅存在于即将消失的节点\"。\n- **陈旧消息隔离**：已提交 epoch 的迟到 SNAPSHOT/FORWARD/BARRIER 会被节点直接忽略，\n  不会用旧值回退已提交存储。\n\n## JSON 运行接口\n\n### 请求（Config）\n\n见 `examples/*.json`。主要字段：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子；决定网络丢包/延迟与客户端选键，保证可复现 |\n| `vnodesPerWeight` | 权重 1 对应的虚拟节点数 |\n| `preload` | tick 0 给每个键写一条种子记录，使迁移有真实快照数据、迁移量可统计 |\n| `lossRate` / `duplicateRate` / `reorderRate` | 每包独立的丢包 / 重复 / 乱序概率，范围 `[0,1)` |\n| `minLinkDelay` / `maxLinkDelay` | 单向投递随机延迟（tick） |\n| `retryTicks` | 客户端请求与迁移控制消息的重传间隔 |\n| `migrationConcurrency` | 单个旧属主并发迁移键的调度上限（错峰开始） |\n| `barrierTicks` | BEGIN 到冻结屏障的窗口长度 |\n| `drainTicks` / `stopTick` | 收尾时长；`stopTick=0` 时用 `最后操作tick+drainTicks` |\n| `initialNodes[]` | 初始加权节点 `{id, weight}` |\n| `keys[]` | 键的全集（最终归属按全集校验） |\n| `clients[]` | 客户端写流 `{id, writes, startTick, endTick, readEvery}` |\n| `operations[]` | 定时操作，见下 |\n\n`operations[].kind`：\n\n- `scaleOut`：`{tick, add:[{id,weight}]}`，新节点加入并触发迁移。\n- `scaleIn`：`{tick, remove:[id]}`，节点离开；受移除安全闸门保护。\n- `interrupt`：`{tick, endTick}`，在该时间窗内**黑洞所有节点间迁移流量**\n  （`Mig*` 消息），但客户端/控制流量照常——用于观察重传恢复与\"未提交不丢数据\"。\n\n### 响应（Report）\n\n- `finalRing[]`：最终权威环及每个在线节点实际持有的键。\n- `removedNodes[]`：已安全下线的节点。\n- `topologyEpochs[]`：每个环版本的开始/提交时刻；未提交的 epoch `commitAt=0`。\n- `stats`：报文收发/丢弃/重复/乱序、字节数、读写 issued/confirmed/failed。\n- `migration`：迁移量统计，见下。\n- `verifications`：五项端到端校验，全部 `pass:true` 才算通过。\n\n迁移量字段：\n\n| 字段 | 含义 |\n|---|---|\n| `keysMoved` | 在**已提交** epoch 中改主的键数（中断未提交不计入） |\n| `keysSwitched` | 屏障已通过的键数（可能含未提交 epoch），`keysMoved ≤ keysSwitched` |\n| `epochsCommitted` | 成功提交的拓扑版本数 |\n| `recordVersionsTransferred` | 经快照/前传在新属主落盘的记录版本总数 |\n| `bytesTransferred` | 上述版本的净荷字节总数 |\n| `bytesMoved` | 每个迁出键最终记录净荷各计一次：不可避免的最小迁移量 |\n| `overheadBytes` | `bytesTransferred - bytesMoved`：迁移窗口内并发写带来的额外前传 |\n| `movements[]` | 每个键的 `from/to/ringVersion/beganAt/switchedAt/committed` |\n\n五项校验：\n\n1. `ownership`：每个曾被写入的键物理存在于最终环的属主上。\n2. `version`：属主持有的是全局账本记录的最新版本与正确值（单一版本决胜）。\n3. `confirmedWritesSurvive`：每条收到 ACK 的写在最终属主上以其版本（或更新链）存在。\n4. `removalSafety`：被移除节点不持有任何键的唯一最新副本（闸门 + 事后复核）。\n5. `noStaleReadAccepted`：单调读（同客户端不见版本倒退）且返回的 `(版本,值)` 真实存在。\n\n## 确定性\n\n- 单一逻辑时钟 + 按 `(时刻, 入队序号)` 排序的最小堆事件队列，单线程执行。\n- 工作负载由\"主种子派生的每客户端 RNG\"在装配阶段一次性生成，网络调度不会扰动负载。\n- `TestDeterminism` 断言同一配置两次运行的 JSON 报告逐字节一致。\n\n## 已知边界（模拟范围之外）\n\n- 副本因子固定为 1（RF-1）；不建模持久化磁盘、真实 TCP、跨进程故障恢复。\n- 不实现读仲裁多数派；读一致性通过双读取最高版本 + 客户端单调水位线实现。\n- `interrupt` 只黑洞节点间迁移流量（刻意保留控制/客户端面，以观察协议自愈）。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c1b803bc-6368-483d-a093-5050fdfa5b6a","session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}

{"parentUuid":"160b4af3-a084-4da6-a45a-2193475018e7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_hvgs6xs56kd8kpm2fe3zf0ig","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b/examples/README.md","content":"# 请求样例\n\n三个场景的 JSON 请求文件就在本目录，可直接作为 `chmig -in` 的输入：\n\n| 文件 | 场景 | 关键观察点 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `scaleout.json` | 3 节点(权重 1:1:2) → 加入权重 2 的 n4，迁移窗内并发写入，并叠加一次迁移流量黑洞 | 约 1/4 键迁移；黑洞靠重传自愈；COMMIT 后版本与归属正确 |\n| `scalein.json` | 4 节点 → 移除 n2，叠加迁移黑洞与并发写 | n2 只有在全部键过屏障、存活属主持有最新版本后才下线 |\n| `interrupted.json` | 扩容迁移窗内持续黑洞到模拟结束 | epoch 不提交、迁移量计 0，但已确认写零丢失、最终仍归旧属主 |\n\n运行：\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json     -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scalein.json      -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/interrupted.json          # 故意中断，不用 -strict 判失败\n```\n\n---\n\n## 样例 1：扩容（scaleout.json，节选）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"seed\": 42,\n  \"vnodesPerWeight\": 64,\n  \"preload\": true,\n  \"lossRate\": 0.05,\n  \"duplicateRate\": 0.02,\n  \"reorderRate\": 0.02,\n  \"minLinkDelay\": 1,\n  \"maxLinkDelay\": 3,\n  \"retryTicks\": 20,\n  \"migrationConcurrency\": 8,\n  \"barrierTicks\": 30,\n  \"drainTicks\": 400,\n  \"initialNodes\": [\n    {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 1},\n    {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 1},\n    {\"id\": \"n3\", \"weight\": 2}\n  ],\n  \"keys\": [\"user:0001\", \"user:0002\", \"...\"],\n  \"clients\": [\n    {\"id\": \"c1\", \"writes\": 120, \"startTick\": 5, \"endTick\": 220, \"readEvery\": 4},\n    {\"id\": \"c2\", \"writes\": 120, \"startTick\": 10, \"endTick\": 240, \"readEvery\": 5}\n  ],\n  \"operations\": [\n    {\"kind\": \"scaleOut\", \"tick\": 60, \"add\": [{\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}]},\n    {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 90, \"endTick\": 130}\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n响应（节选）：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 0, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n2\",\"n3\"], \"beganAt\": 0,   \"commitAt\": 0},\n    {\"version\": 1, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n2\",\"n3\",\"n4\"], \"beganAt\": 60, \"commitAt\": 166}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\n    \"keysMoved\": 5, \"keysSwitched\": 5, \"epochsCommitted\": 1,\n    \"recordVersionsTransferred\": 11,\n    \"bytesTransferred\": 82, \"bytesMoved\": 36, \"overheadBytes\": 46,\n    \"barriersPassed\": 5,\n    \"movements\": [{\"key\": \"...\", \"from\": \"n3\", \"to\": \"n4\", \"ringVersion\": 1,\n                   \"committed\": true, \"beganAt\": 60, \"switchedAt\": 91}]\n  },\n  \"verifications\": {\n    \"ownership\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"version\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"confirmedWritesSurvive\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"removalSafety\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"noStaleReadAccepted\": {\"pass\": true}\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`recordVersionsTransferred(11) > keysMoved(5)`：5 个键各传一份快照，另含迁移窗口内\n被前转发的 6 个并发写版本；`overheadBytes` 即这部分额外迁移量。\n\n---\n\n## 样例 2：缩容 / 节点移除（scalein.json）\n\n与扩容相同，区别在操作：\n\n```json\n\"initialNodes\": [\n  {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 1}, {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 1},\n  {\"id\": \"n3\", \"weight\": 2}, {\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}\n],\n\"operations\": [\n  {\"kind\": \"scaleIn\", \"tick\": 80, \"remove\": [\"n2\"]},\n  {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 110, \"endTick\": 150}\n]\n```\n\n结果要点：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"removedNodes\": [\"n2\"],\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 1, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n3\",\"n4\"], \"beganAt\": 80, \"commitAt\": 176}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\"keysMoved\": 7, \"epochsCommitted\": 1},\n  \"verifications\": { \"removalSafety\": {\"pass\": true}, \"...\": \"...\" }\n}\n```\n\nn2 原属主的键全部迁到 n3/n4；移除安全闸门在 COMMIT 前确认 n2 不再持有任何键的最新\n版本，之后才发 DECOMMISSION，`removedNodes` 才出现 n2。\n\n---\n\n## 样例 3：迁移中断（interrupted.json）\n\n```json\n\"stopTick\": 180,\n\"operations\": [\n  {\"kind\": \"scaleOut\", \"tick\": 50, \"add\": [{\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}]},\n  {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 70, \"endTick\": 175}\n]\n```\n\n黑洞几乎覆盖整个迁移窗，COMMIT 无法在 `stopTick` 前完成。结果：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 1, \"beganAt\": 50, \"commitAt\": 0}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\n    \"keysMoved\": 0, \"keysSwitched\": 0, \"epochsCommitted\": 0,\n    \"recordVersionsTransferred\": 0, \"bytesTransferred\": 0,\n    \"movements\": []\n  },\n  \"stats\": {\"writesConfirmed\": 170, \"writesFailed\": 0},\n  \"verifications\": {\n    \"ownership\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"version\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"confirmedWritesSurvive\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"removalSafety\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"noStaleReadAccepted\": {\"pass\": true}\n  }\n}\n```\n\n迁移未提交，新环不作为权威；屏障后未决的写**从未被确认**，而全部已确认写仍在旧属主\n（最终环）上。该例的 `writesIssued - writesConfirmed` 即因中断而挂起、正确地不计为\n成功也不丢失的写。把黑洞 `endTick` 提前（例如 110）并加大 `drainTicks`，同一协议会\n靠重传恢复并提交——`scaleout.json`/`scalein.json` 正是该恢复路径的验收。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_1a900778477a2c093f548a6c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2739,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":295736,"output_tokens":1905,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_hvgs6xs56kd8kpm2fe3zf0ig":{"content":"# 请求文件就在本目录，可直接作为 `chmig -in` 的输入：\n\n| 文件 | 场景 | 关键观察点 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `scaleout.json` | 3 节点(权重 1:1:2) → 加入权重 2 的 n4，迁移窗内并发写入，并叠加一次迁移流量黑洞 | 约 1/4 键迁移；黑洞靠重传自愈；COMMIT 后版本与归属正确 |\n| `scalein.json` | 4 节点 → 移除 n2，叠加迁移黑洞与并发写 | n2 只有在全部键过屏障、存活属主持有最新版本后才下线 |\n| `interrupted.json` | 扩容迁移窗内持续黑洞到模拟结束 | epoch 不提交、迁移量计 0，但已确认写零丢失、最终仍归旧属主 |\n\n运行：\n\n```bash\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scaleout.json     -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/scalein.json      -strict\ngo run ./cmd/chmig -in examples/interrupted.json          # 故意中断，不用 -strict 判失败\n```\n\n---\n\n## 样例 1：扩容（scaleout.json，节选）\n\n```json\n{\n  \"seed\": 42,\n  \"vnodesPerWeight\": 64,\n  \"preload\": true,\n  \"lossRate\": 0.05,\n  \"duplicateRate\": 0.02,\n  \"reorderRate\": 0.02,\n  \"minLinkDelay\": 1,\n  \"maxLinkDelay\": 3,\n  \"retryTicks\": 20,\n  \"migrationConcurrency\": 8,\n  \"barrierTicks\": 30,\n  \"drainTicks\": 400,\n  \"initialNodes\": [\n    {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 1},\n    {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 1},\n    {\"id\": \"n3\", \"weight\": 2}\n  ],\n  \"keys\": [\"user:0001\", \"user:0002\", \"...\"],\n  \"clients\": [\n    {\"id\": \"c1\", \"writes\": 120, \"startTick\": 5, \"endTick\": 220, \"readEvery\": 4},\n    {\"id\": \"c2\", \"writes\": 120, \"startTick\": 10, \"endTick\": 240, \"readEvery\": 5}\n  ],\n  \"operations\": [\n    {\"kind\": \"scaleOut\", \"tick\": 60, \"add\": [{\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}]},\n    {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 90, \"endTick\": 130}\n  ]\n}\n```\n\n响应（节选）：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 0, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n2\",\"n3\"], \"beganAt\": 0,   \"commitAt\": 0},\n    {\"version\": 1, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n2\",\"n3\",\"n4\"], \"beganAt\": 60, \"commitAt\": 166}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\n    \"keysMoved\": 5, \"keysSwitched\": 5, \"epochsCommitted\": 1,\n    \"recordVersionsTransferred\": 11,\n    \"bytesTransferred\": 82, \"bytesMoved\": 36, \"overheadBytes\": 46,\n    \"barriersPassed\": 5,\n    \"movements\": [{\"key\": \"...\", \"from\": \"n3\", \"to\": \"n4\", \"ringVersion\": 1,\n                   \"committed\": true, \"beganAt\": 60, \"switchedAt\": 91}]\n  },\n  \"verifications\": {\n    \"ownership\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"version\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"confirmedWritesSurvive\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"removalSafety\": {\"pass\": true},\n    \"noStaleReadAccepted\": {\"pass\": true}\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`recordVersionsTransferred(11) > keysMoved(5)`：5 个键各传一份快照，另含迁移窗口内\n被前转发的 6 个并发写版本；`overheadBytes` 即这部分额外迁移量。\n\n---\n\n## 样例 2：缩容 / 节点移除（scalein.json）\n\n与扩容相同，区别在操作：\n\n```json\n\"initialNodes\": [\n  {\"id\": \"n1\", \"weight\": 1}, {\"id\": \"n2\", \"weight\": 1},\n  {\"id\": \"n3\", \"weight\": 2}, {\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}\n],\n\"operations\": [\n  {\"kind\": \"scaleIn\", \"tick\": 80, \"remove\": [\"n2\"]},\n  {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 110, \"endTick\": 150}\n]\n```\n\n结果要点：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"removedNodes\": [\"n2\"],\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 1, \"nodes\": [\"n1\",\"n3\",\"n4\"], \"beganAt\": 80, \"commitAt\": 176}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\"keysMoved\": 7, \"epochsCommitted\": 1},\n  \"verifications\": { \"removalSafety\": {\"pass\": true}, \"...\": \"...\" }\n}\n```\n\nn2 原属主的键全部迁到 n3/n4；移除安全闸门在 COMMIT 前确认 n2 不再持有任何键的最新\n版本，之后才发 DECOMMISSION，`removedNodes` 才出现 n2。\n\n---\n\n## 样例 3：迁移中断（interrupted.json）\n\n```json\n\"stopTick\": 180,\n\"operations\": [\n  {\"kind\": \"scaleOut\", \"tick\": 50, \"add\": [{\"id\": \"n4\", \"weight\": 2}]},\n  {\"kind\": \"interrupt\", \"tick\": 70, \"endTick\": 175}\n]\n```\n\n黑洞几乎覆盖整个迁移窗，COMMIT 无法在 `stopTick` 前完成。结果：\n\n```json\n{\n  \"topologyEpochs\": [\n    {\"version\": 1, \"beganAt\": 50, \"commitAt\": 0}\n  ],\n  \"migration\": {\n    \"keysMoved\": 0, \"keysSwitched\": 0, \"epochsCommitted\": 0,\n    \"recordVersionsTransferred\": 0, }\n}\n```\n\n迁移未提交，新环不作为权威；屏障后未决的写**从未被确认**，而全部已确认写仍在旧属主\n（最终环）上。该例的 `writesIssued - writesConfirmed` 即因中断而挂起、正确地不计为\n成功也不丢失的写。把黑洞 `endTick` 提前（例如 110）并加大 {"parentUuid":"27db5f4d-0463-4f55-aa99-761393c8c584","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"项目完成并已提交。下面是交付说明与**实际运行结果**。\n\n## 交付内容\n\n纯后端、单进程、确定性的**离散事件模拟器**（Go 1.22，零第三方依赖，无 socket、无 goroutine、无真实集群）。\n\n- `ring/` — 带权重和虚拟节点的一致性哈希环（FNV-1a + splitmix64 雪崩化），不可变拓扑视图与键 Diff\n- `sim/` — 堆事件引擎（可注入丢包/重复/乱序/迁移流量黑洞）、节点迁移协议、客户端双读、控制器编排、外部真值账本与 5 项端到端校验\n- `cmd/chmig/` — JSON 请求 → JSON 报告 的命令行（`-strict` 用于 CI）\n- `examples/` — 扩容、缩容、迁移中断三个请求样例 + 说明 + 真实输出\n- 14 个自动化测试（含 3 场景 × 25 种子 = 75 组合、15% 丢包的压测）\n\n## 核心设计如何满足每条要求\n\n- **虚拟节点+权重**：虚拟节点数 = 权重 × vnodesPerWeight；测试验证权重 4:1 的实际键占比，以及加一个节点只迁移约 1/(N+1) 的键。\n- **迁移期双读、单一版本决胜**：客户端同时读旧/新属主，取版本号最大者；并加每客户端单调读水位线，陈旧/缺失副本不被接受。\n- **切换屏障**：`BEGIN→SNAPSHOT→FORWARD→BARRIER→COMMIT`；A 冻结后到 COMMIT 前双方都不确认新写，B 在 COMMIT 时才落盘缓冲写——这是中断安全的关键。\n- **节点移除**：COMMIT 前的移除闸门逐键证明存活属主已持有最新版本，否则拒绝下线；事后再复核一次。\n- **迁移量统计**：`keysMoved / recordVersionsTransferred / bytesTransferred / bytesMoved / overheadBytes`，并区分\"过屏障但未提交\"与\"已提交迁移\"。\n\n## 实际运行的命令与结果（如实记录）\n\n- `go test ./... -count=1` 与 `-race`：**14/14 通过**，gofmt/vet 干净。\n- 扩容：5 键迁移、11 个记录版本、epoch 提交于 tick 166，5 项校验全 true，`-strict` 退出码 0。\n- 缩容：n2 的 7 个键迁出，`removedNodes=[\"n2\"]`，epoch tick 176 提交，`-strict` 退出码 0。\n- 中断（黑洞至 tick 175）：epoch `commitAt=0`、迁移量计 0；184 写 / 170 确认 / 0 失败——未决写正确地\"未确认\"而非丢失，最终权威仍为旧环且全部已确认写在旧属主上，5 项校验仍全 true。\n\n## 开发中真实遇到并修复的缺陷（未掩盖）\n\n接入真实随机丢包后暴露出若干竞态/一致性问题，均已修复并有回归测试：重传幂等应答错取最新版本值、屏障完成上报丢失导致无法提交、COMMIT 后迟到快照用旧值回退存储、双读仅收到 not-found 时返回空、并发读使单调读水位线被旁路。这些正是压力扫描的价值所在。\n\n工作已提交到当前分支（commit `4ee74d3`）。","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_d569a21145bdcc0c2cacf8ef","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":641,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":303928,"output_tokens":826,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":0,"type":"assistant","uuid":"d25b6174-e249-478c-b0d3-887e46cd00bb","timestamp":"2026-09-23T07:29:19.029Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp26/b","sessionId":"e9ed1595-200c-4b9b-b662-a8e08199408b","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp26-b","slug":"scalable-scribbling-raven"}
